paper.title: A balloon effect: ban one channel and a hidden trait finds another
paper.abstract: Language models trained on the outputs of other models can acquire traits that those outputs never mention, such as a preference for an animal carried by lists of numbers. Such subliminal learning can pass on unwanted traits. The intuitive defence is to find and forbid the tokens through which a trait shows, but how a trait's trace behaves under such bans, and what of it a student learns, has not been resolved. We closed a trait's outlets one by one in two stress tests, a preference chain and a

summary.core_problem: 研究用模型输出训练学生模型时，隐藏 trait 是否能绕过表面 token 禁令继续传递，以及这种传递发生在哪些内部电路上。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是合成数据安全与机制分析。它直接挑战“过滤可见特征即可净化 teacher 输出”的做法，对使用模型生成 token 做 continued pretraining、SFT 数据扩增或蒸馏都有警示意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者设计两个 stress test：preference chain 和 name chain，在两个模型、六种输出格式和 16 个 trait 上逐步封禁 trait 的外显通道。观察 trait 是否迁移到剩余格式自由度中，并进一步分解到单个 head 和 neuron，定位把 trait 写入输出的电路；最后通过 patching 该电路阻断传递。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个模型、六种输出格式、16 个 trait。结果显示逐个禁止表面通道不能移除 trait，trait 会转移到格式仍允许表达的位置；摘要称单 head/neuron 级分析定位到写入电路，并且 patching 该电路能在 teacher 写数字时切断传递。模型规模、训练 token 数、学生训练 recipe 和定量效果未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether hidden traits in model-generated training data survive surface-token bans and how those traits are transmitted through internal circuits.
summary_en.importance: This is a synthetic-data safety and mechanistic-analysis contribution. It directly challenges the assumption that filtering visible features is enough to sanitize teacher outputs used for continued pretraining, SFT augmentation, or distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors run two stress tests, a preference chain and a name chain, across two models, six output formats, and 16 traits. They close visible outlets one by one, test whether the trait moves into remaining degrees of freedom, and decompose the transfer down to individual heads and neurons. They then patch the circuit that writes the trait into the output.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover two models, six output formats, and 16 traits. The abstract reports that surface bans do not remove the trait; instead, the trait moves to whatever part of the format still allows expression. Circuit-level analysis identifies heads and neurons involved in writing the trait, and patching that circuit blocks transfer while the teacher writes numbers. Model sizes, token counts, student-training recipe, and exact quantitative effects are not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 会改变我对 synthetic data filtering 的 prior：表面禁词不够，需复现其 circuit-patching setup。
recommendation.en: This changes my prior on synthetic-data filtering: surface bans are insufficient, and the circuit-patching setup is worth reproducing.

paper.title: Model Collapse Is Avoidable Even as Real Data Vanishes: A Sharp Criterion for Iterative Gaussian Estimation
paper.abstract: Large generative models are commonly trained on data collected from the open web, which may contain data produced by previous generations of the same model. Previous work has shown that recursively training on model-generated data can progressively degrade model performance, a phenomenon known as model collapse. Yet, generative models continue to improve dramatically over time. Existing theory suggests that this is enabled by the availability of new real data at each iteration, kept separate fro

summary.core_problem: 研究当真实数据与模型生成数据无法被严格分离、且真实数据比例逐步减少时，递归训练是否必然导致 model collapse。
summary.importance: 贡献是合成数据闭环与 model collapse 的理论分析。它把常见的“必须持续加入并单独保存真实数据才能避免崩塌”假设，改成更接近开放网络污染的混合采样设定，并尝试给出避免崩塌的 sharp criterion。
summary.technical_approach: 作者分析多元高斯分布的迭代均值与协方差估计。每一轮训练样本来自真实数据分布与上一轮估计分布的混合，真实样本和生成样本不被区别处理。该设定抽象了生成模型输出回流到训练语料、且数据来源标签不可用的情况。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示主要是理论研究，未披露 LLM 或图像生成模型实验。对象是 multivariate Gaussian mean/covariance iterative estimation；具体 sharp criterion 的形式、维度依赖、真实数据比例衰减条件和有限样本实验在摘要中未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether recursive training necessarily causes model collapse when real and generated data cannot be separated and the amount of real data gradually vanishes.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a theoretical analysis of synthetic-data feedback loops and model collapse. It replaces the common assumption that fresh real data must be kept separate with a more realistic mixture setting resembling open-web contamination.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze iterative estimation of the mean and covariance of a multivariate Gaussian. At each iteration, samples come from a mixture of the true data distribution and the previously estimated distribution, without treating real and generated samples differently.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates a primarily theoretical study, with no disclosed LLM or image-generation experiments. The object of study is iterative Gaussian mean and covariance estimation; the exact sharp criterion, dimensional dependence, decay schedule for real data, and finite-sample experiments are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看定理条件和相图：高斯设定很窄，但它直接挑战“真实/合成必须分离”的 collapse 叙事。
recommendation.en: Skim the theorem conditions and phase diagram: the Gaussian setup is narrow, but it directly challenges the usual real/synthetic separation story.

paper.title: Isekai3D SDG: A Platform for Diverse Synthetic Gameplay Visual Data
paper.abstract: We present Isekai3D Synthetic Data Generation (SDG), a platform for simulating and capturing synthetic 3D gameplay for research in vision and world models, neural graphics, gameplay agents, and other applications. The platform combines reusable environment and character assets with Unreal Engine plugins in a two-stage workflow. First, world simulation generates gameplay while recording the world state, character movements, actions, and camera tracks needed for replay. Second, the recorded simula

summary.core_problem: 构建一个可模拟、回放并采集合成 3D gameplay 视觉数据的平台，为视觉模型、world model、神经图形和 gameplay agent 提供训练友好的数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是合成数据平台与数据采集系统。它不是 LLM 文本预训练数据工作，但对多模态预训练和 world-model 数据管线有边缘参考价值，尤其是 simulation/capture 解耦和帧级元数据对齐。
summary.technical_approach: Isekai3D SDG 基于 Unreal Engine 插件和可复用环境、角色资产，采用两阶段流程：先运行 world simulation 并记录世界状态、角色运动、动作和相机轨迹；再回放记录的 simulation，以不同分辨率、帧率、渲染和相机配置采集视频、图像、深度图等输出。视觉输出配套 frame-aligned camera、character、action metadata，并以训练友好格式上传。
summary.experiments: 摘要描述平台能力和数据产物，但未披露生成数据规模、资产数量、采集成本、下游训练收益、与真实数据混合比例、world model 或 agent 训练对照结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a platform for simulating, replaying, and capturing synthetic 3D gameplay visual data for vision models, world models, neural graphics, and gameplay agents.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a synthetic-data platform and capture system. It is not text LLM pretraining data, but it has peripheral relevance to multimodal pretraining and world-model data pipelines, especially through simulation/capture decoupling and frame-aligned metadata.
summary_en.technical_approach: Isekai3D SDG uses Unreal Engine plugins and reusable environment and character assets in a two-stage workflow. First, world simulation records world state, character movements, actions, and camera tracks. Second, the recorded simulation is replayed to capture videos, images, depth maps, and other outputs under selected resolution, frame-rate, rendering, and camera settings. Outputs include frame-aligned camera, character, and action metadata and are uploaded in a training-friendly format.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes platform capabilities and data products, but does not report dataset scale, asset count, generation cost, downstream training gains, real/synthetic mixture ratios, or controlled results for world-model or agent training.

recommendation.zh: 可作为多模态数据管线案例看摘要；没有训练收益曲线前，不应把它当成数据 scaling 证据。
recommendation.en: Useful as a multimodal data-pipeline case study; without training-gain curves, it is not evidence for data scaling.

paper.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
paper.abstract: Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level

summary.core_problem: Computer-use Agents 的训练受限于交互数据多样性、可控性和可靠性，现有递归改进又常依赖自生成经验，容易扩展能力不足和收益递减。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 训练数据飞轮与递归自我改进框架。它不是基础预训练论文，但触及一个重要接口：如何从开放世界数据中构造可训练轨迹，并用模型弱点驱动下一轮数据生产。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CUA-Master 的 nested double-loop recursive improvement。外层是 world-data-model flywheel，持续纳入开放世界语料，并根据当前模型弱点指导数据构建和优化迭代；内层是数据飞轮，先从教学视频中挖掘真实工作流作为 seed task，再用视觉-语义双路径重建轨迹，并将种子转化为可复用 primitive 以支持后续扩展。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型规模、训练 token/trajectory 数、合成与真实数据比例、baseline 名称或量化提升。已知实验重点应是 CUA 交互数据构建和递归训练，但效果细节需要正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 输入中标注机构包括 MMLab、CUHK、THU、HKUST(GZ)、Explore Academy、JD。

summary_en.core_problem: Computer-use agent training is constrained by limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data, while existing recursive improvement often depends on self-generated experience and shows diminishing returns.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-data flywheel and recursive improvement framework. It is not a base pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface: constructing trainable trajectories from open-world data and using model weaknesses to drive subsequent data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: CUA-Master introduces a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. The outer world-data-model flywheel continuously incorporates open-world corpora and uses evolving model weaknesses to guide data construction and optimization. The inner data flywheel mines authentic workflows from instructional videos as seed tasks, reconstructs trajectories through visual and semantic paths, and converts seeds into reusable primitives for further propagation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose model size, number of tokens or trajectories, real-to-synthetic data ratio, baselines, or quantitative gains. The experiments likely center on CUA interaction data construction and recursive training, but the effect size must be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The input lists MMLab, CUHK, THU, HKUST(GZ), Explore Academy, and JD as affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据飞轮设计，尤其外层 weakness-driven 采样；实验若没有等算力对照，就只能当 posttrain 数据工程信号。
recommendation.en: Read the data-flywheel design, especially weakness-driven sampling; without compute-matched controls, treat it as a post-training data-engineering signal.

institutions: Affiliation:MMLab, CUHK THU HKUST(GZ) Explore Academy, JD

paper.title: SIMIT: Self-Improving Vision-Language Models via Imagination at Test-Time
paper.abstract: We introduce SIMIT, a test-time self-improvement framework in which a vision-language model creates its own query-specific training data before answering an unlabeled test query. Our goal is to improve performance on a given target test set without annotations or external models. To pursue this goal, some test-time methods improve answers through longer reasoning or repeated sampling but leave the model unchanged. Others update the model using rewards based on majority agreement among multiple c

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 在无标注测试集上能否先为目标 query 合成 query-specific 训练样本，再通过测试时更新提升回答质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是合成数据闭环与 test-time self-improvement。它把自训练信号从“模型对目标题的自我判断”转成“模型构造自己可控答案的相似练习题”，对合成数据可靠性和测试时训练有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SIMIT。模型先想象与目标 query 相似的问题，并在生成图像前先指定答案，再实现对应图像，形成合成的 question-answer-image triplets。方法结合 native image generation 与可扩展 skill library，用于覆盖多种结构化视觉语言任务；随后用这些合成样本对模型做 query-specific 训练或适配。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型参数量、训练步数、合成样本数量、测试时更新成本、具体 benchmark 和提升幅度。已知设定是不使用人工标注或外部模型，目标是在给定无标注 test set 上提升性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether a VLM can synthesize query-specific training examples for an unlabeled test query and improve itself at test time before answering.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a synthetic-data and test-time self-improvement loop. It replaces self-rewarding the target answer with constructing controllable practice problems, which is relevant to reliability issues in synthetic data and self-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIMIT first imagines problems similar to the target query, specifies the answer before generating the image, and builds synthetic question-answer-image triplets. It combines native image generation with an extensible skill library for structured multimodal tasks, then uses the generated examples for query-specific adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not disclose model size, number of update steps, amount of synthetic data, test-time compute cost, benchmark names, or gains. The stated setting uses no annotations and no external models, targeting performance improvement on an unlabeled test set.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图和消融；它绕开 self-judge 奖励的思路干净，但测试时更新成本和错误合成分布是硬风险。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and ablations; it cleanly avoids self-judge rewards, but test-time update cost and synthetic distribution errors are the real risks.

paper.title: NormDetect: Anchored Calibration for Low-False-Positive Detection of Machine-Generated Web Text
paper.abstract: Web platforms screen posts for text written by large language models, and every false flag hits a human writer. Detectors must therefore run at a very low false positive rate (FPR). Zero-shot detectors such as Binoculars score text with frozen language models, but invisible edits such as homoglyphs shatter tokenization and push machine text into the human range. Unicode normalization undoes these edits, yet the normalized score still misses half of the machine text at a strict FPR, under attacks

summary.core_problem: 在极低误报率约束下检测机器生成网页文本，同时抵抗不可见 Unicode 编辑等会破坏 tokenizer 的攻击。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据质量与合成文本污染检测方法。它不直接改进预训练，但对大规模网页语料清洗、合成内容过滤、低误报阈值校准有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 NormDetect：先对文本做 Unicode normalization，得到归一化后的 zero-shot detector 分数；再训练按网页 section 区分的 token-statistics head，并把该 head 锚定到归一化 zero-shot 分数上。混合权重在训练 folds 上按 human FPR 上限选择，最终阈值只用 human text 校准。
summary.experiments: 使用 Falcon-7B scoring pair，与 Binoculars 类 zero-shot detector、token-statistics heads 等比较；在 RAID benchmark 的 8 个 section 和约 11 类攻击上测试。摘要给出的关键结果是：严格 FPR 下，归一化分数在无法清洗的攻击上仍漏掉约一半机器文本；若只用 token-statistics head，召回低于归一化分数，且部分 section 误报过多。具体提升幅度未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Detect machine-generated web text at very low false-positive rates while remaining robust to invisible Unicode edits that break tokenization.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a data-quality and synthetic-contamination detection contribution. It does not change pretraining itself, but it is relevant to web-scale corpus filtering where false positives against human text are costly.
summary_en.technical_approach: NormDetect normalizes Unicode first, scores text with a frozen zero-shot detector, then trains per-section token-statistics heads anchored to the normalized score. The blend weight is selected under a human-FPR cap on training folds, and the final threshold is calibrated using human text only.
summary_en.experiments: The paper uses a Falcon-7B scoring pair and evaluates on eight sections of the RAID benchmark with roughly eleven attacks. It compares against Binoculars-style zero-shot scoring and learned token-statistics heads. The abstract reports that normalization still misses about half of machine text under strict FPR in attacks with nothing to clean, while standalone heads recall less and over-flag some human sections. Exact gains are not disclosed in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为网页预训练语料过滤的低误报案例看，重点读校准 setup；方法增量，但 failure mode 很实际。
recommendation.en: Useful as a low-FPR web-corpus filtering case study; read the calibration setup, since the method is incremental but the failure mode is real.

paper.title: When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
paper.abstract: To succeed in real-world long-horizon software development, coding agents must satisfy multi-dimensional task specifications, such as interface compatibility and error handling, and do so without breaking existing dependencies. However, current works lack specification in both quantity and diversity, often emphasizing primary goals while ignoring complex constraints. Synthesizing tasks to bridge this gap presents two challenges: naively adding specifications risks reducing tasks to trivial check

summary.core_problem: 解决长周期软件开发任务中，合成 coding-agent 任务缺少数量、多样性和相互依赖约束，导致不能有效测试或训练真实工程能力的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是可执行验证的合成代码任务生成。它关心的是如何生成带有接口兼容、错误处理和依赖不破坏等交互式规格的任务，并用测试和轨迹审计控制质量；这对后训练或中期训练中的代码合成数据构造有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CodeSpecWeave。框架从真实开发者 seed 出发，由 synthesis agent 迭代生成相互耦合的任务要求和可执行测试；review agent 审计多个模型的解题轨迹，用于发现测试漏检、隐藏缺陷或错误拒绝有效替代方案。核心不是单纯扩写需求，而是让规格之间形成必须联合推理的依赖关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露生成任务数量、代码仓库规模、参与审计的模型、测试覆盖率、baseline、agent 成功率或是否用于训练。可确认的是其目标是构造 rich interdependent specifications，并通过 executable tests 与多模型轨迹审计保证任务质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of quantity, diversity, and interdependent constraints in synthetic long-horizon software-development tasks for coding agents.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is executable and audited synthetic coding-task generation. The relevant part for foundation-model work is the recipe for generating verifiable code data with interface compatibility, error handling, and dependency-preservation constraints, which can inform code mid-training or post-training data construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: CodeSpecWeave starts from real developer seeds. A synthesis agent iteratively creates coupled task requirements and executable tests, while a review agent audits solution trajectories from multiple models to detect under-specified tests, hidden flaws, or invalid rejection of acceptable alternatives. The central idea is to force joint reasoning over interacting specifications rather than adding checklist-style requirements.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose the number of generated tasks, repository scale, auditing models, test coverage, baselines, agent success rates, or whether the data is used for training. It states that the framework builds rich interdependent specifications and uses executable tests plus multi-model trajectory auditing for quality control.

recommendation.zh: 建议 skim 生成和审计设计；若要做代码 RL/SFT 数据，规格相互依赖比堆更多单点测试更值得复现。
recommendation.en: Skim the generation and audit design; for code RL/SFT data, interdependent specs are more worth reproducing than simply adding more isolated tests.

paper.title: Sometimes less is more: Investigating inductive biases of MLPs and Transformers on noisy k-parity features
paper.abstract: We empirically investigate how MLPs and Transformers differ when trained on data sets containing one or more features encoded by noisy k-parity. Noisy k-parity gives us hard synthetic data sets in which we can control the predictivity and availability of every feature. Across a range of data distributions, data scales and model sizes, we find large differences in the training dynamics and inductive biases of the two architectures: Transformers are more robust to noisy features but struggle to le

summary.core_problem: 在包含噪声 k-parity 特征的合成数据集上，MLP 和 Transformer 的归纳偏置和训练动态有何不同？
summary.importance: 通过控制特征的预测性和可用性，揭示了 Transformer 和 MLP 在处理噪声和复杂特征时的根本差异，为理解架构的归纳偏置提供了干净的实证分析。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 noisy k-parity 构建合成数据集，独立控制特征的预测性（predictivity）和可用性（availability）。在不同数据分布、数据规模和模型大小下，对比 MLP 和 Transformer 的训练动态和最终性能。
summary.experiments: 在合成数据集上训练 MLP 和 Transformer。发现 Transformer 对噪声特征更鲁棒，但难以学习复杂、低可用性的特征；MLP 则相反，且随数据量增加稳步提升。此外，在固定训练预算下，增加唯一训练样本数会减慢 Transformer 的优化速度，导致最终准确率下降。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自剑桥大学和牛津大学。

summary_en.core_problem: How do the inductive biases and training dynamics of MLPs and Transformers differ on synthetic datasets containing noisy k-parity features?
summary_en.importance: By controlling the predictivity and availability of features, this work reveals fundamental differences between Transformers and MLPs in handling noise and complex features, providing a clean empirical analysis of architectural inductive biases.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs synthetic datasets using noisy k-parity to independently control feature predictivity and availability. Compares the training dynamics and final performance of MLPs and Transformers across various data distributions, data scales, and model sizes.
summary_en.experiments: Trains MLPs and Transformers on synthetic datasets. Finds Transformers are more robust to noisy features but struggle with complex, low-availability features; MLPs show the opposite trend and improve steadily with more data. Also finds that under a fixed training budget, increasing unique training examples can slow Transformer optimization, reducing final accuracy.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from University of Cambridge and University of Oxford.

recommendation.zh: 用干净的合成任务对比了 Transformer 和 MLP 的归纳偏置，关于 '数据量增加反而拖慢 Transformer 优化' 的观察值得关注，建议看 §4 和 Fig 3。
recommendation.en: Compares inductive biases of Transformers and MLPs using clean synthetic tasks; the observation that 'more data slows down Transformer optimization' is intriguing. Skim §4 and Fig 3.

paper.title: Prompt Lottery in LLM-as-a-Judge: Measuring and Mitigating Sensitivity to Syntactic Rephrasing
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge has become a standard for evaluating large language models, yet most approaches implicitly assume that a single judge prompt functions as a stable evaluation instrument. Prior work has primarily explored deliberate prompt modifications such as scoring rubrics, role descriptions, or chain-of-thought reasoning in order to optimize accuracy. In contrast, we investigate whether validated prompt variants intended to preserve evaluation semantics while differing in surface realization (

summary.core_problem: LLM-as-a-Judge（LLMaJ）评测默认“一个 judge prompt 就是稳定仪器”，但现实中只做句法层面的等价改写（语义不变）就可能显著改变打分与排序。论文要解决的是：系统量化这种“Prompt Lottery”（评测结论对等价改写的敏感性），评估它对人类一致性与模型排名的破坏程度，并给出一个在鲁棒性与推理成本之间更划算的缓解策略。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接影响不在训练算法，而在“训练与评测闭环”的评测侧：
- 预训练/中期训练常用自动评测做 ablation 与数据决策，若 judge prompt 的句法改写就能导致 rank reversal，会把很多 recipe 结论变成偶然事件。
- 对 RLHF/RLAIF、reward model 训练与验证同样关键：judge 的不稳定会直接污染 reward 信号与离线评估。
- 论文把“提示鲁棒性”提升为一种评测不变性（paraphrastic robustness）要求，并给出可操作的测量与降本聚合方案，属于评测方法论层面的硬问题。
summary.technical_approach:
核心思路是把“prompt 改写”当作评测扰动源，固定语义、只改变句法表述，测量 judge 输出的方差与一致性退化。
- Prompt families：为每个 judge family 设计原始 prompt + 4 个语义等价变体，强调是 validated paraphrases，而不是加入新 rubric 或新角色设定。
- 稳定性度量：比较不同 prompt 变体下 judge 之间的一致性（文中描述从 near-perfect 退化到 fair），并进一步看这种退化是否会降低与人类标注的一致性，以及是否会造成模型排名反转（尤其在更“客观”的任务上）。
- 关键控制：temperature 设为 1e-5，尽量把随机采样噪声压到最低，让观测到的差异更接近“语义一致性缺失”而不是投票效应；同时承认 GPU kernel 非确定性仍可能残留。
- 缓解：提出 selective aggregation（选择性聚合）。不是对 5 个 prompt 全量集成，而是用更少的调用恢复大部分鲁棒性；论文给出一个量化结论：在显著节省推理成本的情况下达到接近全量聚合的鲁棒性。
summary.experiments:
规模：总计约 825–845 个实验条件（文中两处数字略有出入，但量级一致），覆盖 12 个数据集、6 类 judge family、5 个 backbone judge 模型、每类 5 个 prompt 变体。
Backbone judges：GPT-4o、gpt-oss-120B、Llama 3.3 70B Instruct、Kimi-K2.5(-Instruct)、Qwen3(-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct)。
主要结果（按全文描述抓关键数字）：
- 仅做句法等价改写，judge 间一致性会从“接近完美”下降到“fair”水平，且这种下降幅度大于人类标注在可接受用户研究中的波动。
- 这种不稳定不是无关紧要：会降低与人类判断的对齐，并在更客观的任务上出现模型 rank reversal。
- 缓解策略：selective aggregation 相比 naive 的全量聚合推理成本降低约 60%；在计算开销约 2×（而不是 5×）的情况下，达到约 86% 的“全鲁棒性”效果（论文表述为 86% of full robustness）。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议：
- 先读 Introduction：把 Prompt Lottery 定义清楚，并理解作者为什么强调“句法改写、语义不变”而不是传统的 prompt engineering。
- 重点看 Experimental Setup：12 数据集 × judge families × 5 prompts × 5 backbones 的组合方式、温度设定（1e-5）与其含义。
- 结果部分优先看两类图表/表格：
  1）不同 prompt 变体导致的一致性退化曲线/统计量（从 near-perfect 到 fair）；
  2）rank reversal 的案例与发生频率（这决定它是否会影响日常模型迭代结论）。
- 缓解方法部分要看清 selective aggregation 的决策规则：它如何在少量调用下逼近全量聚合的稳定性，以及在哪些任务/judge family 上收益最大。
- 阅读时建议顺手做一个“自检清单”：自己的评测管线是否只用单 prompt、是否做过 paraphrase stress test、是否在 RL/数据选择环节把 LLMaJ 当作确定性标尺。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines often assume a single judge prompt is a stable measurement instrument. This paper shows that even syntactic rephrasings intended to preserve evaluation semantics can substantially change judgments—sometimes enough to reverse model rankings. It formalizes and measures this “Prompt Lottery” effect and proposes a cheaper mitigation than naive multi-prompt ensembling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is evaluation-methodological, but it directly impacts the pretrain↔post-train loop: automated judging is routinely used to choose data mixtures, mid-training recipes, and RL/RLAIF reward signals. If semantically equivalent prompt variants yield materially different scores, many ablation conclusions become prompt-contingent, and reward validation becomes unreliable. The paper elevates paraphrastic robustness as a required invariance property for LLMaJ to be treated as a replacement for human evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Treat paraphrastic prompt variation as a controlled perturbation: keep the evaluation intent fixed while changing surface syntax.
- For each judge family, construct an original prompt plus four validated semantic-preserving variants (not rubric/role/CoT modifications).
- Measure robustness via inter-prompt agreement degradation and downstream consequences: reduced alignment with human judgments and rank reversals.
- Control randomness by using temperature T=1e-5 to minimize sampling variance, aiming to isolate semantic inconsistency rather than “wisdom-of-crowds” effects (while noting residual GPU nondeterminism).
- Mitigation: selective aggregation—an adaptive/efficient multi-prompt aggregation strategy that recovers most robustness with substantially fewer judge calls than full 5-prompt aggregation.
summary_en.experiments:
Scale: ~825–845 experimental conditions across 12 datasets, 6 judge families, 5 backbone judge models, and 5 prompt variants per family.
Judges: GPT-4o, gpt-oss-120B, Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, Kimi-K2.5(-Instruct), Qwen3(-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct).
Key outcomes:
- Agreement across paraphrastic prompts drops sharply (reported as degrading from near-perfect to fair), exceeding what would be considered acceptable variability in human user studies.
- The instability is consequential: it reduces human alignment and can trigger model rank reversals, including on more objective tasks.
- Selective aggregation reduces inference cost by ~60% vs naive aggregation, achieving ~86% of the robustness of full aggregation with about ~2× compute rather than ~5×.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read focus:
- Introduction: the precise definition of Prompt Lottery and why the paper isolates paraphrastic (semantic-preserving) variation instead of prompt “improvements.”
- Experimental setup: the factorial design (datasets × judge families × prompts × backbones) and the low-temperature choice (1e-5) as a robustness probe.
- Results: (1) agreement degradation statistics/plots; (2) rank-reversal analyses—these determine practical risk for model iteration.
- Mitigation section: understand the decision rule behind selective aggregation and where it fails or provides the largest gains.
- Use it as a checklist for your own evaluation stack: single-prompt dependence, paraphrase stress tests, and whether LLMaJ is being treated as a deterministic yardstick in RL/data-selection loops.

recommendation.zh: 如果你用LLM当裁判做对齐/筛数据，这篇必须看：它证明“同义改写就能翻盘”，至少要把prompt ensemble/稳定性检验纳入pipeline。
recommendation.en: Must-read if you use LLM judges for alignment or data filtering: semantic-preserving paraphrases can flip outcomes, so you need prompt ensembling and stability checks in the loop.

paper.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
paper.abstract: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, r

summary.core_problem: 如何低成本合成能同时提升“空间细节感知”和“多模态长上下文理解”的训练数据，而不是为每个下游任务单独造数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据合成范式：把多个多模态感知任务抽象成统一能力“connecting evidence”，并给出可规模化的合成流程与质量控制；对 VLM 预训练/中期训练的数据配方有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EvidenceConnect：在单张图像内选取多个相关区域的“zoomed views”，构造需要比较/聚合/链式推理的问答；核心在于把监督信号从“全图任务标签”转成“跨局部证据绑定与关系恢复”。并用基于一致性/可验证性的过滤策略保留高置信 reference answer（摘要截断，细节以正文为准）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验细节与具体数值；从描述看主要评测空间感知与多模态长上下文/证据链能力，并声称可迁移到 embodied/agent 相关的感知基准。需要在正文确认：数据规模、合成成本、过滤通过率、与直接做任务数据合成/人工标注相比的增益。

summary_en.core_problem: How to cheaply synthesize training data that improves both fine-grained spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding, instead of crafting task-specific datasets.
summary_en.importance: A data-synthesis paradigm contribution: it reframes multiple multimodal perception tasks as a shared capability (“connecting evidence”) and provides a scalable synthesis + quality-control pipeline, which is directly relevant to VLM pretraining / mid-training data recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvidenceConnect generates QA by sampling multiple zoomed-in views from a single image and asking questions that require comparison, aggregation, or multi-hop chaining across regions. The supervision shifts from global task labels to cross-region evidence binding and relation recovery. A consistency/verifiability-based filter keeps only high-confidence reference answers (details need the full paper).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full experimental specs or numbers. It claims improvements on spatial perception and multimodal long-context/evidence-chaining benchmarks with transfer to embodied/agent-related perception. The paper should be checked for data scale, synthesis cost, filtering pass rate, and gains vs direct task-data synthesis or human labels.

recommendation.zh: 把“空间感知+长上下文”抽成可合成的证据连接能力，这个数据视角比又造一个benchmark更实用；先只读数据生成/过滤与消融，确认不是prompt工程。
recommendation.en: The key value is the reframing into a synthesizable “evidence-connecting” skill; read the data generation + filtering + ablations first to verify it’s not just prompt scaffolding.

paper.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
paper.abstract: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do n

summary.core_problem: 从少量多视角参考图像生成同一主体的视频，并在相机大幅运动甚至 360 度环绕时保持主体一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成方法和训练数据合成流程，重点在主体一致性与几何约束；对统一多模态预训练只有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OmniShowcase，由两部分组成：自动化数据合成管线，生成沿多样相机轨迹变化且受主体几何驱动的视频；以及几何条件控制方法，把多视角观测之间的 3D 结构显式提供给生成模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法面向多视角 subject-to-video 生成，并强调覆盖完整 360 度轨迹和一致主体训练数据；未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或具体指标提升。
summary.authors_note: Jaegul Choo 长期从事可视化、多模态与生成模型相关研究；具体机构信息未由题面确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses subject-consistent video generation from a few multi-view reference images, especially when the camera reveals unseen surfaces during large viewpoint changes or full 360-degree orbits.
summary_en.importance: This is a video generation method and data synthesis contribution centered on subject consistency and geometry control. Its relevance to unified multimodal pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniShowcase combines an automated synthetic data pipeline that produces videos along diverse geometry-driven camera trajectories with a geometry-conditioning mechanism that explicitly connects multi-view observations through 3D structure.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for multi-view subject-to-video generation and highlights full-orbit camera motion with subject-preserving synthetic data. It does not provide model size, training data scale, baseline names, or exact metric gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Jaegul Choo is known for work in visualization, multimodal learning, and generative modeling; the affiliation is not confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据合成管线，核心启发是把几何一致性前置到训练数据；对 LLM pretrain 只是弱相关。
recommendation.en: Skim the data synthesis pipeline if needed; the useful idea is moving geometry consistency into the training data, but it is weakly tied to LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can answer many factual questions correctly, but a correct answer is not necessarily a supported one. For an LLM agent, a knowledge graph (KG) plays two roles: as a source of answers, it supplies facts that the model lacks; as a source of evidence, it supplies the supporting triples that make an answer traceable and auditable. However, existing KG agents treat the KG only as a source of answers: their training data carries answers but not evidence, and their training

summary.core_problem: 如何训练知识图谱（KG）Agent 在回答问题时，不仅给出正确答案，还能主动检索并提供支撑答案的证据（三元组）？
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的训练框架 FoG，解决了现有 KG Agent 训练数据和奖励机制只关注答案正确性而忽视证据检索的问题，提升了 Agent 回答的可追溯性和可审计性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FoG 框架，包含证据基础的合成（将显式实体隐藏在可验证的子问题后，构造自带支撑三元组的问题）、KG 交互 Agent 以及证据覆盖过程奖励（ECPR，奖励检索到支撑证据的行为）。
summary.experiments: 未提供具体模型参数和数据集信息，但强调了该框架通过构造自带证据的问题和过程奖励来训练 Agent。

summary_en.core_problem: How to train Knowledge Graph (KG) agents to not only provide correct answers but also actively retrieve and provide the evidence (triples) supporting their answers?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel training framework, FoG, addressing the issue that existing KG agent training data and reward mechanisms only focus on answer correctness, neglecting evidence retrieval, thereby improving the traceability and auditability of agent answers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the FoG framework, consisting of evidence-grounded synthesis (hiding explicit entities behind verifiable sub-questions to construct questions with built-in supporting triples), a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward (ECPR, rewarding the retrieval of supporting evidence).
summary_en.experiments: Specific model parameters and dataset information are not provided, but the emphasis is on training the agent through constructed questions with built-in evidence and process rewards.

recommendation.zh: 关注 Agent 训练中过程奖励（PRM）和数据合成的思路，但作为 KG 领域的特定应用，对通用预训练启发有限，作为 literature 备查即可。
recommendation.en: Note the use of process rewards (PRM) and data synthesis in agent training, but as a specific application in the KG domain, its inspiration for general pre-training is limited; keep as literature reference.

paper.title: How Much Information Can We Fit inside a Transformer?
paper.abstract: How efficiently can transformers store factual knowledge? The answer to this question has implications for both model design and understanding the limits of transformer-based systems. Prior studies observe a linear relationship between the number of facts memorized and the number of model parameters required, substantially worse than what theoretical analyses predict is achievable. We re-examine empirical scaling: through rigorous and systematic experiments, including extensive hyperparameter se

summary.core_problem: 研究 Transformer 到底能以多高的参数效率记住事实知识，尤其是在没有可利用结构的纯随机事实集合上，记忆容量如何随模型规模变化。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制与容量分析工作。它直接碰预训练里一个老问题：参数到底在存什么、知识记忆的瓶颈来自参数量还是训练设置。若结论成立，会修正“事实数与参数量近似线性对应”的经验印象，也会影响对模型容量、知识压缩和记忆型 scaling 的理解。
summary.technical_approach: 作者重新设计了更干净的记忆容量测量流程：在随机独立的(subject, relation, object)三元组数据上，系统搜索超参数，并用贝叶斯优化去逼近“能完美记住给定事实集的最小模型”。核心不是追求常规泛化，而是测量完全记忆所需的最小 Transformer 尺寸，并观察该最小尺寸与事实数之间的标度关系。摘要给出的关键结论是：在这种无结构合成数据上，模型可完全记忆的事实数随 Transformer hidden dimension 呈指数增长，而不是过去经验里常见的近线性关系。
summary.experiments: 实验基于合成随机三元组，重点控制数据中不存在可压缩结构。作者做了系统超参搜索，而不是固定 recipe 后直接读出容量，因此测量比许多先前工作更接近“最优可达容量”。摘要未给出具体参数区间、层数范围和对比 baseline 名称，但明确对比对象是先前观察到的线性记忆 scaling。若正文实验扎实，这类结果最值得看的是最小模型搜索曲线、容量定义是否严格、以及不同深宽配置下指数关系是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how parameter-efficient a Transformer can be at storing factual knowledge, specifically how memorization capacity scales on structure-free random fact sets.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/capacity study with direct relevance to pretraining. It probes what parameters are actually storing and whether factual memory is fundamentally linear in model size. If the result holds, it updates a common empirical prior about memory scaling and informs how we think about knowledge compression and capacity limits.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a cleaner measurement protocol for memorization capacity. Using synthetic datasets of random independent (subject, relation, object) triples with no exploitable structure, they run systematic hyperparameter search, including Bayesian optimization, to estimate the smallest Transformer that can perfectly memorize a dataset of a given size. The main claim in the abstract is that the largest perfectly memorized dataset grows exponentially with Transformer dimension, rather than roughly linearly as prior empirical work suggested.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on synthetic random triples designed to remove latent structure. Instead of reading capacity off a fixed training recipe, the paper searches for the minimum viable model, which is a stronger setup for capacity measurement. The abstract does not provide exact model ranges or named baselines, but the comparison target is prior empirical linear scaling of memorized facts versus parameters. The key things to inspect in the full paper are the minimum-model search procedure, the strictness of the perfect-memorization criterion, and whether the exponential trend is robust across depth/width choices.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动到“参数记忆容量近线性”这个老 prior；先看实验定义和最小模型搜索是否干净，若成立，知识存储的 scaling 直觉要改。
recommendation.en: This one challenges the old near-linear memory-capacity prior; first check whether the minimum-model search is clean, because if it is, your intuition about knowledge storage scaling needs updating.

paper.title: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
paper.abstract: Physical reasoning underpins how embodied systems understand and act in the physical world, yet vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable on questions about dynamics and physical causality. Progress is critically constrained by the scarcity of grounded counterfactual training data, as observational videos capture only the factual trajectory that occurred. The self-evolving paradigm offers a route beyond fixed datasets by enabling models to construct their own training problems. Extending t

summary.core_problem: 如何解决视觉语言模型在物理推理任务中缺乏反事实训练数据的问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于验证器的自进化框架，通过物理引擎生成和验证反事实数据，为 VLM 的物理推理能力提升提供了一种新的数据合成范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PhysEvolve 框架。VLM 提出可执行的世界程序和证据模式；确定性物理引擎冻结每个提出的世界，并执行 VLM 生成的干预措施，以验证反事实结果。通过这种方式，模型可以自主构建和验证包含因果关系的物理推理训练数据。
summary.experiments: 未提供具体模型参数量和 Baseline 信息。摘要指出该方法通过模型提出的可执行世界和模拟授权任务来训练 VLM 进行因果物理推理。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自加州大学伯克利分校等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the scarcity of counterfactual training data for physical reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs)?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a verifier-grounded self-evolving framework that uses a physics engine to generate and validate counterfactual data, offering a new data synthesis paradigm for improving VLM physical reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the PhysEvolve framework. A VLM proposes executable world programs and evidence schemas; a deterministic physics engine freezes each proposed world and executes VLM-generated interventions to verify counterfactual outcomes. This allows the model to autonomously construct and validate physical reasoning training data containing causal relationships.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model parameters and baselines are not provided in the abstract. The abstract states the method trains VLMs for causal physical reasoning from model-proposed executable worlds and simulation-authored tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from UC Berkeley and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 利用物理引擎作为 verifier 来合成 VLM 物理推理数据，思路合理但偏向特定领域的 data pipeline，作为 literature 备查即可。
recommendation.en: Using a physics engine as a verifier to synthesize VLM physical reasoning data is a reasonable approach but leans towards a domain-specific data pipeline; keep as literature reference.

paper.title: PHYRD: A Living Benchmark for Reproducing and Extending Theoretical Physics Research
paper.abstract: Large language models and agents have shown significant power in advanced physical research. In this paper, We introduce PHYRD, a living benchmark for theoretical-physics reasoning with 63 Reproduce and 43 Discover problems. Reproduce tests derivation of published results; Discover tests consequences of modified theoretical conditions. FormulaForest constructs the tasks with reference solutions and subquestion-level rubrics. Across five models, whole-problem accuracy ranges from 49.21% to 68.25%

summary.core_problem: 如何用可持续扩展的方式评测并推动 LLM/agent 在理论物理“复现推导 + 条件变更后发现新结论”两类任务上的推理能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型以 Benchmark + 任务构造方法为主：把“复现论文推导”和“改条件做发现”拆成可打分的 living benchmark，并给出子问题级 rubric；同时展示其任务生成器（FormulaForest）可作为合成数据提升模型在另一个科学推理评测上的准确率。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PHYRD：63 个 Reproduce（复现已发表结果的推导）+ 43 个 Discover（修改理论条件后推导新结论）问题；用 FormulaForest 生成任务、参考解与分步评分 rubric（subquestion-level）；评测设置包含 closed-book 与 tool-augmented 两种，并分析概念性错误与论证缺失等失败模式；额外做“用 FormulaForest 产出的合成数据去训练/微调”并在外部基准上验证收益。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个模型上评测：Reproduce 整题准确率约 49.21%~68.25%；Discover（closed-book）约 18.60%~74.42%；引入工具后 4 个模型在 Discover 完成数上升但仍有概念错误/缺关键论证。合成数据实验：在 OpenAI 的 FrontierScience 上，将 Qwen-35B-A3B 的准确率从 61% 提升到 72%（论文摘要给出）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a continuously extensible benchmark that evaluates and improves LLM/agent reasoning for theoretical physics, covering both reproducing published derivations and discovering consequences under modified conditions.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a benchmark + task-construction contribution: it operationalizes 'paper reproduction' and 'condition-changed discovery' into a living benchmark with subquestion rubrics, and shows the task generator (FormulaForest) can serve as synthetic training data that improves performance on an external science benchmark.
summary_en.technical_approach: PHYRD includes 63 Reproduce and 43 Discover problems. FormulaForest constructs tasks with reference solutions and subquestion-level scoring rubrics. The evaluation compares closed-book vs tool-augmented settings and analyzes failure modes such as conceptual mistakes and missing arguments. It also tests training/finetuning with FormulaForest-generated synthetic data and validates transfer gains.
summary_en.experiments: Across 5 models: whole-problem accuracy is ~49.21%–68.25% on Reproduce and ~18.60%–74.42% on closed-book Discover. With tools, 4 models solve more Discover tasks but still show conceptual errors and missing arguments. Synthetic-data result: on OpenAI FrontierScience, Qwen-35B-A3B improves from 61% to 72% accuracy (per abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把“复现推导/改条件发现”做成可扩展、可分步打分的科学推理基准，且合成数据能外溢提分；重点看 rubric 设计与合成数据实验是否足够干净。
recommendation.en: A rare benchmark that scores stepwise derivations and 'counterfactual discovery' in physics, plus a nontrivial synthetic-data transfer gain; scrutinize rubric validity and whether the training uplift is cleanly controlled.

paper.title: GRADUS: Discovering and Recovering Agent Lessons from the Environment's Latent Syllabus
paper.abstract: Training LLM agents for policy-constrained tool environments, such as an airline backend with booking, refund, and cancellation policies, requires tasks that exercise the environment's rules individually and in combination. Existing synthesis pipelines let a model propose tasks and retain only those it immediately solves, biasing training data toward easier behaviors. We introduce Gradus (Graded Rungs of Ascending Difficulty from an Underlying System), which decouples what a task should teach fr

summary.core_problem: 在“给定一个可执行、带政策约束的工具环境（如航司退改签系统）”的前提下，如何从零构造一个高覆盖、可验证、难度递进的训练课程，让 agent 学到环境中隐含的规则分支、状态依赖与跨步骤交互；并避免现有合成流水线用“能立刻做对就收录”的验收门槛把数据分布悄悄推向简单行为，导致困难但关键的规则组合长期缺失。
summary.importance: 对预训练/中期训练（mid-train）阶段的启发主要在“数据生成与验收机制就是隐式课程设计”这一点：Gradus把‘要教什么行为’与‘如何生成可通过验证的题目与轨迹’解耦，并用环境执行作为共同锚点做双向修复，显著提高困难组合行为在最终被接受语料中的存活率。它不是改模型结构或优化器，但提供了一套可迁移的、面向工具环境的课程构造范式：用可组合的行为算子表示环境规则，用覆盖反馈驱动组合搜索，用任务-解法联合校准对抗“验证过滤偏置”。对做 tool-use/agent continual pretrain 的团队，这类方法比单纯扩大合成规模更直接影响数据分布与学习曲线。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计分三层：
1) 环境→可组合行为表示（guarded operators）：把每个 action 表达为“触发条件（guards）+ 可能结果分支（policy-dependent outcomes）+ 对后续状态/可行动作的影响”。这相当于把环境的隐式规则表面化：同一动作在不同状态下可能被允许/拒绝/需要补充步骤，且结果会改变后续决策条件。
2) 覆盖引导的蓝图搜索（blueprints over operators）：不直接让模型自由写任务，而是先在算子层面组合出‘这道题要覆盖哪些规则分支与交互’的结构化蓝图，并显式控制结构复杂度（从单一规则到多规则组合、跨步骤依赖）。同时维护语料级覆盖统计，优先生成当前欠覆盖的 outcome/组合，避免只在局部多样而全局仍偏科。
3) 环境锚定的任务-解法联合精炼（joint task-solution refinement）：难点在于高难蓝图第一次往往生成不出“既可解又符合政策”的任务与轨迹。Gradus不把失败样本直接丢弃，而是用环境执行把失败归因到两侧：任务侧可能不可解/条件幻觉/目标歧义；解法侧可能偏离政策或状态跟踪错误。然后在蓝图约束下迭代修订任务描述与求解轨迹，使困难组合能通过验证进入最终训练集，从机制上对抗“验收门槛=难例淘汰器”。
此外，论文还引入“cross-space interaction dimensions”去改变同一底层要求的呈现方式（如引入歧义、间接指代、社交压力、额外推理负担），把环境规则学习与对话交互难度解耦控制。
summary.experiments:
论文在两个基准上报告了显著提升，并对 proposer 的闭源/开源差异做了对比：
- 在 τ²-Bench 上，将一个 30B 模型从 59% 提升到 89%（使用 Opus 4.5 作为 proposer）。
- 在 CAR-Bench 上，将同一 30B 模型从 47% 提升到 83%（同样使用 Opus 4.5 proposer）。
- 使用开源 Qwen3-235B 作为 proposer 时，最终分别达到 76%（τ²-Bench）与 62%（CAR-Bench）。
从这些数字能读出的关键信息是：方法收益并不完全依赖最强闭源 proposer，但 proposer 能力会影响“联合精炼”把难蓝图修复成可验证样本的成功率；同时两个基准上提升幅度都很大，符合其主张——主要收益来自数据分布与课程覆盖的改变，而不是小幅 prompt 工程。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计 25–40 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“verification 作为 hidden curriculum selector”的问题定义，这是整篇的动机与评价标准。
- 重点抓 Methodology 中三件事：guarded operators 的定义与例子（理解它如何把政策分支显式化）、blueprint 的组合与覆盖反馈（理解它如何做全局覆盖控制）、joint task-solution refinement 的失败类型与修复闭环（理解它如何让难例存活）。
- 实验部分优先看：不同 proposer（Opus 4.5 vs Qwen3-235B）的对比、CR/多规则组合相关的子项表现（如果文中有分项），以及任何关于“被修复而非丢弃”的样本比例/成功率统计（这直接验证其核心机制）。

summary_en.core_problem: Given a fixed, executable tool environment with policy constraints (e.g., airline booking/refund/cancellation rules), how can we synthesize a high-coverage, difficulty-graded training curriculum from scratch—so an LLM agent learns conditional rule branches and multi-step interactions—without letting the verification gate (keeping only immediately successful trajectories) silently skew the dataset toward easy behaviors and systematically drop hard-but-essential rule compositions?
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a data/curriculum construction recipe for tool-agent mid-training: it makes explicit that “verification is an implicit curriculum selector,” then redesigns the pipeline so hard compositions survive verification instead of being filtered out. This is not an optimizer/architecture paper; its impact is on training signal quality and distribution control for environment-grounded agent pretraining/continual pretraining. The approach is broadly reusable wherever you have an executable environment and want coverage over policy outcomes, not just a pile of solved trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Gradus separates (a) deciding what behaviors to teach from (b) producing valid tasks/solutions that pass environment checks, via three components:
1) Guarded operators: for each action, represent its preconditions (state/policy guards), its possible policy-dependent outcomes, and how each outcome changes the state and future action requirements. This turns an environment’s latent rule structure into composable primitives.
2) Coverage-guided blueprint search: compose operators into structured task blueprints that specify which outcomes/interactions a task should exercise, with explicit controls over structural complexity. Maintain corpus-level coverage statistics and prioritize underrepresented outcomes and combinations, preventing global skew even if local task proposals look diverse.
3) Environment-grounded joint task–solution refinement: instead of discarding failed generations, use environment execution as a shared anchor to iteratively repair both the task (unsatisfiable constraints, hallucinated conditions, ambiguous goals) and the solution trajectory (policy violations, state-tracking errors). The blueprint constrains the repair so the intended behavioral coverage is preserved while making the instance verifiable.
The paper also varies “interaction dimensions” (ambiguity, indirect references, social pressure, extra reasoning burden) to decouple surface interaction difficulty from the underlying policy requirements.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported gains are large on two agent benchmarks, with a clear dependence on the proposer model:
- τ²-Bench: a 30B model improves from 59% to 89% with an Opus 4.5 proposer.
- CAR-Bench: the same 30B model improves from 47% to 83% with Opus 4.5.
- With an open-weight Qwen3-235B proposer, results reach 76% (τ²-Bench) and 62% (CAR-Bench).
The pattern supports the paper’s thesis: controlling coverage and rescuing hard compositions changes the effective training distribution substantially; proposer strength mainly affects how often difficult blueprints can be repaired into valid, verified instances.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the framing: verification as a hidden curriculum selector and why naive “keep only solved” pipelines bias against hard rule interactions.
- In Methodology, focus on (i) the formalization/examples of guarded operators, (ii) how blueprints are composed and how coverage feedback is computed/used, and (iii) the joint task–solution refinement loop and its failure taxonomy.
- In Experiments, prioritize proposer comparisons (Opus vs Qwen), any breakdowns by conflict/interaction complexity, and any statistics showing how many hard candidates are recovered rather than dropped—those directly validate the core mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 读 operator 抽取与覆盖反馈部分；这是比 solved-only self-instruct 更干净的 agent 数据思路。
recommendation.en: Read the operator extraction and coverage-feedback parts; it is a cleaner agent-data recipe than solved-only self-instruct pipelines.

paper.title: Guided Diffusion for Trustworthy Synthetic Text Generation
paper.abstract: The rapid evolution of Large Language Models is fueled by massive datasets, yet this reliance poses severe privacy risks, as models can inadvertently memorize and even directly output sensitive training data. Synthetic text generation offers a promising solution to this challenge; however, existing methods struggle to reconcile rigorous privacy guarantees with high data utility. In this paper, we propose a new paradigm for private synthetic text generation: Guided Diffusion. Leveraging the uniqu

summary.core_problem: 在“有严格隐私保证（DP/DSI）”与“合成文本可用性（流畅度、语义保真、下游效用）”之间找到可落地的折中：既要避免训练数据逐字泄露/成员推断等风险，又要让合成语料在统计与语义层面接近真实分布。论文把关键瓶颈定位为：在离散词表空间做差分隐私会导致噪声尺度过大，从而把语言结构直接打碎；而把隐私机制放到语义嵌入空间后，又需要一种能把“被噪声扰动后的连续语义向量”稳定解码回高质量离散文本的生成范式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于提供了一条更“工程可用”的私有数据利用路径：把隐私预算主要消耗在低维语义空间（可配合现成 DP 聚类/聚合），再用可控生成模型把语义条件还原成文本。它不是在 AR LLM 上硬做全局控制，而是利用 diffusion LM 的迭代去噪可插入逐步约束的特性，把“隐私保护后的语义统计量”转成可训练/可评测的合成语料。对数据侧的启发是：隐私机制与数据表示强相关；对建模侧的启发是：非自回归扩散式生成在“全局条件约束 + 离散输出”场景下更自然，可能成为隐私合成数据、数据去毒、抗记忆化等问题的一个通用接口。
summary.technical_approach: 方法主线是“语义空间做隐私 + 扩散 LM 做条件解码”。(1) 先把真实文本映射到连续语义嵌入（论文动机是语义流形低维、距离更有意义），然后在该空间上接入现成的 DP 聚类/聚合机制，得到带隐私保证的语义原型/语义分布表征；并强调 DP 的后处理不变性：只要后续生成仅依赖这些 DP 输出，最终合成文本仍继承 DP 保证。(2) 生成端选用 masked diffusion language model（逐步从噪声/掩码状态恢复整句 token），并在采样过程中引入“Guided Diffusion”：在每个去噪步，用一个语义一致性目标把当前离散序列的语义表示拉向目标嵌入/目标簇中心，从而实现全局语义对齐。(3) 为了让连续语义指导信号真正影响离散 token 采样，提出两类关键操作：semantic-aware sampling（在采样/选 token 时显式考虑语义距离或语义得分，避免仅按 DLM 局部概率贪心导致语义漂移）与 semantic-aware re-masking（在迭代过程中优先重新掩码那些对语义偏差贡献大的位置，让后续步有机会“纠偏”，而不是把早期错误锁死）。(4) 框架不仅兼容 DP，也扩展到 DSI（Data-Specific Indistinguishability）聚合：把风险从“单样本隐私”拓展到“对污染源/记忆化的形式化抑制”，本质仍是先在语义统计量层面做可证明的稳健/隐私处理，再通过扩散解码生成文本。
summary.experiments: 全文声称在两个数据集、两种 diffusion backbone 上评估，比较对象包括 Private Evolution 与 DP-SGD 训练的生成模型。结论层面：在相同或可比隐私预算下，Guided Diffusion 的分布保真与下游任务效用更好，同时生成速度显著快于 Private Evolution；相对 DP-SGD 路线，输出更连贯、重复更少。论文还强调其优势来自“把噪声放在语义空间而非词表空间”以及“扩散采样过程可逐步施加语义约束”。但你给到的全文片段未包含具体表格与数值（如 epsilon/delta、下游准确率提升幅度、生成吞吐等），因此这里无法可靠复述精确数字；精读时需要直接核对实验章节的隐私预算设置、utility 指标（例如下游分类/检索/困惑度或分布距离）以及速度对比的测量口径。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“动机—保证—算法细节—实验口径”走：
1) Introduction 里关于“词表空间高方差导致 DP 噪声灾难”的论证，是整篇文章的立论点。
2) Preliminaries 里确认他们用的 DLM 具体是哪一类（masked DLM / D3PM 变体等）、去噪/重掩码的定义与符号。
3) 方法章节重点看 semantic-aware sampling 与 semantic-aware re-masking 的具体实现：语义得分怎么计算（用哪个 encoder、是否可微、是否做近似）、如何与 token 概率融合、重掩码策略如何决定位置与比例。
4) 隐私部分要核对 DP/DSI 的“接口边界”：DP 聚类/聚合输出是什么（簇中心、直方图、混合权重？），以及他们如何严格使用后处理不变性把保证传递到最终文本。
5) 实验部分优先看：隐私预算-效用曲线、与 Private Evolution 的速度/质量对比、以及消融（去掉 guidance / 去掉 re-masking / 换语义 encoder）来验证增益来源。预计 30–45 分钟可完成有效泛读，若要复现或迁移到自家语料，需要精读算法细节与隐私会计设置。

summary_en.core_problem: How to generate synthetic text with formal privacy guarantees (DP/DSI) while retaining high utility (fluency, semantic fidelity, downstream performance). The paper pinpoints a practical bottleneck: applying DP noise in discrete vocabulary space requires overly large perturbations because semantically similar sentences can be far apart in one-hot/token space. Moving privacy mechanisms to a compact semantic embedding space improves the privacy–utility trade-off, but then requires a robust way to decode privatized continuous embeddings back into coherent discrete text.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution for pretraining-oriented work is an actionable pipeline for privacy-preserving data reuse: privatize/aggregate in semantic space using off-the-shelf DP clustering/aggregation, then decode via a controllable diffusion LM. Instead of forcing global conditioning into an autoregressive LM, it leverages diffusion LMs’ iterative denoising to inject semantic constraints step-by-step. This is relevant to pretraining data governance (private corpora, regulated domains), and also suggests a broader pattern: non-AR diffusion-style generation can be a convenient interface when you need global constraints, discrete outputs, and provable guarantees inherited via post-processing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework is “privacy in embedding space + guided diffusion decoding.” (1) Encode real text into continuous semantic embeddings; run DP clustering/aggregation in that space to obtain privatized semantic prototypes or a target semantic distribution. The DP guarantee is argued to carry over to the final synthetic text by DP’s post-processing property, as long as generation depends only on the DP outputs. (2) Use a masked diffusion language model that denoises a whole sequence in parallel. (3) Introduce Guided Diffusion: at each denoising step, steer the sampled discrete sequence toward the target semantic embedding by minimizing a semantic distance/score mismatch. (4) Two key mechanisms make continuous guidance effective for discrete sampling: semantic-aware sampling (bias token selection using a semantic alignment score, not just local token likelihood) and semantic-aware re-masking (re-mask positions that contribute most to semantic deviation so later steps can correct early mistakes). (5) The same interface is extended from DP to DSI aggregation, aiming at formal protection against corrupted sources and memorization, while keeping the generation stage as a post-processing step.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on two datasets and two diffusion backbones, comparing against Private Evolution and DP-SGD-based baselines. Claimed outcomes: better distributional fidelity and downstream utility under comparable privacy settings, with substantially faster generation than Private Evolution; and higher text quality than DP-SGD approaches (less repetition/incoherence). However, the provided full-text excerpt does not include the quantitative tables (privacy budgets, exact utility gains, throughput numbers), so exact figures cannot be reproduced here; verifying epsilon/delta accounting, utility metrics, and speed measurement protocol requires checking the experiment section directly.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path that preserves the key technical content:
1) Introduction: the argument that DP in token space is inherently high-variance and utility-destructive is the central motivation.
2) Preliminaries: confirm the exact DLM variant (masked DLM / discrete diffusion) and how masking/denoising steps are defined.
3) Method: focus on the concrete implementation of semantic-aware sampling and semantic-aware re-masking—how semantic scores are computed (which encoder, differentiability/approximation), how they are combined with token probabilities, and how re-masking selects positions/ratios.
4) Privacy section: check what DP mechanism is used in embedding space (what is released: cluster centers, histograms, mixture weights) and how the post-processing argument is formalized.
5) Experiments: prioritize privacy–utility curves, speed comparisons vs Private Evolution, and ablations (no guidance / no re-masking / different semantic encoders). Expect ~30–45 minutes for a solid skim; deeper reading is needed if you plan to reproduce or adapt the privacy accounting and the guidance mechanics.

recommendation.zh: 值得看隐私证明和 re-masking 细节；DP 只压 embedding 的假设很关键，utility 结论先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the privacy proof and re-masking details; the DP-on-embeddings assumption is the crux, and the utility claims should be treated as a weak signal until baselines are checked.

paper.title: From Stories to Features: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment & Interpretability
paper.abstract: We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model a

summary.core_problem: 如何在不依赖 SAE 这类“全量字典学习”的前提下，规模化获得“可解释、可泛化、可因果干预”的概念方向（feature vectors），并把它们做成可复用的对齐/安全概念字典，用于监测与 steering。
summary.importance:
对预训练本身不是 recipe 级贡献，但对“可控性/可解释性作为训练信号与诊断工具”很实用：
1) 给出一条成本很低、可并行扩展的 feature extraction 管线，把差分均值（difference-in-means）从“少量概念手工配对”扩展到千级概念；
2) 释放了 2M 级别、跨语言/跨体裁的合成对比语料，可作为后续做 representation probing、steering、甚至做安全相关 continual pretrain / mid-train 数据的原材料；
3) 通过跨模型验证与多场景 case study，提供了“哪些层更可干预、向量需要多少样本收敛、格式敏感性”等工程可用的经验结论。
局限也明确：概念由生成模型定义，存在 generator bias；差分方向依赖“对立概念如何写”，不是客观原子特征；更像对齐概念的工具箱，而不是对预训练机制的闭环解释。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 difference-in-means 的数据瓶颈替换成“可控的合成对比故事”。关键设计点：
- 原子单位是 concept–antagonist pair，而不是单个 concept。作者强调同一概念对不同反概念会得到不同方向，因此用“一句话 dichotomy guidance”来固定语义边界。
- 合成数据的覆盖面用来换泛化：每个 pair 交叉 5 种语言（英/中/俄/西/德）、10 种体裁（叙事/对话/新闻/备忘录等）、10 个 setup，并用两个生成器（Qwen3-235B-A22B 与 Deepseek-v4-flash）生成 matched stories。生成时先出共享 setup，再分别写正/反两篇，尽量保证除概念极性外其余因素一致。
- 向量提取：对每个概念对，在指定模型、指定层（或层集合）上取激活均值差（正极均值 − 反极均值），得到 feature vector；用它做 probing（投影打分）与 steering（在激活上加方向）。
- 验证思路强调“超出合成域”：不仅在合成故事上分离，还要在自然 chat/web 文本上能检测；并且要能因果 steering（加向量能稳定改变生成）。
- 额外做了工程性质的刻画：向量随样本数的收敛、对 prompt/格式的敏感性、跨模型几何结构是否共享、以及干预更有效的层位置（附录）。
整体取舍很清楚：放弃“发现模型全部原子特征”的雄心，转向“对齐相关概念的可用字典”，用合成对比数据把差分均值做成可规模化的工具。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见的关键实验与结论（数字以文中披露为准；当前给定内容未包含全部表格数值，因此只总结可确认部分）：
- 数据规模与成本：1,036 个概念对；2,072,000 篇 matched narratives（每对每极 1,000 篇）；覆盖 148 个概念类；5 语言×10 体裁×10 setup×2 生成器；总生成成本约 500 美元，约 0.48 美元/概念对。
- 模型覆盖：在 3 个模型家族的 6 个模型上抽取并验证向量（具体型号需看正文实验设置表）。
- 泛化验证：向量在自然 chat 与 web 文本中能检测对应概念（Sec 3.1），说明不是只记住合成分布。
- 因果性：几乎所有概念对都能通过 steering 稳定推动生成朝目标极性变化（Sec 3.2），这是比纯 probing 更强的证据。
- Case studies：
  1) coding agent 多轮 edit-test 循环中用字典分析/监测行为特征（Sec 4.1）；
  2) 在 GCG jailbreak 下，识别“安全方向漂移”，并通过反向 steering 抑制有害输出且不显著提高 benign refusal（Sec 4.2）；
  3) 长 CoT 推理中，正确/错误轨迹在“不确定性”等特征上可分离（Sec 4.3）。
- 消融/诊断：样本数收敛、格式敏感性、跨模型几何、有效层位点等在 Sec 2.2 与附录给出，属于复现与落地时最有用的部分。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先级：
- 先看 Sec 2.1–2.2：概念对如何定义、matched story 如何生成、difference-in-means 在哪一层/如何聚合激活——这是方法可复现的关键。
- 再看 Sec 3.1–3.2：两类验证（自然文本检测 + steering 因果干预）决定这套字典是不是“只在合成域好看”。
- 最后挑一个你关心的应用读 Sec 4：如果做安全/红队，重点是 GCG 场景；如果做 agent，重点是多轮循环；如果做推理机制分析，重点是 CoT 轨迹对比。
- 附录建议按需精读：格式敏感性、跨模型几何、有效层（App F.*）对工程落地很关键。预计 45–90 分钟可抓住主线；要复现与扩展需要把附录也读完。

summary_en.core_problem: How to scale up concept-aligned, human-interpretable feature directions in LLM activation space—while keeping them robust and causally usable (probing + steering)—without relying on SAEs or manual contrastive data collection per concept.
summary_en.importance:
Not a pretraining-recipe paper, but practically relevant to pretrain researchers as a diagnostics/control layer:
- Turns the difference-in-means baseline into a scalable pipeline by replacing hand-curated contrastive corpora with controlled synthetic matched stories.
- Releases a large synthetic contrastive dataset (2M narratives, multilingual + multi-genre) that can be reused for representation studies, safety monitoring, and potentially as raw material for mid-train/continual-pretrain data.
- Provides engineering-facing characterization (sample complexity for convergence, format sensitivity, effective intervention layers, cross-model geometry).
Main caveats: the “concept space” is defined by generator prompts and antagonists (generator bias + framing dependence). These vectors are best viewed as a safety/alignment concept toolbox, not ground-truth atomic features of the model.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A scaled difference-in-means recipe built on synthetic matched narratives:
- The atomic unit is a concept–antagonist pair, fixed by a one-sentence dichotomy guidance (because a concept’s direction depends on what it is contrasted against).
- Data generation is designed for generalization: for each of 1,036 pairs, generate matched story pairs across 5 languages, 10 genres, 10 setups, using two independent generator models. Generation first produces a shared setup, then writes the positive/negative story from that same setup to control confounders.
- Vector extraction: for a chosen model and layer(s), compute the mean activation for positive vs. negative stories and take their difference as the feature vector.
- Validation goes beyond the synthetic domain: (i) detection on natural chat/web text, and (ii) causal steering by adding the vector to activations.
- Additional analyses quantify convergence vs. number of stories, sensitivity to formatting, shared geometry across models, and which layers are most effective for interventions (main text + appendices).
summary_en.experiments:
Key results and evidence (only what is directly supported by the provided full-text excerpt; detailed benchmark numbers likely sit in the missing tables/figures):
- Scale/cost: 1,036 concept pairs; 2,072,000 matched narratives (1,000 per pole per pair); 148 concept classes; 5 languages × 10 genres × 10 setups × 2 generators; ~US$500 total generation cost (~$0.48 per pair).
- Model coverage: vectors extracted and tested on 6 models across 3 families.
- Out-of-domain generalization: vectors detect target concepts in natural chat and web text (Sec. 3.1).
- Causal usefulness: steering works for almost every concept pair (Sec. 3.2), indicating the directions are not merely correlational probes.
- Case studies: coding-agent multi-step loops (Sec. 4.1), GCG jailbreak mitigation via counter-steering without inflating benign refusals (Sec. 4.2), and CoT trajectory analysis where correct vs. incorrect reasoning differs in uncertainty-related features (Sec. 4.3).
- Diagnostics/ablations: convergence with story count, format sensitivity, cross-model geometry, and effective intervention layers (Sec. 2.2 + App. F.*).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
1) Sec. 2.1–2.2 for the exact data generation controls and the extraction details (layer choice, activation aggregation).
2) Sec. 3.1–3.2 for the two validations that matter: natural-text detection and causal steering.
3) Pick one Sec. 4 case study aligned with your work (agent loops / jailbreaks / CoT).
4) Appendices (esp. App. F.*) are worth targeted reading if you plan to reproduce or extend: they contain the practical knobs (sample size, formatting, layer selection, cross-model transfer). ~45–90 minutes to get the main ideas; longer if you want to operationalize it.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它对“定向构造概念方向是否比 SAE 更实用”给了可操作答案；先看方法定义和跨模型泛化，别急着相信所有 steering 结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it gives a practical answer to whether targeted concept vectors beat broad SAE-style recovery; read the construction and cross-model generalization first, and treat the steering claims with some caution.
