- Main findings: (i) the benefit of the correct reference depends on teacher mode, model size, and dataset; (ii) students can improve without the correct reference; (iii) references from other problems can outperform the correct one on several math benchmarks; (iv) student changes align more with the base model’s thinking-mode behavior than with reference-induced supervision; (v) control contexts reproduce much of the alignment, and stronger reference-attributable alignment does not reliably imply larger performance gains.
The excerpt does not include exact score deltas; the most important artifacts in the full paper are the condition-by-condition performance tables and the alignment-over-training plots.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the Introduction for the three questions and the key experimental control (student fixed non-thinking).
- Read the Analysis Framework carefully until the D_ref/D_rec/D_tot decomposition and alignment metrics are fully clear.
- Then jump to the main results tables (teacher mode × reference condition) and the alignment/control figures.
Time: ~30–45 minutes for understanding; add ~30 minutes if you want to re-derive/implement the metrics.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 self-distillation 中一个反直觉现象：用错的 reference 甚至不相关的 reference 也能涨点，说明 OPSD 更多是激活 base model 的内在能力而非注入新知识，对合成数据构造有直接指导意义。
recommendation.en: Reveals a counter-intuitive phenomenon in self-distillation: using incorrect or even irrelevant references can still improve performance, suggesting OPSD primarily activates the base model's intrinsic capabilities rather than injecting new knowledge, offering direct guidance for synthetic data construction.

paper.title: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis
paper.abstract: Training terminal agents requires scalable executable supervision, yet synthesizing high-quality terminal tasks remains challenging. Each task couples an instruction, an initialized environment, a reference solution, and an executable verifier; if these artifacts are generated from inconsistent assumptions, the resulting task may be unsolvable or incorrectly evaluated. Meanwhile, multi-stage synthesis can discard the goals, dependencies, state transitions, and procedural constraints encoded in t

summary.core_problem: 面向 terminal agent 训练时，如何自动合成 instruction、初始环境、参考解法和可执行 verifier 彼此一致的任务。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 后训练数据/监督构造方法。它关注 executable supervision 的质量控制，重点不在模型结构，而在减少合成任务中常见的不可解、误判和状态不一致问题。
summary.technical_approach: FACET 先把相关 agent skills 重构为信息更完整的场景，再实现并修复可执行环境，最后生成任务指令、参考方案和 verifier。核心设计是让容器状态成为 instruction、solution、verifier 的共享 grounding，并用执行验证闭环修复跨 artifact 不一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量、baseline 或提升幅度。可确认的实验方向应是对合成 terminal tasks 的可解性、verifier 正确性、agent 训练或评测效果进行执行级验证。
summary.authors_note: 上海人工智能实验室；从题目和摘要看，团队关注 terminal agent 的可执行任务合成与训练数据质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to synthesize terminal-agent tasks whose instruction, initialized environment, reference solution, and executable verifier are mutually consistent.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training data and supervision construction contribution for agents. Its value is in executable task quality control rather than model architecture, targeting unsolvable tasks, incorrect verifiers, and inconsistent environment assumptions.
summary_en.technical_approach: FACET reconstructs related agent skills into coherent scenarios, realizes and repairs the execution environment, and then generates the final instruction, solution, and verifier. The key idea is to use the container state as shared grounding across all artifacts, with execution-based validation to repair inconsistencies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation focuses on task solvability, verifier correctness, and downstream terminal-agent training or evaluation under executable validation.
summary_en.authors_note: Shanghai AI Laboratory; the work appears centered on executable terminal-agent task synthesis and data quality.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为 agent 训练数据质检范式备查；预训练研究员看方法图和验证闭环即可，不必深读实验。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for agent training-data quality control; for pretraining work, skim the pipeline and executable validation loop only.

paper.title: LLMs Get Smarter from Targeted Synthetic Multilingual Data
paper.abstract: Language-specific competency (LSC) is the phenomenon of a language model performing better or worse depending on the language of the prompt. In other words, a language model outputs different (and potentially incorrect) responses to the same semantic query when prompted in different languages. Prior work attributes this to an internal misalignment of semantic representation across languages. Currently, there are two main approaches to address LSC in the literature: (1) routing all queries throug

summary.core_problem: 多语言 LLM 存在语言特异性能力差异（LSC），现有方案要么经英语路由损失表达性，要么语言均衡数据降低整体性能。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出以数据为中心的靶向合成数据框架 HOTFIXR，针对学生模型的多语言弱点生成训练数据，避免语言均衡训练的整体性能下降。
summary.technical_approach: 用教师模型探测学生模型在不同语言上的推理弱点，基于探测到的困难样本生成针对性的多语言训练数据，再用这些数据微调学生模型以缓解跨语言推理能力差异。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、数据量和量化提升幅度；核心验证目标是在不降低整体性能的前提下缩小跨语言性能差距。
summary.authors_note: Andreas Stolcke 为资深 NLP 研究者，曾在 SRI/微软从事语音与语言建模研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Multilingual LLMs exhibit language-specific competency (LSC), and existing fixes either route through English (losing expressivity) or use language-balanced data (hurting overall performance).
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a data-centric targeted synthetic data framework, HOTFIXR, that generates training data tailored to a student model's multilingual weaknesses without the tradeoffs of balanced training.
summary_en.technical_approach: A teacher model probes the student's reasoning weaknesses across languages, then targeted multilingual training data is generated from those hard cases and used to fine-tune the student, reducing cross-language performance gaps.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model sizes, data volumes, and quantitative gains are not provided in the abstract; the goal is to narrow cross-language performance gaps without degrading overall performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Andreas Stolcke is a senior NLP researcher with prior work at SRI and Microsoft on speech and language modeling.

recommendation.zh: 靶向合成数据补短板的思路对后训练数据策略有启发，但属于 SFT 层面的增量工作，对预训练数据配比设计参考有限。
recommendation.en: The idea of targeted synthetic data for weakness remediation is useful for post-training data strategy, but it is an incremental SFT-level work with limited implications for pretraining data mixture design.

paper.title: Ask, Condition or Abstain: Reinforcement Learning for Missing-Premise Reasoning
paper.abstract: Answer-only reinforcement learning (RL) trains reasoning models to solve fully specified problems, but many realistic queries omit a premise needed for a unique answer. In this setting, the useful response is not always refusal: the model should ask for the missing premise, condition its answer on the unknown quantity, or abstain when no informative conditional response is available. We present \emph{Ask-Condition-Abstain Reinforcement Learning} (ACA-RL), a data-augmented RL framework for this s

summary.core_problem: 现有仅针对答案的RL无法处理缺失前提的推理场景，模型需在追问、条件回答、拒绝三种行为间做合理选择。
summary.importance: 方法创新+Benchmark贡献，提出面向缺失前提推理的RL框架，并发布人工验证的评测集。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ACA-RL：先用推理图引导将良定义问题转换为带缺口标注的缺失前提样本，再用覆盖5种可观测响应行为的结构化奖励做RL训练。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3与Llama系列模型上验证，在274条人工验证的Missing-Premise Benchmark(MPB)上取得一致提升，同时保留通用推理能力。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学团队

summary_en.core_problem: Answer-only RL fails on reasoning queries with missing premises, where the model should choose among asking, conditional answering, or abstaining appropriately.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation plus benchmark contribution; proposes an RL framework for missing-premise reasoning and releases a human-verified evaluation set.
summary_en.technical_approach: ACA-RL first uses a reasoning-graph-guided pipeline to convert well-posed problems into missing-premise instances with localized gap annotations, then trains RL with a structured reward over five observable response behaviors.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3 and Llama families; shows consistent gains on the 274-instance human-verified Missing-Premise Benchmark (MPB) while preserving general reasoning ability.
summary_en.authors_note: Zhejiang University team

recommendation.zh: 奖励设计和数据合成pipeline有参考价值，核心看奖励定义部分即可，整体是特定场景的增量工作。
recommendation.en: The reward design and data synthesis pipeline are worth a quick look; focus on the reward definition section, overall an incremental work for a narrow scenario.

paper.title: ChainSpace: A Chained-Reasoning Paradigm for Spatial Intelligence
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence requires foundation models to maintain coherent spatial state across interactions with the physical world. However, existing data-centric approaches typically treat spatial reasoning as independent question-answer instances, enabling shortcut-based answering and providing limited supervision for persistent spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce ChainSpace, a chained-reasoning paradigm that structures spatial reasoning as a state-preserving multi-round process.

summary.core_problem: 现有空间智能数据把多轮空间问答当成相互独立的 QA 样本，模型可以靠常识先验、局部视觉线索或数据集规律走捷径答对单题，却没有在交互中维护一致的潜在空间状态，导致评测虚高、训练监督信号偏弱。
summary.importance: 对预训练的启发主要在数据构造与评测形态，而不是架构。它把空间推理从独立 QA 改成共享潜在状态的链式过程，用逻辑约束让后一轮问题依赖前几轮建立的空间约束，从而压缩捷径空间。这种“用样本结构制造更难的监督”的思路，对多模态预训练数据课程、轨迹式数据合成、一致性评测都有参考价值。但论文本身偏空间智能应用，对通用 LLM 基座的直接迁移有限，定为 skim。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ChainSpace 范式：给定视频或具身轨迹作为观测，多轮问题共享一个潜在空间状态 s_t，状态随每轮问答更新 s_t = Φ(s_{t-1}, x, q_t, a_t)，后续回答必须与前面建立的空间约束一致。评测侧构造 ChainSpace-Bench，人工标注真实场景多轮链式问题，并引入 Chain-Aware Metric，在单题准确率之外衡量整条链的一致性。训练侧给出 ChainSpace-Pipeline，从模拟器中的具身轨迹自动生成链式监督数据，而不是大规模采集真实世界 QA。核心区别在于：它不修改模型结构，而是通过数据的逻辑依赖结构和链级指标，迫使模型维护持久空间表示。
summary.experiments: ChainSpace-Bench 能暴露出单题准确率看不到的链式失败，即模型逐题看似答对，但跨轮空间关系不一致。训练侧仅使用约 50K 模拟器生成的链式样本，就在 ChainSpace-Bench 上取得开源模型中的最好表现，并超过使用数十万到数百万真实空间样本训练的模型；同时在多个外部空间智能 benchmark 上具有竞争力。具体模型名称、绝对分数和消融细节在提供的全文片段中不完整。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看 Introduction 中关于独立 QA 与链式状态的对比、Chained Spatial Intelligence 的形式化，以及 ChainSpace-Pipeline 如何从具身轨迹构造监督。若关注多模态数据合成，可进一步看 Chain-Aware Metric 的设计和 50K 样本实验。预计 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing spatial-intelligence data treats multi-round spatial questions as independent QA instances, allowing models to answer correctly through commonsense priors, local visual cues, or dataset regularities rather than maintaining a coherent latent spatial state across interactions.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly to multimodal data construction and evaluation rather than architecture. ChainSpace recasts spatial reasoning as a state-preserving chained process in which later questions depend on spatial constraints established earlier, making shortcut answering harder. The idea is useful for thinking about trajectory-based multimodal pretraining data, structured supervision, and consistency evaluation. Its direct transfer to general-purpose LLM pretraining is limited, so it is a skim.
summary_en.technical_approach: ChainSpace formulates multi-round spatial reasoning under a shared latent spatial state s_t, updated as s_t = Φ(s_{t-1}, x, q_t, a_t). Later answers must remain jointly consistent with constraints accumulated earlier. For evaluation, the authors build ChainSpace-Bench, a manually annotated real-world multi-round benchmark with a Chain-Aware Metric that measures chain-level consistency beyond per-question accuracy. For training, ChainSpace-Pipeline generates chained supervision from simulator-based embodied trajectories instead of collecting large-scale real-world QA. The model architecture is unchanged; the additional pressure comes from the logical structure of the data and the chain-level evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: ChainSpace-Bench reveals chain-level failures that isolated question accuracy misses. With about 50K simulator-generated chained samples, models trained with ChainSpace-Pipeline achieve the best open-source performance on ChainSpace-Bench, outperform spatial models trained with hundreds of thousands to millions of real-world samples, and transfer competitively to external spatial-intelligence benchmarks. Exact model names, absolute scores, and detailed ablations are not fully included in the available text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the contrast between independent QA and chained state in the introduction, the formalization of chained spatial intelligence, and the pipeline that converts embodied trajectories into chained supervision. Readers interested in multimodal data synthesis should also inspect the Chain-Aware Metric and the 50K-sample result. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 链式多轮空间推理的范式设计和数据构造思路对多模态推理训练有参考，重点看范式定义和bench构造部分。
recommendation.en: The chained multi-turn spatial reasoning paradigm and data design offer useful insights for multimodal reasoning training; focus on the paradigm definition and benchmark construction sections.

paper.title: SynWeaver: Website-Prior Task and Trajectory Co-Synthesis for Web Agents
paper.abstract: Web agents often struggle to generalize to unseen websites because they lack website-specific supervision. Recent exploration-based data synthesis methods reduce manual annotation, but they still face two key limitations: they often fail to cover the full functionality of a website, and without sufficient website prior knowledge, they tend to propose hallucinated tasks, which in turn limits the diversity and efficiency of downstream trajectory synthesis. We present \textbf{SynWeaver}, a website-

summary.core_problem: 现有Web智能体的数据合成方法存在两个核心缺陷：一是随机探索类方法覆盖率低、冗余交互多，无法覆盖网站全功能；二是缺乏网站先验知识，容易生成不可执行的幻觉任务，或为匹配轨迹把任务改写成过程化描述而非自然用户请求，导致合成数据的质量和多样性不足，限制下游Web智能体的跨网站泛化能力。
summary.importance: 提出以网站先验为核心的任务-轨迹联合合成范式，解决了Web智能体训练数据标注成本高、跨网站泛化差的痛点，合成数据的效率和质量均有明显提升，对通用智能体的环境感知先验注入、自监督训练数据合成方法有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: SynWeaver分为三个串联阶段：1）结构化网站探索：用基于DFS的爬虫构建网站功能拓扑图G=(S,T)，节点S为功能互异的页面状态（含截图和可访问性树），边T为可执行交互动作，避免随机游走的冗余探索，保证功能覆盖度；2）网站先验学习：从拓扑图中提取UI监督信号，微调得到具备网站特定知识的UI感知模型，让任务提议不再依赖局部页面观察，而是基于全局网站先验；3）任务-轨迹协同合成：用教师模型在执行过程中联合优化任务描述和执行前缀，一旦发现意图和执行不一致就同步修正，既保证任务是自然的用户请求形式，又保证轨迹可执行。
summary.experiments: 在WebArena和WebVoyager两个基准上验证：仅用从网站拓扑图合成的822条经过验证的任务-轨迹对，在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct和InternVL3-8B两个基座上均取得WebArena最优的整体成功率；在WebVoyager上达到27.06%的成功率，比最强基线高出4.64个百分点；消融实验验证了结构化网站探索、UI感知先验、联合修正三个模块的必要性，相比随机游走探索冗余交互大幅降低，任务可行性和自然度均有提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节的三阶段方法框架和图1的流程图，以及第4节的主实验和消融结果，预计阅读时间20-25分钟；从事智能体数据合成或环境先验建模的研究者可细读网站拓扑图构建的具体规则和联合修正的prompt设计部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing data synthesis methods for web agents have two core limitations: first, random exploration-based approaches have low functional coverage and high redundant interaction, failing to capture the full scope of a target website; second, lack of website-specific priors leads to hallucinated infeasible tasks, or forces task descriptions to be rewritten as procedural step lists to match collected trajectories instead of retaining natural user request form, reducing synthesized data quality and diversity and limiting downstream cross-website generalization.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a website-prior centered task-trajectory co-synthesis paradigm that addresses the high annotation cost and poor cross-website generalization pain points of web agent training. The method improves both efficiency and quality of synthesized training data, and offers a useful reference for environment prior injection and self-supervised training data synthesis for general-purpose agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: SynWeaver runs in three sequential stages: 1) Structured website exploration: a DFS-based crawler constructs a functional website topology graph G=(S,T), where nodes S represent functionally distinct page states (paired with screenshots and accessibility trees) and edges T represent executable interactions, eliminating redundant traversal common in random walks while ensuring full functional coverage; 2) Website prior learning: UI supervision signals extracted from the topology graph are used to fine-tune a UI-aware model, so task proposals are grounded in global website knowledge rather than only local page observations; 3) Collaborative task-trajectory synthesis: a teacher model jointly refines task descriptions and execution prefixes during rollout, correcting mismatches between intent and execution in real time to preserve natural user request form while ensuring trajectory executability.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on WebArena and WebVoyager benchmarks: using only 822 validated task-trajectory pairs synthesized from website topology graphs, it achieves the best overall WebArena success rate on both Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and InternVL3-8B base models; on WebVoyager, it reaches a 27.06% success rate, 4.64 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Ablation studies confirm the necessity of all three modules. Compared to random-walk exploration, redundant interactions are significantly reduced, and both task feasibility and naturalness improve.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skim reading, focus on the three-stage framework in Section 3, the flow diagram in Figure 1, and the main experimental + ablation results in Section 4, with an estimated reading time of 20-25 minutes. Researchers working on agent data synthesis or environment prior modeling may deep-dive into the specific rules for website topology construction and the prompt design for collaborative refinement.

recommendation.zh: Web Agent训练数据合成的实用方法，重点看网站地图构建与任务生成约束模块，可迁移到通用Agent轨迹合成场景
recommendation.en: Practical method for web agent training data synthesis; focus on site map construction and task generation constraints, transferable to general agent trajectory synthesis scenarios

paper.title: Yesterday's Shield, Today's Spear: A Self-Evolving Safety Guardrail in Production
paper.abstract: Deployed LLM safety guardrails are predominantly static: trained once and frozen at release, while new jailbreak techniques and previously un-addressed harmful categories emerge within days, leaving the defense perpetually a step behind. We present SESG (Self-Evolving Safety Guardrails), a multi-agent system running in production. SESG monitors the live traffic behind a deployed guardrail and surfaces two classes of failure: jailbreaks novel in form and harmful categories novel in content. Once

summary.core_problem: 解决线上 LLM 安全护栏在新型 jailbreak 和新增有害类别面前更新滞后的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练与安全系统创新。它把线上失败样本、合成训练数据、验证筛选和版本路由闭成一个持续演化回路，比一次性训练后冻结的 guardrail 更贴近真实部署压力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SESG，一个生产环境中的多 Agent 安全护栏演化系统。监控 Agent 从真实流量中发现两类失败：形式新颖的 jailbreak 和内容新颖的 harmful category；生成 Agent 合成针对性正负配对训练数据；验证 Agent 按当前模型错误方向重加权 batch；路由 Agent 根据诊断缺口选择训练动作并推送下一版本。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在六轮线上演化中从 V0 更新到 V6，一个 1.7B guardrail 能在 16-24 小时内适应新威胁，人工投入约 2 小时。由于摘要截断，完整 baseline、误杀率、漏检率和每轮数据规模需要看正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lag of deployed LLM safety guardrails when new jailbreak forms and harmful-content categories appear after release.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training and production safety loop: live failures are turned into targeted data, validated, routed to an update action, and redeployed. This is more operationally relevant than a frozen guardrail trained once before launch.
summary_en.technical_approach: SESG is a multi-agent production system. A monitoring component detects novel jailbreak formats and novel harmful categories from live traffic; a generation agent synthesizes paired training examples; a validation agent rebalances batches toward the deployed model’s observed error direction; and a routing agent selects the proper update path and returns the next guardrail version to production.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports six live evolution rounds from V0 to V6. A 1.7B guardrail adapts to a new threat within 16-24 hours with roughly two hours of human effort. Full baselines, false-positive tradeoffs, data sizes, and per-round metrics require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 值得看系统闭环而不是模型结构；重点读线上失败如何变成训练 batch，离线安全论文常避开这个脏问题。
recommendation.en: Read it for the production feedback loop, not the model; the useful part is how live failures become training batches, a messy detail many safety papers skip.

paper.title: Beyond "AI Language": The case for the idiolectal nature of LLM output
paper.abstract: While large language model outputs are frequently analysed as a collective super variety termed "AI language," this chapter argues that this perspective coexists with distinct, model-specific linguistic signatures akin to human idiolects. We analyse two datasets of LLM-generated texts on societal topics: a 2024 corpus of six models (Improta et al. 2024) and a newly generated 2026 corpus using the same prompts featuring six contemporary models. Our findings, utilising computational descriptors an

summary.core_problem: 检验“AI language”作为统一文体的说法是否过度简化：不同LLM是否存在稳定、可识别的模型特异语言风格（类似人类idiolect）。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是语言学/风格计量分析：给出跨代模型（2024 vs 2026）与同代不同模型的风格差异证据；对预训练研究的价值在于提醒“模型输出分布”可被风格特征强烈区分，可能影响数据合成、蒸馏与水印/溯源。
summary.technical_approach: 基于两套LLM生成文本语料（同一提示集、不同年份模型），用计算语言学描述符与stylometric PCA做聚类/区分；用缩写（contractions）频率等可解释特征展示模型间差异与代际漂移。
summary.experiments: 使用Improta et al. 2024 的六模型语料+作者新生成的2026六模型语料；报告缩写频率在同一cohort内可从约1,200到30,000 per million words的巨大跨度，并观察到2024与2026 cohort 的整体风格漂移；未见与训练配方/数据的因果归因实验（摘要层面）。

summary_en.core_problem: Test whether treating LLM outputs as a single “AI language” is an oversimplification by measuring stable, model-specific linguistic signatures akin to idiolects.
summary_en.importance: A stylometric/mechanistic analysis contribution: shows both cohort-level drift (2024 vs 2026) and persistent model-specific signatures; relevant to pretraining mainly as a caution for synthetic data, distillation, and provenance/watermarking assumptions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Use computational linguistic descriptors and stylometric PCA on two prompt-matched corpora of LLM-generated texts; highlight interpretable features such as contraction frequency to separate models and cohorts.
summary_en.experiments: Six-model corpus from 2024 (Improta et al. 2024) plus a newly generated six-model 2026 corpus; contraction frequency ranges from ~1,200 to ~30,000 per million words within the 2026 cohort; limited causal linkage to training data/recipes in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 结论不直接指导训练，但对“合成数据会不会把某个模型口音蒸馏进来”是个提醒；只看特征统计和PCA图即可。
recommendation.en: Not a training recipe paper, but a useful reminder that synthetic data can carry strong model “accents”; skim the feature stats and PCA plots.

paper.title: CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks
paper.abstract: Training terminal agents requires executable and verifiable tasks that are not merely solvable, but appropriately challenging for learning. Executable validation establishes feasibility, yet does not reveal how a task behaves relative to a given solver setting. In this paper, we present CalibForge, an autonomous terminal-task synthesis system that uses verified solver behavior to revise candidate tasks through adversarial solver calibration. Multi-solver calibration targets disagreement within a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的不是“如何生成可执行 terminal 任务”，而是更难的一层：如何把任务构造成对某一类求解器来说“可学但不平庸”的训练样本。仅靠 executable validation 只能证明任务能跑、能验收，不能判断它对当前 agent 是太简单、太难，还是刚好处在能提供学习信号的区间。CalibForge 把这个问题形式化为 solver-relative learnable zone：任务必须被至少一个求解器真实解出，同时又不能被目标 solver 设定下全部轻松解出。论文的核心是在任务合成阶段引入基于 solver 行为的多轮对抗式校准，让“任务难度是否合适”从事后经验判断，变成可观测、可操作、可迭代优化的构造目标。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在训练数据构造，而不是 agent 应用本身。它给出的关键信号是：对于可验证环境任务，数据质量不应只看正确性和多样性，还应看相对于训练中模型能力的“可学习性带宽”。这和预训练里的 data curriculum、difficulty shaping、self-play data generation 有直接对应关系。论文贡献的量级不在新模型结构，而在提出了一种更细粒度的数据筛选与修订机制：不是简单保留 solved/unsolved 样本，而是利用强弱 solver 的差异、失败轨迹和多轮重写，把任务推向更有监督密度的区域。对做代码 agent、tool-use、terminal interaction 数据合成的人，这个思路是实用的；对更广义的 pretrain/post-train 接口研究，它也提示了一个方向：训练数据的价值取决于模型相对能力，而不是静态标签质量。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，CalibForge 是一个从 clue 出发的自动任务合成系统，但真正的创新不在 authoring pipeline 本身，而在后面的 adversarial solver calibration。流程大致分四步。第一步，authoring agent 在 draft sandbox 中做外部调研，查官方文档、GitHub issue、Stack Overflow 等，寻找具体且可复现的工程问题，例如版本冲突、配置陷阱、依赖 bug、边界条件。第二步，它联合生成任务说明、执行环境和验证测试，并做结构校验与 self-solving，确保候选任务至少是可执行、可验证、可被系统自身完成的。第三步，进入校准环节。论文给了两种校准准则。multi-solver calibration 追求异构 solver 池中的分歧，即至少一个成功、至少一个失败；contrastive solver calibration 则更强，要求指定的强 solver 通过、弱 solver 失败。两者都把“可学区间”定义成 solver 相对关系，而不是绝对难度分数。第四步，如果当前候选不满足目标行为模式，authoring agent 不只是微调 wording，而是可以回到外部研究、重写任务方向、修改环境、测试和约束，再重新验证和 probing，直到满足条件或达到最大轮数。

这里有两个值得注意的设计。其一，反馈信号不只用 pass/fail，还用完整 trajectory。这样 authoring agent 能根据失败原因去改任务，例如减少偶然性、强化目标约束、修正环境噪声，或者反过来引入更能区分强弱 solver 的关键步骤。其二，论文强调“constrained adversarial”：作者代理在对抗地改任务，但 retention criterion 始终要求至少存在真实成功解，因此不会把任务推向纯粹刁钻或不可解的方向。和只用单一 solver 打分、或者只做一次 authoring+validation 的方法相比，这里多了一层基于行为证据的闭环修订。这个区别很重要，因为 learnability 不是任务初稿的静态属性，而是可以通过重写被主动塑形的。
summary.experiments:
实验最有信息量的部分有三块。第一块是校准本身是否必要。论文指出，进入 contrastive calibration 的候选任务都已经通过结构验证和 self-solving，但初始时只有 19% 满足“强通过、弱失败”的目标关系；经过多轮 revision 和 re-probing，累计接受率提升到 96%。这说明 executable validity 与 solver-relative learnability 之间有明显缺口，而且这个缺口可以通过行为驱动的重写显著缩小。

第二块是不同数据构造策略对下游 agent 训练的影响。作者构建了 5,431 个校准后的 terminal tasks，并比较了几种训练数据来源：仅 authoring+validation、单 solver 反馈、多 solver calibration、contrastive calibration。Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，authoring+validation 只有 22.47%，单 solver 反馈 24.34%，multi-solver calibration 提升到 29.21%，contrastive calibration 31.09%。这里的提升不是边际噪声，而是相对清晰地说明：只知道任务“能做”不够，知道“谁能做、谁做不好”更有训练价值。

第三块是用完整校准数据训练模型后的结果。CalibForge-30B-A3B 和 CalibForge-35B-A3B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上分别达到 32.58% 和 47.57%，比最强 baseline 高 6.36 和 6.75 个百分点。更关键的是泛化：35B 模型在 SWE-bench Pro 上 44.32%，在 Doc2Repo 上 48.77%，都是同 backbone 下所比较训练数据源里最好的结果。这个结果支持一个判断：校准得到的不是只对合成任务有效的“刷榜数据”，而是更接近真实软件工程交互中有效 supervision 的数据分布。

从消融角度，最值得注意的是 single-solver feedback 与 multi/contrastive calibration 的差距。它说明单一 solver 的成功或失败信号太粗，容易把任务推向该 solver 的局部偏好，而多 solver 分歧或强弱对比能提供更稳定的难度定位信号。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只花一小时，先看 Introduction 里对 learnable zone 的定义，再看 Methodology 中 Figure 2、Algorithm 1，把 author–solver loop 的控制流理清。随后重点看两类 calibration criterion：multi-solver 和 contrastive。这里决定了任务被保留的逻辑，也决定了这篇工作的真正贡献不只是“自动出题”，而是“按 solver 相对能力塑形数据”。

实验部分建议先抓三张信息最密的结果：一是初始候选满足 contrastive relation 的比例与多轮修订后的累计接受率；二是不同数据构造策略在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上的对比；三是用 5,431 个任务训练后的 30B/35B 结果及其在 SWE-bench Pro、Doc2Repo 上的迁移表现。读到这里，基本就能判断这套方法是否只是 task-generation 工程，还是确实改变了训练信号质量。

值得深挖的点有三个。第一，revision 是如何利用 trajectory 的，失败模式是否被系统性归纳成可操作的编辑策略。第二，solver pool 的组成如何影响 learnable zone 的形状；如果强弱模型差距太小或太大，校准是否会退化。第三，这套方法能否迁移到更一般的数据合成场景，例如代码补全、tool-use、web agent，甚至 masked/AR 预训练中的 difficulty-aware sampling。若做复现，先不要急着复刻全系统，先验证“多 solver 分歧筛选”相对“单 solver 通过率筛选”的增益是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about generating executable terminal tasks. It targets a harder problem: how to synthesize tasks that are learnable for a given solver regime, rather than merely valid, trivial, or effectively impossible. Executable validation only tells you that a task can run and be checked. It does not tell you whether the task sits in a useful difficulty band for training. CalibForge formalizes this as a solver-relative learnable zone: a retained task must be demonstrably solvable by at least one solver, yet not uniformly solved under the target solver setting. The central contribution is to make this property observable and editable during data construction through an adversarial author–solver loop.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is primarily on the data side of foundation-model training, not on agent deployment. The main lesson is that for executable environments, data quality should not be judged only by correctness or diversity. It should also be judged by learnability relative to model capability. That connects directly to curriculum design, difficulty shaping, and self-play style data generation. The contribution is not a new model family. It is a more informative data filtering and revision mechanism: instead of keeping solved or unsolved tasks, it uses solver disagreement, strong-vs-weak relations, and failure trajectories to push tasks into a region with denser learning signal. For code agents and tool-use training, this is practically useful. For the broader pretrain–post-train interface, it suggests that data value is capability-relative rather than a static property of labels.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CalibForge starts from a clue and builds a terminal task automatically, but the real novelty is the adversarial solver calibration stage after initial authoring. The pipeline has four main parts. First, an authoring agent works in a draft sandbox with web search, shell execution, and file editing. It researches concrete engineering issues from documentation, GitHub repositories and issues, and Stack Overflow, looking for reproducible problems such as dependency conflicts, version-specific bugs, configuration pitfalls, and edge cases. Second, it jointly writes the task instruction, execution environment, and verification tests, then performs structural validation and self-solving so the candidate is executable, checkable, and solvable by the system itself.

Third, the candidate enters calibration. The paper defines two retention criteria. Multi-solver calibration seeks disagreement in a heterogeneous solver pool: at least one solver must pass and at least one must fail. Contrastive calibration is stricter: a designated stronger solver must pass while a designated weaker solver must fail. In both cases, learnability is defined relationally, not by an absolute difficulty score. Fourth, if the criterion is not met, the authoring agent revises the task and revalidates it before another probing round. Importantly, revision is not limited to wording tweaks. The agent may revisit external research, change the technical direction, rewrite the environment, modify tests, or alter constraints.

Two design choices matter. First, the feedback includes not only verified pass/fail outcomes but also full trajectories. That gives the authoring agent actionable evidence about why a task failed or succeeded, which can be used to reduce noise, sharpen constraints, or introduce steps that better separate strong and weak solvers. Second, the loop is adversarial but constrained: retention always requires at least one real successful solve, so the system does not drift toward pathological or unsolvable tasks. Compared with one-shot authoring plus validation, or with single-solver scoring, this adds a behavior-driven revision loop. That is the key difference, because learnability is treated as something that can be actively shaped rather than passively measured.
summary_en.experiments:
The most informative results come in three layers. First, calibration is clearly necessary. All candidates entering contrastive calibration have already passed structural validation and self-solving, yet only 19% initially satisfy the target strong-pass/weak-fail relation. After iterative revision and re-probing, cumulative acceptance rises to 96%. This shows that executable validity and solver-relative learnability are far from equivalent, and that the gap can be closed by behavior-guided rewriting.

Second, the paper compares training data produced by different construction strategies. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, authoring plus validation alone yields 22.47% accuracy. Adding single-solver feedback gives 24.34%. Multi-solver calibration reaches 29.21%, and contrastive calibration reaches 31.09%. The gain is large enough to support a clear interpretation: knowing that a task is solvable is not enough; knowing which solvers succeed and which fail provides substantially better supervision.

Third, the authors train on the full set of 5,431 calibrated tasks. CalibForge-30B-A3B and CalibForge-35B-A3B obtain 32.58% and 47.57% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, outperforming the strongest baselines by 6.36 and 6.75 points. The transfer results matter even more. The 35B model reaches 44.32% on SWE-bench Pro and 48.77% on Doc2Repo, the best among the compared training-data sources for the same backbone. That suggests the calibrated tasks are not merely overfit synthetic exercises; they appear to induce supervision that transfers to broader software-engineering settings.

The ablation that stands out is the gap between single-solver feedback and multi-solver or contrastive calibration. A single solver provides a coarse signal and can bias task construction toward that solver’s idiosyncrasies. Solver disagreement and strong-vs-weak contrast provide a more stable handle on difficulty placement.
summary_en.reading_guide:
If time is limited, start with the Introduction sections that define the solver-relative learnable zone, then read the methodology around Figure 2 and Algorithm 1 to understand the control flow of the author–solver loop. After that, focus on the two calibration criteria, multi-solver and contrastive. Those sections contain the real contribution. Without them, the system would be just another task-generation pipeline.

In the experiments, prioritize three result blocks. First, the fraction of initially authored tasks that already satisfy the contrastive relation versus the cumulative acceptance after revision rounds. Second, the comparison among authoring-only, single-solver feedback, multi-solver calibration, and contrastive calibration on Terminal-Bench 2.0. Third, the final 30B and 35B training results and their transfer to SWE-bench Pro and Doc2Repo. Those are the results that tell you whether the method changes supervision quality rather than just producing more tasks.

Three deeper questions are worth following while reading. How exactly are trajectories converted into revision actions? How sensitive is the learnable zone to the composition of the solver pool? And can this idea generalize beyond terminal tasks to code completion, tool-use, web agents, or even difficulty-aware sampling in broader pretraining settings? For reproduction, it would be sensible to test the value of multi-solver disagreement filtering before rebuilding the full authoring system.

recommendation.zh: 做agent后训练数据合成的研究员重点看§3的两种校准策略，难度控制方法可迁移到数学/代码等其他任务合成场景
recommendation.en: For agent post-training data synthesis researchers, focus on §3 two calibration strategies; difficulty control methods transfer to math/code task synthesis scenarios

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: PRISM: Priority-aware Rubric Internalization via Structured Multimodal Data Synthesis
paper.abstract: Real-world multimodal instructions often bundle multiple requirements with unequal importance, yet most multimodal training data still reduce instruction following to answering one self-contained question. We study this gap through \textbf{rubric comprehension}, which casts the model not as a generator measured against rubrics but as an \textbf{executor} that follows them: given an image and a typed, prioritized rubric, the model must verify each rule before producing an overall judgment. To sup

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在多要求、不同优先级的真实多模态指令中，难以按 rubric 逐条验证并给出整体判断的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态后训练数据合成和评测设计；它把模型从“回答单个问题”转向“执行带优先级规则”，对 instruction-following 数据格式有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PRISM 四阶段合成流程：生成 persona-task pairs、用 prefix 引导规则集、过滤 rubric 质量、生成结构化 verification traces；同时构建 PRISM-Eval，用 Loose 和 Strict 两类基于固定标签的 deterministic matching，避免推理时再调用 judge model。
summary.experiments: 使用 10K 合成样本训练后，Qwen3-VL-4B 在 PRISM-Eval 上 Strict accuracy 从 9.5% 提升到 30.1%；摘要称同时保持原有能力，但未给出完整 baseline、训练超参或更大模型扩展结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets multimodal instructions that contain multiple requirements with unequal priorities, asking a VLM to verify each rubric rule before making an overall judgment.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is multimodal post-training data synthesis plus an evaluation setup. It is useful as a data-format study for instruction following, not as a foundation pretraining result.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRISM uses a four-stage synthesis pipeline: persona-task pair generation, prefix-guided rule-set construction, rubric quality filtering, and structured verification-trace generation. PRISM-Eval uses Loose and Strict deterministic matching against fixed labels instead of an inference-time judge.
summary_en.experiments: With 10K synthesized samples, PRISM improves Qwen3-VL-4B Strict accuracy on PRISM-Eval from 9.5% to 30.1%. The abstract does not provide full training details, baseline breadth, or larger-scale scaling evidence.

recommendation.zh: 数据格式比方法更有用；看合成 pipeline 和 Strict metric，别过度外推 10K 样本结果。
recommendation.en: The data format is more useful than the method; inspect the synthesis pipeline and Strict metric, but do not overread the 10K-sample result.

paper.title: RTLCurator: Label-Efficient Data Curation for RTL Generation
paper.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) to write register-transfer level (RTL) requires large corpora of paired specifications and code, and such data is scarce enough that most public corpora are now synthesized. Synthesis provides scale but not correctness, and in two widely used RTL datasets only 24.4% and 53.5% of pairs pass generated functional tests. This raises the question of how much of such a corpus to keep and which part of it. Correctness alone is a poor answer. A pair that misbehaves

summary.core_problem: 为 RTL 代码生成 LLM 清洗合成 specification-code 语料时，如何在 correctness、复杂度和可学习信号之间做取舍。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是预训练/微调数据筛选方法，虽然领域是硬件 RTL，但问题本身对合成代码数据有参考意义。关键观察是，按功能测试通过与否过滤会丢掉复杂样本，并把语料推向短小简单模块。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RTLCurator，通过对比每个 specification 与代码生成行为来学习 behavior-aware compatibility prior，而不是简单保留通过测试的样本。方法目标是识别规范和 RTL 实现之间更细的兼容性信号，把语法、接口约定、部分行为正确性和设计复杂度纳入筛选。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告两个常用 RTL 数据集中，合成样本通过生成式功能测试的比例只有 24.4% 和 53.5%。摘要未给出最终训练模型规模、筛选后数据量、下游 RTL generation 提升幅度或 baseline 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to curate synthetic specification-code pairs for RTL-generation LLMs when correctness, complexity, and learnable signal are in tension.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a data-curation method for code-model training. Although the domain is RTL, the core issue is relevant to synthetic code corpora: correctness-only filtering can discard complex examples and bias the corpus toward short, simple modules.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTLCurator learns a behavior-aware compatibility prior by contrasting each specification with generated RTL behavior, instead of simply keeping examples that pass tests. The method aims to preserve finer-grained signals such as syntax, interface conventions, partial behavioral validity, and design complexity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that only 24.4% and 53.5% of pairs in two widely used RTL datasets pass generated functional tests. It does not provide final model sizes, curated data volume, downstream RTL-generation gains, or detailed baselines in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据筛选动机即可：correctness-only 会系统性删复杂样本，这点对合成代码语料很实用。
recommendation.en: Read only the data-curation motivation: correctness-only filtering systematically removes complex examples, which matters for synthetic code corpora.

paper.title: BridgeAlign: Bridging Preference Alignment for Humanities and Social Sciences
paper.abstract: While data synthesis for large language models (LLMs) is prevalent, it primarily targets domains with verifiable answers, overlooking open-ended humanities and social sciences (HSS), where nuanced quality judgments matter more than objective correctness. This makes preference alignment a natural paradigm for broad HSS tasks. Yet existing methods are either costly or not tailored to broad HSS disciplines. We thus propose BridgeAlign, among the first preference-alignment pipelines for broad HSS di

summary.core_problem: 为开放式人文社科任务构造偏好对齐数据和训练流程，解决这类任务缺少可验证答案、质量判断依赖语境和文体的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 HSS 的后训练数据合成与偏好优化 pipeline。它不是预训练数据工作，主要价值在于把 rubric-grounded preference 从数学、代码等可验证任务迁移到开放式学科写作和问答。
summary.technical_approach: BridgeAlign 包含三阶段：先从网页语料中过滤和精炼 HSS seed documents；再用 persona-based instruction inversion 生成 preference triplets，并用 Q&A consistency check 控制一致性；最后用 HSS quality rubric 生成偏好，并通过 controlled quality degradation 构造接近决策边界的 transitional responses，避免只比较明显优劣样本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 和具体提升幅度。可确认的是方法覆盖 broad HSS disciplines，并针对 preference optimization 设计了更细粒度的近边界偏好样本。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Junyang Lin，用户提供信息标注其为通义千问核心成员；摘要未确认完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds preference-alignment data and training procedures for open-ended humanities and social-science tasks, where quality is contextual and rarely reducible to verifiable answers.
summary_en.importance: It is a post-training data synthesis and preference-optimization pipeline for HSS. Its value is transferring rubric-grounded preference construction from verifiable domains such as math or coding to open-ended disciplinary writing and QA.
summary_en.technical_approach: BridgeAlign has three stages: curating and refining HSS seed documents from web corpora; generating preference triplets through persona-based instruction inversion with Q&A consistency checks; and grounding preferences in HSS quality rubrics, using controlled quality degradation to create near-boundary transitional responses rather than only easy good-vs-bad pairs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact gains. It states that the pipeline targets broad HSS disciplines and designs finer-grained near-boundary preference samples for preference optimization.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Junyang Lin, identified in the prompt as a core Qwen contributor; full institutional affiliations are not confirmed by the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 这是后训练数据工程而非基座方法；若在做开放式偏好数据，只看 degradation 造近边界样本的部分。
recommendation.en: This is post-training data engineering, not a foundation-model method; if you build open-ended preference data, read the near-boundary degradation design.

paper.title: HSS-Synth: Humanities and Social Sciences Data Synthesis for LLMs
paper.abstract: High-quality, diverse data are vital for large language models (LLMs) but remain scarce and costly. Data synthesis is a viable alternative and succeeds on closed tasks, yet the humanities and social sciences (HSS) are overlooked, and their open-ended nature makes synthesis challenging. Moving beyond prior capability-centric, fragmented attempts, we adopt a subject-centric paradigm, define the first HSS domain system covering 14 mainstream fields, and introduce HSS-Synth, the first data synthesis

summary.core_problem: 为人文社科领域合成高质量、多样且语义忠实的 LLM 训练数据，缓解开放式学科任务缺少可验证答案和低幻觉数据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 HSS 指令数据合成 pipeline 和学科体系设计。它对后训练数据构建有参考价值，但属于领域扩展型数据工程，不是通用预训练语料或 scaling 方法。
summary.technical_approach: HSS-Synth 先定义覆盖 14 个主流领域的 HSS domain system；再从网页语料中多步过滤和文本精炼 seed documents，并用 judge 评估；随后用“requirements + persona”把 seed documents 反向生成多样指令，并用严格 Q&A alignment check 保持一致性；最后用 teacher-forced Answering，在生成回答时喂入 seed documents，以锚定语义、降低幻觉并保留语气和完整性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型参数量、合成数据规模、训练设置、baseline 或提升幅度。可确认的实验主张是 pipeline 面向 14 个 HSS 主流领域，并强调 teacher-forced Answering 用于突破普通 LLM 回答长度和忠实性限制。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Junyang Lin，用户提供信息标注其为通义千问核心成员；摘要未确认完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper synthesizes high-quality, diverse, and semantically faithful LLM training data for humanities and social sciences, where open-ended tasks lack easily verifiable answers.
summary_en.importance: It contributes an HSS instruction-data synthesis pipeline and disciplinary taxonomy. It is useful for post-training data construction, but it is domain-oriented data engineering rather than general pretraining corpus design or scaling methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: HSS-Synth first defines an HSS domain system covering 14 mainstream fields. It then filters and refines seed documents from web corpora with judge-based assessment, backtranslates seed documents into diverse instructions using requirements plus personas with strict Q&A alignment checks, and uses teacher-forced Answering that feeds seed documents during response generation to anchor semantics, reduce hallucination, and preserve tone and integrity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, synthetic data scale, training settings, baselines, or quantitative gains. It states that the pipeline covers 14 HSS fields and that teacher-forced Answering addresses answer-length and faithfulness limitations of ordinary LLM generation.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Junyang Lin, identified in the prompt as a core Qwen contributor; full institutional affiliations are not confirmed by the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 又一篇领域指令合成 pipeline，pretrain 信号有限；可备查 teacher-forced Answering 的忠实性控制。
recommendation.en: Another domain instruction-synthesis pipeline with limited pretraining signal; keep the teacher-forced Answering faithfulness control as a reference.

paper.title: DuplexGen: Adaptive Synthesis of Human-AI Turn-Taking Dialogues
paper.abstract: Turn-taking is a central component of full-duplex interaction. Which turn-taking behaviors are appropriate varies with the scenario, yet current models apply a single norm regardless of context. This limitation originates in their training data: human-human speech corpora capture natural timing phenomena but provide little role grounding or scenario-specific norms, while heuristic or prompted synthesis methods inject turn-taking behaviors without basing them on human preferences. We introduce Du

summary.core_problem: 为 full-duplex 人机对话生成符合具体场景的 turn-taking 训练数据，而不是让模型学习单一、固定的轮次规范。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是对话后训练数据合成和偏好校准；对语音 LM、实时对话模型和端到端交互模型有参考价值，但不是基座预训练方法突破。
summary.technical_approach: DuplexGen 用少量 slot-level 人类偏好标注校准 LLM 对 turn-taking 行为的预测，再按任务场景合成对话；它区分合作和竞争任务中的不同插话、等待、接管与让渡行为。
summary.experiments: 论文覆盖 6 个合作与竞争任务，发现人类 turn-taking 偏好随场景系统变化；DuplexGen 比未校准 prompting 和只用通用人人对话数据训练更贴近人类偏好，且用合成数据训练的 full-duplex 模型表现出更符合人类预期的轮次行为。摘要未给出模型规模和提升幅度细节。
summary.authors_note: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign、Seoul National University、Columbia University、University of California, Berkeley、Georgia Institute of Technology；Julia Hirschberg 和 Dilek Hakkani-Tür 是语音对话系统领域知名研究者，Gunhee Kim 长期做视觉语言与多模态学习。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper generates scenario-adaptive turn-taking dialogue data for full-duplex human-AI interaction.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is synthetic dialogue data generation with preference calibration for post-training interactive speech/dialogue models; it is relevant to audio LMs and real-time assistants, but not a base pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: DuplexGen calibrates LLM predictions against a small set of slot-level human preference annotations, then synthesizes dialogues whose interruption, waiting, yielding, and takeover behavior depends on the task context.
summary_en.experiments: Across six cooperative and competitive tasks, the paper reports systematic differences in human turn-taking preferences. DuplexGen aligns better with these preferences than uncalibrated prompting or training only on generic human-human dialogue data, and a full-duplex model trained on the generated data shows more human-aligned turn-taking behavior. The abstract does not provide model size or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Seoul National University, Columbia University, University of California, Berkeley, and Georgia Institute of Technology; Julia Hirschberg and Dilek Hakkani-Tür are well-known in speech and dialogue systems, and Gunhee Kim is known for multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和实验设置即可；有用的点是“交互规范应按场景校准”，不是合成数据框架本身。
recommendation.en: Read the setup rather than the whole paper; the useful signal is that interaction norms need scenario calibration, not the synthesis pipeline itself.

paper.title: Distilling Temporal Search and Reasoning: Evolving LLMs for Future Prediction via Harness-Assisted Efficient Data Synthesis
paper.abstract: Future event prediction carries broad social impact yet remains challenging. SOTA approaches augment LLMs with external agent frameworks whose predictive capability vanishes once the harness is removed. While recent Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) internalizes deep search for multi-hop retrieval of facts, forecasting further demands temporal search and reasoning over historical trends and dynamic shifts. The key obstacle is data: historical queries induce temporal leakage that degrades forecasti

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM未来事件预测依赖外部agent框架，脱离框架后能力消失，且训练数据存在时间泄漏导致预测退化为检索，数据合成效率低
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出时间截断式数据合成范式，将时间搜索与推理能力内化到LLM中，同时提升数据合成效率
summary.technical_approach: 提出时间截断harness，在每轮对话中强制设置时间截止点，采用TIR风格从历史事件中采样训练数据，减少时间泄漏，降低对拒绝采样或未解决查询的依赖，提升采样效率，进而蒸馏得到具备内生时间推理能力的LLM
summary.experiments: 摘要截断，未披露完整实验设置、模型规模及最终效果指标，仅提及该方法可降低时间泄漏、提升数据合成效率，构建了大规模相关数据集（未完成披露）

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLMs rely on external agent frameworks for future event prediction and lose capability when the framework is removed; training data suffers from temporal leakage that reduces forecasting to retrieval, and data synthesis efficiency is low.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a time-truncated data synthesis paradigm to internalize temporal search and reasoning into LLMs while improving data synthesis efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a time-truncation harness that enforces a temporal cutoff at each turn, enabling TIR-style sampling from historical events to reduce temporal leakage, decrease reliance on rejection sampling or unsolved queries, boost sampling efficiency, and distill LLMs with endogenous temporal reasoning ability.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; full experimental setup, model scale, and final performance metrics are not disclosed. Only mentions reduced temporal leakage, improved data synthesis efficiency, and construction of a large-scale relevant dataset (incomplete disclosure).

recommendation.zh: 时间截断式数据合成的思路可用于避免预训练/后训练数据的时间泄漏问题，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: The time-truncated data synthesis idea is useful for avoiding temporal leakage in pretrain/post-train data; read only the abstract.

paper.title: Ground Truth First: A Longitudinal Evaluation Instrument for Agent Memory, and the Tenure Crossover in Memory-Architecture Rankings
paper.abstract: Benchmarks for LLM-agent memory typically generate conversations first and extract answer keys afterwards -- with documented label-error and contamination problems -- and they overwhelmingly measure short interaction histories. We invert the pipeline: a seeded life-script sampler emits facts with validity intervals, volatility classes, and source channels before any text exists; an LLM renderer writes chat and email from per-event fact manifests; a fidelity verifier confirms every planted fact;

summary.core_problem: 现有 agent memory benchmark 往往先生成对话再反推答案，容易带来标签错误、污染和短上下文偏置，导致对记忆架构的评估失真。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测方法论文。它不直接推进预训练，但对长期记忆、合成评测构造、标签保真和 contamination 控制给出了较干净的设计，对做 long-horizon agent eval 的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者反转 benchmark 构造流程：先用 life-script sampler 生成带有效期、波动性、来源渠道的事实脚本，再由 LLM 渲染成聊天和邮件，随后用 verifier 检查每个植入事实，并机械生成问题与 gold answers。数据还包含 as-of-date 问题、sent/received trust 区分和 benign injection probes。随后在固定 answerer、版本化 LLM judge 的设置下评测五种 memory architecture。
summary.experiments: 构造约 380 个问题、15 种题型的合成长期记忆评测集，并比较五种 memory 架构与无记忆对照。摘要中的核心结果是出现“tenure crossover”：短期与长期交互历史下，记忆架构的优劣排序会发生反转。由于规模不大、作者为独立研究者，结论更适合作为评测设计信号，而非定论。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者；工作代表性在于评测构造思路较干净，而非大规模实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent-memory benchmarks often generate conversations first and derive answer keys afterward, which introduces label errors, contamination, and a bias toward short histories.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method paper. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it offers a cleaner way to build long-horizon memory benchmarks with better label fidelity and contamination control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper inverts the benchmark pipeline: a life-script sampler first generates facts with validity intervals, volatility classes, and source channels; an LLM then renders chats and emails; a verifier checks planted facts; and questions plus gold answers are instantiated mechanically. The benchmark also includes as-of-date questions, sent/received trust distinctions, and benign injection probes. Five memory architectures are then evaluated under a fixed answerer and versioned LLM judge.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains about 380 questions across 15 types. The headline finding is a tenure crossover: architecture rankings change when moving from shorter to longer interaction histories. Because the scale is modest and the work is from an independent researcher, the result is better treated as an evaluation signal than a settled conclusion.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher; the main value is the cleaner benchmark-construction logic rather than large-scale experimentation.

recommendation.zh: 评测构造比结果本身更值得看：先种事实再生成文本，这个 pipeline 能减少 memory benchmark 的脏标签；正文只看数据生成流程和 crossover 结果。
recommendation.en: The construction pipeline matters more than the leaderboard: seed facts first, render text later. Read the data-generation setup and the crossover result, not the full paper.

paper.title: SenWorld: A Digital-Twin Simulation for Generating Context-Rich Evaluation Data
paper.abstract: Smartphone personal assistants reason over longitudinal personal data, yet evaluating them requires context-rich evaluation data whose correct answers are known, and real device traces are too privacy-sensitive to share. To address this challenge, we present SenWorld, a physically grounded, deterministic, event-sourced digital-twin simulation that generates such data with ground truth fixed by construction. In SenWorld, personas live through a full day in a world built from real map, weather, ho

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是个人设备助手评测里的一个基础难题：怎样构造既有真实纵向上下文、又能给出可验证标准答案、同时还能共享复现的数据。真实手机轨迹最接近目标场景，但隐私上几乎不可共享；手工写 case 安全但状态稀薄，覆盖不了跨应用、跨时间、多跳检索；LLM 生成 query 或答案虽然快，但如果背后没有完整设备状态，正确性就只能依赖人工或 LLM judge，稳定性和可审计性都不够。SenWorld 的切入点不是继续改 judge，而是把“评测”重写成“可控世界状态生成”问题：只要模拟世界完整拥有设备状态，并且状态演化受物理与外部环境约束，那么很多问题的正确答案就不是事后标注出来的，而是由某一时刻快照中的唯一记录直接决定。
summary.importance: 对大模型基座研究的直接意义不在于训练方法，而在于评测数据生产范式。它给 personal agent / on-device assistant 这类系统提供了一种不依赖 LLM judge 的评测资产构造方式，尤其适合需要长期记忆、跨源检索、时空上下文绑定的任务。对预训练研究员而言，价值主要有三点。第一，它把“ground truth by construction”做到了设备级状态，而不是抽象任务后端，这对未来构造更高可信度的 agent eval 很重要。第二，它展示了 snapshot + pointer label 的标注形式，标签不是自然语言答案，而是指向底层记录的可验证引用，这比开放式文本评分更稳。第三，它说明了高质量评测集未必来自人工标注或模型蒸馏，也可以来自可复现模拟器。量级上，这更像评测基础设施而不是模型方法突破；对通用 LLM 预训练本身启发有限，但对 agent memory、tool use、personal context reasoning 的离线评测设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是一个 physically grounded、deterministic、event-sourced 的 digital twin。论文把 persona、手机、外部服务和物理环境放进同一个随时间推进的世界里统一演化。这里有几个关键设计。第一，物理与外部约束是真实注入的，不是纯文本虚构。世界构建会接入真实地图、天气、节假日、网络等外部数据，让位置、出行、通信、活动安排这些状态变化受现实条件约束。第二，系统是 deterministic 的，同样的初始条件和事件流会得到同样的世界轨迹，这保证了评测可复现。第三，采用 event sourcing 而不是只保留最终数据库状态。也就是每个状态变化都由事件驱动并被记录，系统可以在每个模拟帧导出 full-system snapshot。这样做的好处是，评测样本可以绑定到任意时刻的完整设备状态，而不是只看最终结果。第四，标签机制不是后验生成答案，而是把 query 的正确答案编码成 snapshot 中某个 source table 和 unique record id 的指针。比如“给住在这里的朋友打电话”，正确性最终落在联系人表中某条记录是否与当前位置关联，而不是落在某段自由文本是否看起来合理。第五，论文还设计了 snapshot-centered projection：同一个世界快照可以被确定性地投影成多种下游测试工件，比如用户可见上下文、结构化状态、评测 query 与目标记录等。这使模拟器既是数据生成器，也是评测样本工厂。与已有 state-grounded eval 相比，SenWorld 的区别在于它模拟的是更接近真实 smartphone ecosystem 的完整状态空间，而且评分绕开了 LLM judge。
summary.experiments: 实验主要围绕三件事展开。第一，分布层面的真实性。作者用北京场景下的 16 个 persona 运行整日模拟，并把生成数据与一个保留的真实用户基准在 6 个共享类别上做分布比较。摘要和正文给出的结论是生成分布与真实基准较接近，说明模拟器没有只生成模板化、过于规则的状态组合。第二，行为涌现。论文强调没有为每个 persona 手写 interaction script，而是让行为在环境、日程、设备状态和 persona 设定共同作用下自然出现，进而产生联系人、位置、通信、应用状态之间的长程关联。这一点很关键，因为如果交互脚本是手工编排的，评测集很容易退化成作者预设的有限模式。第三，实用性验证。作者把生成的 evaluation cases 用于诊断一个生产级 smartphone assistant，发现这些 case 能暴露真实缺陷，并帮助定位问题来源。就全文可见内容看，这篇论文更强调评测资产的构造逻辑和案例诊断价值，而不是追求大规模 benchmark 数字。参数量、训练 token、模型提升幅度这类信息并不是重点，因为它不是模型训练论文。若要抓实验重点，建议关注分布对齐图、case 构造示例，以及生产系统缺陷分析部分，而不是期待标准 leaderboard 式结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Method，把问题设定吃透，再看实验图表。优先关注三处。第一，SenWorld 的世界状态定义与事件驱动更新机制，这决定了为什么它能给出 by-construction 的标签。第二，snapshot-centered projection 的具体形式，理解“一个快照如何变成多个评测工件”，这是方法最有可迁移性的部分。第三，生产助手缺陷诊断案例，那里最能看出这种评测数据相比人工 case 或 LLM judge 的实际差异。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果只关心是否值得纳入 agent eval 工具箱，看引言、方法总览图和实验最后一节就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a hard evaluation bottleneck for personal device assistants: how to build context-rich, longitudinal evaluation data with reliable ground truth, without relying on private real-device traces. Real smartphone logs are the natural source, but they are not shareable. Manual case writing is safe but too shallow. LLM-generated cases scale, yet correctness becomes dependent on post-hoc checking or LLM judges. SenWorld reframes the problem: instead of improving answer judging, it constructs a simulated world whose device state is fully owned, reproducible, and physically constrained, so the correct answer is determined directly by the world state at a given time.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation-data production paradigm rather than a model-training advance. For LLM base-model researchers, the relevance is indirect but real: it offers a way to build agent evaluation assets where labels are fixed by construction, especially for tasks involving memory, multi-source retrieval, and temporal context. Two ideas stand out. First, it moves from abstract backend state to a smartphone-like ecosystem, which is closer to the actual failure modes of personal assistants. Second, it replaces free-form answer judging with pointer-based labels into structured records. That makes evaluation more auditable and less dependent on noisy LLM judges. The impact is stronger for agent eval and personal-context reasoning than for core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SenWorld is a physically grounded, deterministic, event-sourced digital twin. Personas, smartphones, external services, and physical context evolve together in one simulated world. Several design choices matter. Real-world constraints are injected through maps, weather, holidays, and network data, so movement, communication, and device state changes are not purely fictional. The system is deterministic, which supports reproducibility. It is also event-sourced, meaning state transitions are recorded as events and full-system snapshots can be exported at each simulated frame. This allows evaluation cases to be tied to exact moments in a longitudinal trajectory. Ground truth is represented as a pointer into the snapshot, such as a source table plus a unique record ID, rather than a natural-language answer. The paper also introduces a snapshot-centered projection mechanism: one world snapshot can be deterministically transformed into multiple downstream testing artifacts. Compared with prior state-grounded evaluation setups, the key difference is that SenWorld targets a richer smartphone ecosystem and avoids LLM-based judging in the final scoring loop.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section focuses on three questions. First, distributional fidelity: the authors simulate full-day trajectories for 16 personas in Beijing and compare generated data against a held-out real-user benchmark over six shared categories. The reported conclusion is that the synthetic data tracks the real benchmark reasonably well at the distribution level. Second, emergent behavior: instead of hand-authoring interaction scripts for each persona, the framework lets behavior arise from persona settings, schedules, environment, and device dynamics, producing nontrivial links across contacts, locations, communication logs, and app state. Third, practical utility: the generated evaluation cases are used to diagnose defects in a production smartphone assistant, and the paper shows that these cases can surface concrete failures and help localize them. This is not a model-scaling paper, so readers should not expect parameter-count or training-token tables. The experimental value lies in the realism checks, case studies, and defect analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction and method first. The key is to understand why the authors treat evaluation as a state-generation problem. Then focus on three parts: the world-state and event model, the snapshot-centered projection mechanism, and the production-assistant defect case studies. Those sections make clear what is genuinely new and what is mostly engineering integration. A quick but useful read should take about 20 to 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成和 label pointer 设计；它给个人助理 eval 一个比 LLM judge 更干净的替代方案。
recommendation.en: Read the data-generation and label-pointer design; it offers a cleaner personal-assistant eval path than LLM judging.

paper.title: RIMS: Preference Optimization via Smoothed Multi-pair Aggregation for Small-Scale LLM Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Small-scale language models (SLMs) are attractive for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in resource-constrained settings, but their limited capacity makes them highly sensitive to noisy or spurious retrieved evidence. Existing preference-based methods such as RoseRAG select only the hardest single preference pair via hard argmin/argmax, discarding the remaining signal; others treat multiple pairs as independent binary comparisons, resulting in low data utilization. We propose RIMS, a three-st

summary.core_problem: 解决小模型在 RAG 场景中对噪声检索证据敏感，以及现有偏好优化方法只使用单个 hard preference pair 或把多 pair 独立处理导致训练信号利用不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向 RAG 的后训练目标改进。它不直接推进预训练，但涉及偏好数据构造、拒绝采样和多比较信号聚合，对理解小模型如何利用弱偏好信号有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RIMS 三阶段框架：先用目标小模型自身通过拒绝采样生成合成 CoT 偏好数据，不依赖闭源教师；再用可微的 soft aggregation 替代 hard argmin/argmax，从多个 preference pairs 中保留梯度；最后用平滑后的多 pair preference objective 做优化。方法主要是对 RAG 偏好优化目标和数据利用方式的改进。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、RAG 数据集、baseline 名称、指标或提升幅度。需要看正文确认是否只在小规模 RAG benchmark 上有效，以及 self-generated CoT preference 是否引入确认偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets small-scale LMs for RAG, where noisy or spurious retrieved evidence can dominate, and existing preference optimization methods waste signal by selecting a single hard pair or treating many pairs as independent binaries.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training objective contribution for RAG. It is not central to base pretraining, but the treatment of synthetic preference data and multi-pair aggregation is mildly useful for understanding how small models can learn from weak preference signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: RIMS uses a three-stage pipeline: generating synthetic chain-of-thought preference data with rejection sampling from the target SLM itself, replacing hard pair selection with a differentiable soft aggregation operator, and optimizing a smoothed multi-pair preference objective. The novelty is mainly in the preference loss and data-utilization strategy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, RAG datasets, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains. The full paper should be checked for whether the method holds beyond small RAG benchmarks and whether self-generated CoT preferences create self-confirmation bias.

recommendation.zh: 作为小模型 RAG 偏好优化备查即可；关键看 soft aggregation 是否比多 pair DPO 有干净增益。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for small-model RAG preference tuning; the only real question is whether soft aggregation beats multi-pair DPO in a clean setup.

paper.title: Automatic Hard Example Synthesis with Multi-Level Agentic Data Curation
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed for nuanced content safety and moderation tasks, yet they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks and out-of-distribution edge cases. Traditional active learning and manual annotation fail to scale against the complexity and volume of novel multimodal threats. In this paper, we propose an automated, agentic red-teaming framework that systematically synthesizes difficult examples using an iterative strategy that proposes novel hy

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型用于内容安全审核时，人工标注和传统主动学习（仅从现有未标注数据中筛选高价值样本）无法高效覆盖快速演进的跨模态对抗样本和决策边界附近的高歧义难例，现有自动红队方法缺乏系统化的探索机制，难以持续挖掘未知的、未被现有数据覆盖的边界漏洞。
summary.importance: 提出的多智能体假设驱动的难例挖掘框架，为自动化策展高质量训练/评测难例提供了可复用的流程设计，其“探索+变异+多层级验证”的迭代思路可迁移到通用对齐数据合成、难负例挖掘、模型边界探测等场景，可降低数据标注的人力成本，为提升模型在边界case上的鲁棒性提供了可行路径。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了运行在Gemini 3上的全自动多智能体数据策展框架，采用迭代“探索-变异”范式：1）Architect智能体基于政策文本、少量种子示例和存储了历史尝试结果的持久记忆库，按比例生成全新漏洞假设或变异已验证有效的旧假设；2）Operator智能体将假设转化为具体的图像生成提示（含文本叠加等对抗设计），合成对应的多模态样本；3）双层级LLM评审委员会与目标审核模型共同做标注验证，通过评审者之间的判断分歧定位高歧义的边界样本。框架通过平衡探索与变异的比例，避免搜索过早收敛到局部。
summary.experiments: 在内容安全审核场景下，使用该框架挖掘的难例构建动态检索的ICL示例库，相比零样本基线，将目标模型的假阴性率从41.2%降低到24.5%。消融实验显示75%新假设探索、25%旧假设变异的配比最优，能最大化新难例的发现效率，避免搜索停滞。框架在挖掘难例的同时，还能自动识别政策文本本身存在的歧义点。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对边界难例挖掘痛点的分析、多智能体的角色分工与迭代循环设计、探索/变异比例的消融结果和FNR提升的核心指标，无需通读附录中的prompt模板和政策细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal LLMs deployed for content safety moderation remain vulnerable to evolving adversarial attacks and ambiguous edge cases near decision boundaries. Manual annotation and traditional active learning pipelines — which only select high-value samples from existing unlabeled datasets — cannot scale to cover these cases at the rate adversaries generate new tactics, and existing automated red-teaming methods lack systematic exploration mechanisms to uncover unknown policy boundary failures absent from existing datasets.
summary_en.importance: The multi-agent, hypothesis-driven hard example synthesis pipeline provides a reusable template for automated curation of high-value training and evaluation data. Its iterative explore-mutate-verify design is transferable to general alignment data synthesis, hard negative mining, and model boundary probing, offering a path to reduce annotation cost and improve model robustness on edge cases.
summary_en.technical_approach: The fully automated multi-agent data curation framework runs on Gemini 3 with an iterative explore-and-mutate loop: 1) An Architect agent generates either entirely new vulnerability hypotheses or mutations of previously successful hypotheses, conditioned on policy text, a small set of seed examples, and a persistent memory of past attempts and outcomes; 2) An Operator agent converts these hypotheses into concrete image generation prompts (including adversarial text overlays and cross-modal obfuscations) and synthesizes corresponding multimodal samples; 3) A two-tier committee of independent LLM raters evaluates samples alongside the target moderation model, using inter-rater disagreement to identify high-ambiguity samples near the policy boundary. The framework balances novel exploration and mutation of existing hypotheses to avoid premature convergence during search.
summary_en.experiments: On a real-world content moderation task, a dynamic in-context learning pool populated with hard examples from the system reduces the target model's false negative rate from 41.2% to 24.5% relative to a zero-shot baseline. Ablations find that a 75% novel exploration / 25% mutation ratio maximizes the rate of new hard example discovery and prevents search stagnation. The system also surfaces inherent ambiguities in written policy text as a byproduct of the boundary search process.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the pipeline design. Focus on the problem framing in the introduction, the division of labor across agents in the curation loop, the exploration vs. mutation ablation, and the core FNR improvement result. There is no need to review appendix prompt templates or full policy text. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“红队=搜索+变异+多级验证”做成自动闭环，适合借鉴到对齐数据生产线；重点看筛选/验证机制，否则容易变成自嗨生成。
recommendation.en: Turns red-teaming into an automated loop (search + mutation + multi-level verification), worth borrowing for alignment data pipelines; focus on the filtering/verification design or it degenerates into self-amplifying junk.

paper.title: HyMobileAgent: Data-Environment Co-Scaling for Efficient GUI Agents
paper.abstract: As large multimodal models move from understanding content to operating on digital environments, mobile GUI has emerged as a challenging and consequential testbed for digital embodied intelligence. Mobile agents operate under three coupled constraints: precise perception of complex interfaces, scalable acquisition of high-quality interaction data, and robust long-horizon decision making under compounding execution errors. This report presents HyMobileAgent, a mobile GUI agent built on Hy3.0-VL-A

summary.core_problem: 移动 GUI agent 受限于复杂界面精确感知、高质量交互数据的可扩展获取、以及长程决策中累积执行误差三个耦合约束。
summary.importance: 提出数据-环境协同 scaling 框架，而非单纯依赖模型 scaling，来解决移动 GUI 交互的关键瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 Hy3.0-VL-A3B（原生任意分辨率输入、A3B 规模部署、32K 上下文窗口）构建 HyMobileAgent，集成 GUI 感知飞轮（mock 界面合成、拒绝采样、图标特定增强）和知识流水线。
summary.experiments: 在移动 GUI 交互场景中验证，报告了感知、数据获取和长程决策三方面的改进。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Hy Vision Team，基于自研 Hy3.0-VL-A3B 视觉原生基座模型。

summary_en.core_problem: Mobile GUI agents face three coupled constraints: precise perception of complex interfaces, scalable acquisition of high-quality interaction data, and robust long-horizon decision making under compounding execution errors.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a joint data-environment co-scaling framework rather than relying solely on model scaling to address key mobile interaction bottlenecks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds HyMobileAgent on Hy3.0-VL-A3B (native any-resolution input, A3B-scale deployment budget, 32K context window), integrating a GUI perception flywheel (mock-interface synthesis, rejection sampling, icon-specific augmentation) and a knowledge pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: Validated in mobile GUI interaction scenarios, reporting improvements across perception, data acquisition, and long-horizon decision making.
summary_en.authors_note: From the Hy Vision Team, built on the in-house Hy3.0-VL-A3B vision-native foundation model.

recommendation.zh: GUI agent 的数据-环境协同 scaling 思路对 VLM 预训练数据合成有参考，但属应用系统报告，看数据飞轮部分即可。
recommendation.en: The data-environment co-scaling idea for GUI agents is relevant to VLM pretraining data synthesis, but this is an application system report—just read the data flywheel section.

paper.title: The Test Oracle Problem in Synthetic LLM-as-Judge Corpora: Disappearance, Distortion and a Validation Protocol
paper.abstract: Studies of bias in LLM-as-judge systems typically build synthetic corpora by prompting an LLM to generate a hallucinated answer to pair with a factual one, then presenting both to a judge. We report a case in which this generation step silently failed, and use it to argue that the failure mode is structural rather than incidental. In a multilingual (Turkish/English) faithfulness-judgment corpus, a decoding-budget parameter shared between judging and generation calls truncated one producer's hall

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是 synthetic LLM-as-judge 语料构建里的一个很具体但很容易被忽视的问题：当研究者用一个 LLM 生成“错误答案/幻觉答案”作为 judge 的负样本时，如果生成环节本身悄悄退化，后续所有关于 judge 偏差的统计分析都可能建立在坏刺激上，而且常规的稳健性检查未必能发现。作者把这个问题上升为 test oracle problem：对于一条自动生成的负样本，是否存在便宜、机械、逐条可执行的正确性检查。如果没有，那么语料构建流程就天然缺少 item-level 审计能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究，这不是直接改模型或训练配方的论文，但它和评测方法、合成数据质量、自动 judge 可靠性高度相关。现在很多 post-train、reward modeling、preference data、self-play 数据合成都依赖 LLM 生成中间产物，再用另一个模型打分或筛选。论文提醒的一点很重要：如果生成端没有可验证 oracle，后续再精细的统计显著性、复现实验、机制解释，都可能只是把上游数据缺陷包装得更可信。它的贡献不在提出复杂新算法，而在把一个常见实践问题讲清楚：LLM-generated negatives 和 mechanical perturbation negatives 在可审计性上并不对称。这个判断对做合成预训练数据、judge benchmark、reward 数据集的人都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
论文的方法部分其实是一种失败案例剖析加验证协议设计。作者在构建一个土耳其语/英语双语 faithfulness-judgment corpus 时，错误地让 judging call 和 generation call 共享同一个 decoding-budget 参数。这个预算对 judge 的单 token 输出足够，但对生成段落级 hallucinated answer 来说过小，结果把某个 producer 生成的土耳其语负样本截断成很短的几词片段。随后这些坏样本进入 judge 评测流程，制造出一个看起来很显著的跨语言偏差效应。

论文的关键不是“发现了一个 bug”，而是系统说明为什么常规检查抓不到它。作者做了四类标准 aggregate-level robustness 检查，但它们都只看 judge 行为统计，不看刺激本身，因此对 item-level degeneration 天然失明。接着作者用 test oracle 的视角区分两类负样本构造：
1. LLM-generated-negative design：负样本由模型自由生成，没有廉价 oracle 去判断一条样本是“合理的错误答案”还是“退化的短残片”。
2. Mechanical-perturbation design：负样本由 gold answer 经过确定性变换得到，因此 gold 与 negative 之间存在可机械验证的关系，可以用字符串比较之类的方法做 item-level 检查。

为了把这个论点从概念变成证据，作者做了一个 positive control：在一个最小化的、oracle-bearing 的 mechanical corpus 上注入与原故障最接近的机械类比错误，结果用 gold-to-negative string comparison 可以 100% 检出，且不需要额外 API 调用和人工阅读。对于无法避免使用 oracle-less 生成设计的场景，作者提出一个很朴素的 validation protocol：在做任何聚合统计前，按 generation condition 人工抽读 15 到 20 条原始生成样本，并报告长度分布与 degeneration rate。这个协议不花哨，但论文的论证是，至少在他们的故障类型上，这是唯一真正有效的检查。
summary.experiments:
实验核心是一个 A/B 验证过的真实故障案例。坏数据会制造出一个看似稳健的现象：某个 judge 在土耳其语上的选择准确率相对英语出现 32 个点的坍塌，而且这个效应从 N=50 扩展到 N=500 都能复现。作者还给出了三层 mechanistic account，并做了 controlled producer-swap experiment，结果都支持这个“偏差故事”。但这些支持后来被证明是建立在退化刺激上的假象。

更有信息量的是纠错后的分析。作者指出，生成故障会以两种不同方式污染结论：一种是凭空制造一个不存在的效应；另一种是把原本真实存在的效应扭曲成错误的大小或形态。aggregate metrics 无法区分这两类污染。也就是说，即便某个偏差现象并非完全虚构，上游刺激退化仍会改变你对它的定量判断。

positive control 部分则展示了设计差异：在 mechanical-perturbation 语料上注入对应故障后，简单的字符串级 oracle 检查达到 100% 检出率，成本为零 API、零人工。这个结果不说明 mechanical design 在所有方面都更好，但至少说明它在可审计性上有明确优势。

如果从实验局限看，论文没有去普查现有 judge corpora 有多少已经受影响，也没有给出通用阈值证明 15 到 20 条人工抽检在所有场景都足够。它更像一个经过充分验证的 failure analysis，而不是大规模基准研究。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按问题链条来读。先看引言里对故障案例的叙述，弄清楚 fabricated effect 是怎么形成的；再看 Section 4.1 和 4.2，重点理解“消失、扭曲”这两类污染分别是什么意思；最后看 Section 4.3 的 positive control 和 Section 5 的 validation protocol。这样能最快抓住论文真正的贡献，不会把它误读成单纯的 pipeline 事故记录。

如果时间有限，优先看故障复现图表、producer-swap 实验、以及纠错前后结果对比。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。值得特别留意的一点是，作者不是在泛泛批评 LLM-as-judge，而是在指出 synthetic corpus 构建里“负样本生成无 oracle”这一结构性缺口。做合成数据、reward 数据、judge benchmark 的人都应该把这点记下来。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific but underappreciated failure mode in synthetic LLM-as-judge corpora. Many judge-bias studies create negative examples by asking an LLM to generate a fluent but incorrect answer, then compare it against a factual answer. If that generation step silently degenerates, the downstream bias analysis can become invalid even when the aggregate statistics look strong. The paper reframes this as a test oracle problem: for each generated negative example, is there a cheap, mechanical way to verify that the item is valid? If not, the corpus construction pipeline lacks item-level auditability by design.
summary_en.importance: This is not a model-training paper, but it is highly relevant to evaluation methodology, synthetic data quality, and automatic judging. A large amount of post-training, preference collection, reward modeling, and synthetic supervision now depends on one model generating intermediate artifacts that another model scores or filters. The paper makes a useful point: if the generation side has no reliable oracle, then replication, significance testing, and even mechanistic explanations can all become downstream confirmations of bad stimuli. The contribution is not a new algorithm. It is a careful argument that LLM-generated negatives and mechanically perturbed negatives are not symmetric in auditability. That matters for anyone building judge benchmarks, synthetic training corpora, or reward datasets.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is structured as a failure analysis plus a validation protocol. While building a bilingual Turkish/English faithfulness-judgment corpus, the authors accidentally shared one decoding-budget parameter across both judging calls and generation calls. That budget was fine for judges that only needed a short output, but disastrous for generators that were supposed to produce paragraph-length hallucinated answers. As a result, one producer’s Turkish negative examples were silently truncated into very short fragments. Those corrupted items then entered the judge evaluation pipeline and produced what looked like a strong cross-lingual bias effect.

The main contribution is not merely finding a bug. It is explaining why standard checks failed to catch it. The authors applied four aggregate-level robustness procedures, and all of them reinforced the false story rather than exposing the fault, because they only inspected judge behavior and not the stimuli themselves. The paper then contrasts two corpus-construction regimes:
1. LLM-generated-negative design: negatives are sampled from a model, so there is no cheap oracle to tell whether a short or odd output is a valid hallucination or a degenerate artifact.
2. Mechanical-perturbation design: negatives are derived from gold answers by deterministic transformations, so the relation between gold and negative can be checked mechanically, for example with string-level comparisons.

To turn this from an argument into evidence, the paper includes a positive control. The authors inject the closest mechanical analogue of their fault into a minimal oracle-bearing corpus and show that a simple gold-to-negative string comparison catches it with 100% accuracy, at zero API cost and zero human reading. For settings where oracle-less generation cannot be avoided, they propose a practical validation protocol: before computing any aggregate statistic, manually inspect 15 to 20 raw generated items per generation condition and report their length distribution and degeneration rate. The protocol is deliberately simple because, in their case, simple manual inspection was the only thing that actually worked.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical core is a real A/B-verified pipeline failure. On the corrupted corpus, one judge appeared to suffer a 32-point collapse in selection accuracy in Turkish relative to English. The effect replicated from N=50 to N=500. The authors could even build a three-layer mechanistic account for it, and a controlled producer-swap experiment also supported the apparent story. Yet the effect was fabricated by stimulus corruption.

The corrected-data analysis is especially useful. The paper shows that generation faults can corrupt conclusions in two qualitatively different ways: they can fabricate an effect that does not exist, or they can distort a real effect into the wrong magnitude or shape. Aggregate metrics cannot distinguish these cases. So even when a bias is not entirely fictional, upstream stimulus degeneration can still bend the measurement in a misleading direction.

The positive-control experiment then demonstrates the design asymmetry. When an analogous fault is injected into a mechanical-perturbation corpus, a simple string-based oracle detects it with 100% accuracy and no additional API calls or human effort. This does not prove that mechanical designs are always better overall, but it does show a clear auditability advantage.

The limitations are also clear. The paper does not audit the broader literature to estimate how many existing judge corpora are affected, and it does not prove that inspecting 15 to 20 items is universally sufficient. It is best read as a well-validated failure analysis rather than a large-scale benchmark study.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, follow the causal chain. Start with the introduction to understand how the fabricated effect emerged. Then read Sections 4.1 and 4.2 to see the two corruption modes: complete fabrication versus distortion of a real effect.
