After that, read Section 4.3 for the positive control and Section 5 for the proposed validation protocol. That sequence makes the paper’s contribution much clearer than treating it as a simple pipeline anecdote.

If time is limited, prioritize the figures or tables that show the false cross-lingual collapse, the producer-swap experiment, and the before/after correction comparison. A useful skim should take around 20 to 30 minutes. The key takeaway is not a generic complaint about LLM-as-judge, but a structural warning about oracle-free negative generation in synthetic corpora.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim；它不是大模型方法，但会改变你对合成 judge 数据“统计显著即可用”的信任。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming; it is not a model paper, but it should lower your trust in statistically significant synthetic judge corpora.

paper.title: When T2I Synthetic Data Backfires: Amplified Privacy Risks in Real-Synthetic Mix Training
paper.abstract: To overcome data scarcity and privacy constraints in data collection, it has become standard practice across academia and industry to augment real training data with text-to-image (T2I)-generated synthetic data, a paradigm we term Real-Synthetic Mix-Training (RSMT). While substituting synthetic data for sensitive real samples is widely regarded as a means to mitigate privacy exposure of the substituted data, the risk to the remaining real samples that actively participate in training has remaine

summary.core_problem: T2I模型训练中普遍认为合成数据替代部分真实数据可降低隐私风险，但未被替换的剩余真实样本的隐私泄露风险未被系统研究。
summary.importance: 首次揭示真实-合成数据混合训练（RSMT）会放大剩余真实样本的隐私泄露，提出记忆放大理论框架和风险评估方法，挑战了“合成数据必然降低隐私风险”的直觉。
summary.technical_approach: 建立RSMT记忆放大理论框架，证明合成数据会将真实样本挤压到混合特征空间边缘，迫使模型更激进地记忆这些样本；基于该理论设计RSMixLeak成员推断攻击流程，量化隐私放大程度。
summary.experiments: 在T2I生成模型训练场景下验证了理论效应，显示混合合成数据后剩余真实样本的成员推断攻击成功率显著上升；摘要截断了具体模型、数据集和量化结果细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In text-to-image (T2I) model training, it is widely assumed that substituting part of real training data with synthetic samples reduces privacy risks, but privacy exposure of the remaining non-substituted real samples has not been systematically examined.
summary_en.importance: This work is the first to demonstrate that real-synthetic mix training (RSMT) amplifies privacy leakage of remaining real samples, proposes a theoretical memorization amplification framework to explain the effect, and introduces a corresponding risk assessment method, challenging the intuition that synthetic data universally reduces privacy risk.
summary_en.technical_approach: Develops the RSMT Memorization Amplification framework, proving synthetic data displaces real samples to peripheral regions of the mixed feature space, forcing models to memorize these outlying real samples more aggressively; designs RSMixLeak, a membership inference attack pipeline to systematically quantify amplified privacy risk.
summary_en.experiments: Validated in T2I generative model training setups, showing significantly higher membership inference success rates on remaining real samples after mixing in synthetic data; specific model, dataset, and quantitative details are truncated in the available abstract.

recommendation.zh: T2I场景下发现合成数据混合训练会放大真实样本记忆与隐私泄露，机制可能外溢到LM合成数据预训练，但无LM实验，知道结论即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Finds amplified real sample memorization when mixing T2I synthetic data, a mechanism potentially relevant to LLM synthetic data pretraining, but no LM experiments are included—just note the finding, no deep read needed.

paper.title: FormalAnalyticGeo: A Neural-Symbolic Based Framework for Multimodal Analytic Geometry Problem Generation
paper.abstract: Math reasoning has achieved significant progress with the rapid advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), however analytic geometry remains largely underexplored, primarily due to the scarcity of annotated samples. Existing diagram generation approaches struggle with analytic geometry: template methods cannot handle constraint-driven layouts, and generative models lack the geometric precision to render annotated conic curves correctly. We present FormalAnalyticGeo, a scalable fram

summary.core_problem: 多模态解析几何题数据稀缺，现有图表生成方法无法同时满足约束驱动布局和几何精度要求。
summary.importance: 提出了一个可扩展的多模态数学题生成框架，属于数据合成类工具工作。
summary.technical_approach: FormalAnalyticGeo框架围绕形式化中间表示CDL构建，通过有符号距离场(SDF)引擎实现精确图表渲染，串联四个专用LLM组件（生成器、形式化器等）完成全自动题目生成。
summary.experiments: 验证了框架在解析几何题目生成上的多样性和几何精度，未做大规模模型训练评测。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal analytic geometry problem data is scarce; existing diagram generation methods fail at both constraint-driven layout and geometric precision.
summary_en.importance: A scalable multimodal math problem generation framework, categorized as a data synthesis tooling work.
summary_en.technical_approach: FormalAnalyticGeo is built around CDL, a formal intermediate representation bridging problem text and precise diagram rendering via a Signed Distance Field engine, with four sequential specialized LLM components.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on diversity and geometric precision of generated analytic geometry problems; no large-scale model training evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 形式化+SDF生成多模态数学题的思路有参考性，但属于小领域数据合成工具，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The formal-language-plus-SDF approach for multimodal math problem generation is interesting, but it is a niche data synthesis tool; read the abstract only.

paper.title: Watermark Forensics for Generative Models: An Information-Theoretic Perspective
paper.abstract: A watermark in a generative model's output is usually asked only whether a text is machine-made. The same mark can do more: attribute it to the user who produced it, extract a hidden payload, or localize the part that survives editing. These form a forensic ladder, and we ask what each rung costs in the sample length $n$.   One object organizes the answers. Let $S$ be the secret the mark carries (a user's identity or payload), and let the information profile $ν(t)=I(S;X_t\mid X_{<t})$ record how

summary.core_problem: 从信息论角度刻画生成模型水印在检测、用户归因、隐藏载荷提取和编辑后局部定位之间的样本长度与信息成本差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论分析；它把水印从“是否机器生成”的二元检测扩展成 forensic ladder，并用统一的信息 profile 描述不同取证能力的代价。对预训练研究员的价值主要在数据 provenance、合成文本检测和水印设计边界，而不是训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 定义 secret S 与 token 序列之间的信息 profile ν(t)=I(S;X_t|X_<t)，用其总质量解释 attribution 和 extraction 的成本，用信息质量在 token 位置上的分布解释 localization 的成本；同时区分 detection 的成本来源，它由 marked distribution 与 unmarked distribution 的距离支付，而不是由 secret information 支付。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调主定理和 entropy collapse 相关结论，未给出具体 LLM 水印算法、模型规模或实证 benchmark；主要结果是样本长度 n 下不同 forensic 任务的理论界限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper gives an information-theoretic account of what generative-model watermarks can support beyond detection: user attribution, payload extraction, and localization after editing.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is theoretical. It organizes watermark forensics into a ladder of capabilities and assigns different sample-length costs to each rung. For LLM pretraining researchers, the relevance is mainly data provenance, synthetic-text detection, and limits of watermark design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines an information profile ν(t)=I(S;X_t|X_<t), measuring how much each token reveals about the secret given prior tokens. Total information mass pays for attribution and extraction, the spatial spread of that mass pays for localization, while detection is governed by distributional distance between marked and unmarked outputs rather than by secret information.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on main theorems and sample-length scaling, not empirical LLM evaluations. It does not report model sizes, datasets, or benchmark gains for a concrete watermarking system.

recommendation.zh: 理论边界比具体算法更有用；读信息 profile 定义和主定理即可，能校准对 LLM 水印取证能力的预期。
recommendation.en: The bounds matter more than any algorithm here; read the information-profile definition and main theorem to calibrate expectations for LLM watermark forensics.

paper.title: Weight-Adjusted Gradients Reveal Parameter Importance and Failure Modes in LLMs
paper.abstract: Understanding which parameters are influential in Large Language Models (LLMs) is central to improving their efficiency, reliability, and interpretability. We introduce Weight-Adjusted Gradients (WAG), a simple yet effective approach for estimating parameter importance that explicitly captures the interaction between model weights and first-order gradient information and identifies parameters that disproportionately influence model behavior, such as those responsible for collapse phenomena in LL

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题是：如何用低成本指标识别 LLM 中少量对性能和失效模式高度敏感的参数，而不是只看权重大小或梯度大小。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的启发在训练动态、模型脆弱性和参数重要性分析。WAG 把权重幅值和一阶梯度相乘，近似衡量参数在相对扰动下会带来多大损失变化。这个视角比单独看 magnitude 或 gradient 更贴近实际训练和部署中的风险：某些参数本身很大且局部敏感，扰动后可能导致性能突降。对大模型训练来说，这类指标可能帮助分析 loss spike、坏 checkpoint、混合精度分配、量化敏感层、MoE 层级容量分配，以及 model editing / unlearning 中的局部风险。
summary.technical_approach: WAG 的核心形式可以理解为参数值与对应梯度的交互项，通常对应 |θ_i · ∂ℓ/∂θ_i| 这一类尺度。它衡量的是乘性扰动或相对扰动下的敏感性：如果参数 θ_i 被按比例改变，损失的一阶变化与 θ_i 和梯度的乘积相关。这样做的好处是同时避免两个问题：只看权重大小会把功能上不敏感的大参数误判为重要；只看梯度会高估尺度很小、对模型函数影响有限的参数。论文用 targeted masking 展示，WAG 能找出一小部分被扰动后会引发显著性能退化的参数，而这些参数常被传统 magnitude、gradient 或部分 saliency 指标漏掉。应用层面，作者把 WAG 用于 MoE expert allocation、mixed-precision quantization、targeted unlearning 和 knowledge editing。
summary.experiments: 实验主线是参数重要性验证：按不同指标选出参数子集并进行 masking 或扰动，比较性能下降幅度。论文报告 WAG 能定位很小但关键的参数集合，对这些参数做修改会造成明显退化，甚至出现 abrupt collapse；而仅用 magnitude 或 gradient 的指标不能稳定找到这些失效触发点。应用实验中，WAG 被用来指导 MoE 中不同层分配多少 expert，以及在混合精度量化中决定哪些子模块保留高精度；结果显示它能作为简单、低开销的分配信号。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格和模型清单，具体模型名称、任务分数和精确提升幅度不宜过度外推。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。先看 WAG 定义和理论解释，尤其是它为什么对应 multiplicative perturbation sensitivity；再看 targeted masking 实验，这是判断指标是否真正有用的核心证据。应用部分可以按兴趣选择：做训练稳定性和量化的人看 mixed-precision quantization；做稀疏模型的人看 MoE expert allocation；做安全和编辑的人看 unlearning / knowledge editing。需要注意的是，WAG 是分析指标，不是完整训练算法。更值得深挖的问题是：这些高 WAG 参数在层、模块、attention/MLP、norm 或 embedding 中是否有稳定分布，以及它们是否能预测训练过程中的 spike 或 collapse。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to cheaply identify a tiny subset of LLM parameters that are highly influential for performance and failure modes, beyond weight magnitude or gradient magnitude alone.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is in training dynamics and model fragility analysis. WAG combines parameter scale with first-order sensitivity, giving an estimate of how much the loss would change under relative parameter perturbations. This is useful because severe degradation can come from parameters that are both large enough to matter functionally and locally sensitive in the loss landscape. Such a signal may help diagnose loss spikes, fragile checkpoints, mixed-precision placement, quantization-sensitive modules, MoE capacity allocation, and the risks of localized model editing or unlearning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Weight-Adjusted Gradients measure the interaction between a parameter and its gradient, roughly in the form of |θ_i · ∂ℓ/∂θ_i| when considered per parameter and aggregated over data. The metric can be interpreted as first-order sensitivity to multiplicative, or relative, perturbations. This matters because magnitude-only metrics ignore local loss sensitivity, while gradient-only metrics can overemphasize tiny parameters whose absolute functional effect is limited. The paper uses targeted masking and perturbation experiments to show that WAG surfaces parameters whose modification causes severe degradation, including collapse-like behavior. It also applies WAG as a practical signal for MoE expert allocation, mixed-precision quantization, targeted unlearning, and knowledge editing.
summary_en.experiments: The central experiment ranks parameters by different importance metrics, masks or perturbs selected subsets, and measures the resulting degradation. WAG identifies very small parameter sets whose modification causes large performance drops, while magnitude-based and gradient-based baselines do not consistently expose the same failure-triggering parameters. In application experiments, WAG guides how many experts to allocate to each layer in MoE models and which submodules to keep in higher precision for mixed-precision quantization. The available text does not provide the full model list, task table, or exact numerical gains, so the safest reading is that the paper establishes WAG as a low-cost diagnostic and allocation heuristic rather than a complete training method.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the definition of WAG and the theoretical interpretation as multiplicative perturbation sensitivity. Then read the targeted masking experiments, since they contain the main evidence that the metric captures something missed by weight-only or gradient-only scores. The application sections can be read selectively: mixed-precision quantization for systems and deployment, MoE expert allocation for sparse-model training, and unlearning or editing for safety-oriented work. A useful follow-up question is whether high-WAG parameters have stable locations across layers and modules, and whether they can predict loss spikes or collapse during pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 提出了一种结合权重和梯度的参数重要性指标 WAG，发现修改极少数关键参数会导致 LLM 崩溃，对理解模型鲁棒性和剪枝/量化有启发，值得关注其机制分析。
recommendation.en: Proposes WAG, a parameter importance metric combining weights and gradients, revealing that modifying a tiny fraction of critical parameters causes LLM collapse. Insightful for understanding model robustness, pruning, and quantization.

paper.title: Infinity-Parser2 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Infinity-Parser2, a large multimodal model that couples a controllable data-synthesis pipeline with multi-task reinforcement learning for end-to-end document parsing, addressing the persistent scarcity of faithfully annotated parsing corpora. Our contributions are threefold. First, we build a scalable synthesis engine, pairing a controllable rendering framework with an iterative refinement loop, and use it to construct and open-source Infinity-Doc2-5M: a 5-million-sample bilingual (Ch

summary.core_problem: 解决端到端文档解析缺少高保真标注语料的问题，覆盖版面、表格、公式、图表、化学式和阅读顺序等复杂结构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态文档理解系统报告，核心亮点是 500 万规模中英双语合成语料 Infinity-Doc2-5M，以及可验证多任务 reward 支撑的联合强化学习；对多模态预训练的数据合成和 reward 设计有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包括可控渲染框架、迭代式数据精修循环、全页元素框和规范内容形式标注，并将 Markdown、HTML、LaTeX、SMILES、结构化图表和阅读顺序统一到文档解析训练中；训练侧提出跨八个目标的 verifiable reward，并进行 Joint Reinforcement Learning。
summary.experiments: 语料规模为 500 万样本，覆盖中英文和多类文档；八个联合目标包括文档解析、布局分析、表格解析、数学公式解析、图表解析、化学公式解析、文档 VQA 和通用多模态理解。摘要未提供模型参数量、基线、具体指标或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The report tackles the shortage of faithfully annotated corpora for end-to-end document parsing across layout, tables, formulas, charts, chemical structures, and reading order.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a multimodal document-understanding system report, highlighted by the 5M-sample bilingual Infinity-Doc2-5M synthetic corpus and a verifiable multi-task reward setup for joint reinforcement learning. It is indirectly useful for multimodal data synthesis and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system combines controllable rendering, iterative data refinement, full-page element boxes, canonical content annotations, and unified targets such as Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, SMILES, structured charts, and reading order. It then trains with verifiable rewards across eight co-trained objectives.
summary_en.experiments: The corpus contains 5 million Chinese-English samples across diverse document types. The eight objectives include document parsing, layout analysis, table parsing, math formula parsing, chart parsing, chemical formula parsing, document VQA, and general multimodal understanding. The supplied abstract does not include parameter counts, baselines, metrics, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据合成闭环和可验证 reward 设计；任务偏文档解析，别把结论外推到通用 VLM pretrain。
recommendation.en: Read only the synthesis loop and verifiable-reward design; the task is document parsing, so avoid overextending it to general VLM pretraining.

paper.title: Demonstrating TOFFEE: A Learned System for Synthesizing Data Agent Trajectories at Scale
paper.abstract: LLM-powered data agents are playing an increasingly important role in data-driven decision making. However, existing data agents struggle to generalize to unseen data environments and analytical workflows, especially in heterogeneous enterprise settings. This creates a growing need for synthesizing high-quality data agent trajectories that capture complex analytical workflows for given data environments. Such trajectories support two key downstream uses: they can serve as supervised finetuning (

summary.core_problem: 如何为数据分析 Agent 自动合成高质量、可扩展的轨迹数据，以解决其在异构企业环境中泛化能力差的问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于 MCTS 的数据合成系统，为数据 Agent 的 SFT 和 ICL 提供了高质量的训练/演示数据，缓解了数据 Agent 领域高质量轨迹数据匮乏的瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TOFFEE 系统，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索 (MCTS) 探索数据环境，结合自适应模型选择（在探索和利用阶段动态切换不同能力的 LLM）和跨任务前缀重用（复用已验证的中间步骤）来提高合成效率和质量。
summary.experiments: 在多个异构数据分析任务上验证，表明 TOFFEE 能有效生成可扩展的轨迹数据，提升下游数据 Agent 的性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南洋理工大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: How to automatically synthesize high-quality, scalable trajectory data for data analysis agents to address their poor generalization in heterogeneous enterprise environments?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an MCTS-based data synthesis system that provides high-quality training/demonstration data for SFT and ICL of data agents, alleviating the bottleneck of scarce high-quality trajectory data in this domain.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces TOFFEE, a system that uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explore data environments, combined with adaptive model selection (dynamically switching LLMs of different capabilities during exploration and exploitation) and cross-task prefix reuse (reusing verified intermediate steps) to improve synthesis efficiency and quality.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple heterogeneous data analysis tasks, showing that TOFFEE can effectively generate scalable trajectory data and improve the performance of downstream data agents.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Nanyang Technological University and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 用 MCTS 合成 Agent 轨迹的常规思路，工程实现（自适应模型选择、前缀重用）有一定参考价值，作为 Agent 数据合成的 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: A standard approach using MCTS for agent trajectory synthesis; the engineering details (adaptive model selection, prefix reuse) offer some reference value. Keep as literature for agent data synthesis.

paper.title: HaloGuard 1.0: An Open Weights Constitutional Classifier for Multilingual AI Safety
paper.abstract: We present HaloGuard 1.0, an open-weights implementation of the constitutional-classifier paradigm for input safety. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on English and multilingual prompt-safety benchmarks at roughly one-tenth the model size of current leading open guard models. The safety constitution is the organising structure of the corpus: a natural-language constitution of 46 policies and 2,940 subcategories drives synthetic data generation, with exhaustive one-to-one paired counterfa

summary.core_problem: 构建一个小参数、开源权重、多语言输入安全分类器，用于判断用户 prompt 是否违反安全政策。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全后训练/guard 模型工程与数据构造。亮点在于用自然语言 constitution 驱动合成数据，并通过成对反事实样本降低边界误判，对安全数据生成有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: HaloGuard 1.0 使用 46 条 policy 和 2,940 个子类组织安全语料；为每个安全边界构造成对 counterfactual，保持主题和词汇相近但翻转意图；同时设计两层 harmless 数据来分别压低边界 false positive 和普通 harmless false positive；覆盖 46 种语言，并把语言当作表层形式而不是攻击信号。
summary.experiments: HaloGuard 1.0-0.8B 在七个 prompt-safety benchmark 上平均 F1 达到 90.9；摘要称其优于若干开源 guard baseline，包括参数量最高到 27B 的模型，且模型尺寸约为当前领先开源 guard 的十分之一。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore。摘要未显示知名基础模型团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a compact open-weight multilingual safety classifier for detecting unsafe user prompts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly post-training safety infrastructure and synthetic safety data design. The interesting part is the constitution-driven corpus with paired counterfactuals, which is relevant to guard-model data quality rather than base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: HaloGuard uses a natural-language constitution with 46 policies and 2,940 subcategories. It generates one-to-one counterfactual pairs that keep topic and vocabulary fixed while flipping intent, adds two harmless tiers to reduce boundary and baseline false positives, and materializes the data across 46 languages.
summary_en.experiments: HaloGuard 1.0-0.8B reports an average F1 of 90.9 across seven prompt-safety benchmarks and is claimed to outperform open guard baselines up to 27B parameters, at roughly one-tenth the size of leading open guard models.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore. No major foundation-model lab affiliation is indicated in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造部分；0.8B 打过 27B 的结论要核 benchmark 泄漏和标签定义。
recommendation.en: Read the data-construction recipe only; the 0.8B-beats-27B claim needs leakage and label-boundary checks.

institutions: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore

paper.title: Search-based Testing of Vision Language Models for In-Car Scene Understanding
paper.abstract: In the automotive domain, in-car scene understanding (ISU) enables the detection of safety-critical events, such as driver distraction, and supports drivers or passengers by analyzing the in-car scene and adapting the environment (e.g., ambient lighting). The industry is increasingly exploring vision-language models (VLMs) to interpret camera-recorded in-car scenes and extract information for downstream reasoning tasks. However, VLMs may generate incomplete, erroneous, or misleading scene descri

summary.core_problem: 如何在真实数据昂贵的车内场景下，对 VLM 驱动的车内场景理解系统进行系统化、可扩展的可靠性测试。
summary.importance: 属于面向安全关键场景的 VLM 测试/评测方法；对“VLM 可靠性评估、合成场景生成用于测试”有参考，但偏垂直领域，难直接反馈到通用预训练配方。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ISU-Test：用渲染生成车内场景，并把测试用例生成表述为搜索/优化问题，通过系统性修改场景参数探索失败模式与覆盖更广的 corner cases。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VLM/ISU 系统、搜索空间规模、发现的失败类型统计或与随机采样的对比增益；主要是方法框架描述。

summary_en.core_problem: How to systematically and scalably test VLM-based in-car scene understanding systems when real in-vehicle data is costly.
summary_en.importance: An evaluation/testing methodology for VLM reliability using synthetic rendering; informative for robustness evaluation, but domain-specific and only weakly connected to general pretraining recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ISU-Test combines rendering-based scene generation with search-based testing, framing test generation as an optimization problem over scene parameters to explore diverse corner cases and failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify target VLMs, search budget, failure statistics, or gains over random sampling; mostly a framework description.

recommendation.zh: 把“渲染+搜索”当作 VLM 可靠性评测脚手架的思路可借鉴；只看问题建模与参数化搜索，别深挖车内细节。
recommendation.en: The render+search framing is a reusable VLM reliability testing scaffold; skim the optimization setup and parameterization, ignore in-car specifics.

paper.title: DisciplineGen-1M: A Large-Scale Dataset for Multidisciplinary Visual Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Recent image generation and editing models can produce visually appealing natural images, yet they remain unreliable when the target image is a knowledge-intensive diagram whose correctness depends on disciplinary concepts, symbolic structure, and precise spatial relations. We introduce DisciplineGen-1M, a million-scale multidisciplinary dataset that supports text-to-image generation and image editing. It contains 1.2M samples spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, geography, compute

summary.core_problem: 现有图像生成/编辑模型在知识密集型“学科图表/示意图”上不可靠，缺少大规模、可控、带结构监督的数据来训练与评测。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是百万级合成+过滤的数据集与构建流水线；对多模态生成/编辑的预训练数据配方、可控编辑监督、以及“符号结构+空间关系”建模有参考价值，但仍偏图像生成数据资产。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DisciplineGen-1M：结合矢量图渲染、OCR 驱动编辑、程序化合成、以及大规模 text-to-image 过滤，产出 1.2M 跨学科样本；提供 caption、编辑指令、结构化标注与成对图像（语义差异可控）。并在其上训练“discipline-informed reasoning-generation model”用于 T2I 与编辑（摘要未给出细节）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出训练的生成/编辑模型规模、基线与量化提升；主要信息是数据规模（1.2M）与覆盖学科（数理化生地/CS/经济/历史/音乐/体育）。

summary_en.core_problem: Current image generation/editing models are unreliable on knowledge-intensive diagrams that require disciplinary concepts, symbolic structure, and precise spatial relations; large-scale controllable data is missing.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a million-scale synthetic+filtered dataset and pipeline; useful for multimodal generation/editing pretraining data recipes and controllable edit supervision, but still a data asset for image generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: DisciplineGen-1M is built via vector-graphics rendering, OCR-based editing, curated programmatic synthesis, and large-scale text-to-image filtering, producing captions, edit instructions, structured annotations, and paired images with controlled semantic differences. A discipline-informed reasoning-generation model is trained on top (details not in abstract).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks model sizes, baselines, and quantitative gains; key reported facts are 1.2M samples and broad disciplinary coverage.

recommendation.zh: 把“可验证的图表/符号结构”做成 1M 级生成+编辑数据，这点比模型更值钱；先看数据构建与过滤流程，模型结果当弱信号。
recommendation.en: The 1M-scale diagram/symbolic-structure generation+editing data is the real value; read the pipeline/filtering, treat model claims as weak until numbers are checked.

paper.title: Phantom References: Hallucinated Citations That Survive Peer Review at Top-Tier Conferences
paper.abstract: Large language models can generate polished scientific text that includes unsupported claims, allowing hallucinations to enter the archival record. Assessing this risk via technical statements is difficult and often requires expert judgment, but citations provide a more auditable surface: a reference either resolves to a real scholarly work with compatible authorship, or it does not.   We measure citation hallucination in peer-reviewed proceedings using a conservative definition limited to ident

summary.core_problem: 解决如何大规模、可审计地衡量学术论文中由 LLM 生成或辅助生成的幻觉引用，并评估其是否已经进入顶会正式发表记录的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测与审计方法。它不直接推进预训练，但对训练数据质量、合成文本污染、以及模型生成内容进入公开语料后的反馈回路有现实意义，尤其适合作为 data contamination 与 synthetic text quality 讨论的旁证。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 RefChecker，一个多源书目信息解析与核验流水线：先将参考文献解析并对接多个 bibliographic source，未解析项再升级到 web-search 复核。定义上只统计 identity-level failures，即不存在的论文或作者列表严重不匹配，刻意排除 venue/year 漂移、发表状态变化和轻微姓名变体等噪声。
summary.experiments: 他们将 RefChecker 应用于 ICLR、ICML、NeurIPS 等顶会已接收 camera-ready 论文，审计其中的 citation hallucination。摘要未给出具体比例数字，但强调这些幻觉引用可以穿过同行评审并进入档案记录。对 LLM 研究的价值主要在于审计 protocol，而非模型比较。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Mark Russinovich 与 Ram Shankar Siva Kumar，均与微软安全和平台方向有较高知名度；这使论文更像一篇面向学术生态与生成式 AI 风险的系统审计工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to audit hallucinated citations in scientific papers at scale, and whether such LLM-style citation failures are already surviving peer review into the archival literature.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation and auditing pipeline. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it matters for data quality, synthetic-text contamination, and the feedback loop where generated content re-enters public corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build RefChecker, a multi-source bibliography verification pipeline. It resolves references against multiple bibliographic databases and escalates unresolved cases to web-search re-verification. The audit uses a conservative definition focused only on identity-level failures: non-existent works and major author-list mismatches.
summary_en.experiments: RefChecker is applied to accepted camera-ready papers from top ML conferences including ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. The abstract does not provide exact rates, but the central finding is that hallucinated citations can survive peer review and enter the archival record. The value for LLM researchers lies more in the audit protocol than in model comparison.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Mark Russinovich and Ram Shankar Siva Kumar, both well known in Microsoft’s platform and security ecosystem, which makes this paper read as a systems-style audit of generative-AI risk in the scientific pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 不是一线相关，但它提醒了一个脏反馈回路：模型生成的假引用会回流成训练语料；只看审计定义和 RefChecker 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Not directly pretraining work, but it flags a dirty feedback loop: generated fake citations can flow back into training corpora; read the audit definition and RefChecker design, skip the rest.

paper.title: World-Model Collapse as a Phase Transition
paper.abstract: Water looks unchanged as it warms, then at a critical point it boils. We ask whether long-horizon language agents show an analogous transition in their implicit world models. In some parameter settings, changing state load by a small amount, or adding a single step of horizon, leaves behavior nearly unchanged; near a critical boundary, the same small change causes a sudden world collapse. We study this effect in a deterministic task family with exact per-step gold state. A large grid search over

summary.core_problem: 研究长程语言 Agent 的隐式世界模型是否会在状态负载或任务 horizon 小幅增加时出现突然崩塌。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和可测量现象提出。它把长程 Agent 失败从平均性能下降改写为相变式边界问题，并区分世界状态保真度与动作合法性两个层面的失败。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造一个确定性任务族，带有精确的逐步 gold state。通过网格搜索状态基数、依赖密度、horizon、branching、观测模式和 mutation rate，绘制 solved plateau、transition band 和 collapse floor 组成的 phase diagram。逐步 trace 用于判断错误先出现在状态维护还是动作选择。
summary.experiments: 实验采用可控合成任务而非真实开放环境。摘要称大规模网格搜索发现窄转移带；逐步轨迹显示 world-state fidelity 先于 action validity 下降；更强模型可以移动临界边界，但不能消除这种定性相变。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-horizon language agents undergo abrupt implicit world-model collapse when state load or horizon increases slightly.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic analysis and a measurable failure phenomenon. It reframes long-horizon agent degradation as a phase-boundary problem and separates world-state fidelity from action validity.
summary_en.technical_approach: It builds a deterministic task family with exact per-step gold states. A grid search varies state cardinality, dependency density, horizon, branching, observation mode, and mutation rate to produce a phase diagram with a solved plateau, a narrow transition band, and a collapse floor. Per-step traces are used to identify whether errors first appear in state maintenance or action choice.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use controlled synthetic tasks rather than open-ended real environments. The abstract reports a narrow transition band, state-fidelity failure before action-validity failure, and stronger models shifting the critical boundary without removing the qualitative transition.

recommendation.zh: 读 phase diagram 和 per-step trace；toy setup 不能外推太远，但它给长程 Agent 失败一个可复现实验形状。
recommendation.en: Read the phase diagram and per-step traces; the toy setup limits extrapolation, but it gives long-horizon agent failure a reproducible shape.

paper.title: DataEvolver: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Data Construction for Text-Rich Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-rich image generation is one of the most challenging settings in image generation, since models must simultaneously produce visually realistic images and render legible, semantically aligned, and layout-consistent text. Existing data pipelines usually follow a static crawl-filter-freeze paradigm. They collect candidate samples, filter them once, and freeze the accepted data for training. However, rejected samples are usually discarded, although they often contain useful failure signals such

summary.core_problem: 解决文本丰富图像生成中训练数据构建静态、一次性过滤后无法利用失败样本反馈的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献在数据构建流程而非模型本身。虽然任务是 text-rich image generation，离 LLM 预训练有一层距离，但“把 rejected samples 变成下一轮数据策略信号”这个思路，对预训练数据筛选、课程式构建和合成数据闭环有可迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DataEvolver，多智能体自演化数据构建框架。Retriever 收集候选样本，Verifier 给出质量分与拒绝原因，Critic 汇总轮次级失败模式形成语义反馈，Generator/策略模块据此更新后续构建策略。与 crawl-filter-freeze 的静态管线不同，它把数据构建视为带反馈的策略演化过程。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练轮数或数据量，也未说明相对哪些 text-rich image generation baseline 提升多少；从设定看，实验重点应是数据集质量提升以及下游生成模型在文本可读性、语义一致性、布局一致性上的改进。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the static crawl-filter-freeze pipeline for text-rich image generation data, where rejected samples are discarded instead of being used as feedback.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily about data construction rather than model design. The task is image generation, but the idea of turning rejected samples into signals for the next data-construction round is transferable to pretraining data curation and synthetic-data loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: DataEvolver is a self-evolving multi-agent data construction framework: a Retriever gathers candidates, a Verifier scores quality and rejection causes, a Critic summarizes round-level failure patterns into semantic feedback, and the construction policy is updated accordingly. This replaces a static one-shot filtering pipeline with a feedback-driven loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, or exact gains over baselines. The likely evaluation focuses on improved dataset quality and downstream gains in text legibility, semantic alignment, and layout consistency for text-rich image generation.

recommendation.zh: 任务偏图像生成，但“拒绝样本别扔，拿来更新数据策略”这点值得借到 pretrain data pipeline；只看数据闭环设计即可。
recommendation.en: The task is image generation, but the key lesson is reusable: rejected samples should update the data policy rather than be discarded; read it for the data loop only.

paper.title: Diff-Based Code Corruption using LLMs for Large-Scale Bugfix Benchmarking
paper.abstract: There are various benchmarks to evaluate bugfixing capabilities of Large Language Models. However, most widespread benchmarks do not fully reflect real-world bugfixing practices. They are small, weakening statistical reliability, and the buggy programs are often similar to one another, potentially distorting evaluation results. The range of bug types can also be narrow, failing to capture a representative range of bugs. To address these issues, we introduce MegaBugFix, a large-scale bugfixing be

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是代码修复评测集规模小、样本相似、bug 类型偏窄的问题，尤其是现有 LLM 合成 bug 容易生成语法错误或过于浅层的扰动，不能稳定衡量模型的真实修复能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更接近代码模型与代码智能体的评测资产。可取之处在于它把“用 LLM 生成坏样本”从直接改写代码改成生成 diff，并用人类提交中的 accepted/wrong-answer 对来训练 bug 注入器。这对构造代码训练数据、代码修复 SFT 数据和 verifier 数据有一定参考价值，但它不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一，从 Project CodeNet 中按同一用户、同一题目配对 accepted 提交和 wrong-answer 提交，并用 rapidfuzz 相似度过滤，只保留相似度至少 70% 的 correct/buggy 程序对，作为微调数据。第二，微调一个开源 LLM，让它从正确代码生成表示 bug 注入的 diff，而不是直接生成完整错误代码。这样做的动机是减少“输出与输入完全相同”的编辑失败，也减少直接改写时常见的语法级错误。第三，把训练好的 corruption model 应用于来自 6 个公开来源的正确 Python 程序，生成大规模 buggy variants，并统一不同来源的测试用例执行接口。
summary.experiments: 产物是 MegaBugFix，包含 12,629 个错误 Python 程序、对应正确版本和统一评测框架。论文指出，DebugBench 与 CodeEditorBench 中相当比例的 Python 样本不可解析，例如 DebugBench 的 832/1414，以及 CodeEditorBench Primary 的 312/716、Plus 的 193/356。MegaBugFix 的设计目标是减少这类语法错误，增加语义型 bug 和多样性。关键实验应主要看生成 bug 的可解析率、测试失败率、bug diff 规模分布，以及不同代码修复模型在该 benchmark 上的 pass@1/pass@k 表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看数据构造流程、CodeNet 配对规则、diff 生成微调设置、过滤与统一测试框架。若关注代码模型 post-training 数据，可以多看 bug diff 的分布和质量控制。若只关注 LLM 预训练，这篇的主要价值是数据合成范式，不需要细读模型评测排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical weakness in bug-fixing evaluation: common benchmarks are small, structurally repetitive, and biased toward narrow or shallow bug types. Existing LLM-based corruption methods often create syntactic failures rather than realistic semantic bugs.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect. The main contribution is an evaluation and data-generation asset for code repair models. The useful idea is to train a corruption model on human accepted/wrong-answer pairs and make it emit diffs instead of full rewritten programs. This can inform synthetic data pipelines for code repair SFT, verifier training, or code-editing evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline starts from Project CodeNet. Accepted and wrong-answer Python submissions are paired by user and task, then filtered with a rapidfuzz similarity threshold of at least 70%. These correct/buggy pairs are used to fine-tune an open-weight LLM for code corruption. Instead of producing an entire buggy program, the model generates a diff. This choice reduces identity edits and makes the corruption operation explicit. The trained model is then applied to correct programs collected from six public sources, and their heterogeneous test suites are wrapped into a unified execution framework.
summary_en.experiments: The resulting benchmark, MegaBugFix, contains 12,629 buggy Python programs with correct counterparts and executable tests. The paper contrasts this with prior synthetic bug datasets where many Python samples are not parseable, such as 832/1414 in DebugBench and 312/716 plus 193/356 in two CodeEditorBench splits. The most informative results are the parseability and validity checks of injected bugs, the distribution of diff sizes and bug types, and pass@1/pass@k repair performance of LLMs under the unified harness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the dataset construction pipeline, the CodeNet pairing rule, the diff-generation fine-tuning setup, and the filtering/evaluation harness. For code post-training data work, inspect the bug quality analysis. For pretraining research, the benchmark leaderboard is less important than the corruption-data recipe.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫数据构造和模型排名差异；合成 bug 有偏，但能暴露小型修复集对代码模型的乐观估计。
recommendation.en: Skim the data construction and ranking shifts; synthetic bugs are biased, but the benchmark usefully exposes optimism in small bug-fix sets.

paper.title: Goku: A Million-Scale Universal Dataset and Benchmark for Instruction-Based Video Editing
paper.abstract: Existing instruction-based video editing datasets commonly focus on single-task appearance editing, failing to meet the complex creative demands of real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present Goku, a large-scale dataset featuring 2 million high-quality, instruction-aligned video editing pairs, which is the first to extend task boundaries from basic appearance editing to multi-task and structural manipulations(e.g., precise control of subject movement). To tackle the data synthesis chall

summary.core_problem: 现有指令驱动视频编辑（IVE）数据集多局限于单任务和外观层面的修改（如物体移除、属性替换），缺乏对多任务、结构形变（如相机运动、主体运动）及参考引导编辑等复杂真实场景的支持。
summary.importance: 构建了迄今为止规模最大、任务最全面的指令视频编辑数据集 Goku，首次将任务边界扩展至结构和多任务编辑，并提出了配套的基准测试和模型，为复杂视频编辑研究提供了重要的数据基础设施。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 数据集构建：设计了可扩展的自动化数据生成 pipeline，将复杂编辑指令分解为可控的子问题，并利用特定任务的专家模型处理。2. 质量控制：引入基于 Gemini2.5-Pro 的渐进式过滤系统，在指令对齐、帧间稳定性和感知真实感三个维度进行过滤，确保数据质量。3. 模型设计：提出 Goku-Edit，采用 MLLM 作为文本编码器，并引入额外的掩码预测分支增强空间定位能力，使主分支更专注于细粒度外观细节。4. 评测基准：建立 Goku-Bench，包含 1000 个测试用例和 7 个专门指标，并经过人工验证。
summary.experiments: Goku 数据集包含 200 万对高质量视频编辑数据。在 Goku-Bench 上的实验表明，Goku-Edit 模型在指令遵循方面比现有 SOTA 模型提升了高达 8%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注第 3 节关于复杂编辑指令分解和渐进式过滤系统的设计，以及第 4 节 Goku-Edit 模型中掩码预测分支的具体实现。这对于理解如何构建高质量复杂视频编辑数据和提升模型空间定位能力有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing instruction-based video editing (IVE) datasets are mostly limited to single-task and appearance-level modifications (e.g., object removal, attribute replacement), lacking support for complex real-world scenarios such as multi-task editing, structural deformations (e.g., camera movement, subject movement), and reference-guided editing.
summary_en.importance: Introduces Goku, the largest and most comprehensive IVE dataset to date, extending the task boundaries to structural and multi-task editing for the first time. It also provides a corresponding benchmark and model, serving as a crucial data infrastructure for complex video editing research.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Dataset Construction: Designs a scalable and automated data generation pipeline that decomposes complex editing instructions into controllable sub-problems, handled by task-specific expert models. 2. Quality Control: Introduces a progressive filtering system powered by Gemini2.5-Pro to filter data across instruction alignment, frame-to-frame stability, and perceptual photorealism. 3. Model Design: Proposes Goku-Edit, which uses an MLLM as the text encoder and incorporates an additional mask prediction branch to enhance spatial grounding, allowing the main branch to focus on fine-grained appearance details. 4. Benchmark: Establishes Goku-Bench with 1,000 test cases and 7 specialized metrics, all human-verified.
summary_en.experiments: The Goku dataset contains 2 million high-quality video editing pairs. Experiments on Goku-Bench show that the Goku-Edit model achieves up to an 8% improvement in instruction following compared to existing SOTA models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the design of complex editing instruction decomposition and the progressive filtering system, and Section 4 for the specific implementation of the mask prediction branch in the Goku-Edit model. These provide insights into constructing high-quality complex video editing data and improving model spatial grounding.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“视频编辑预训练数据工程手册”：重点看合成分解+渐进过滤的可靠性设计；模型结构部分先别太当真，等看清baseline与协议。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a playbook for video-editing pretraining data: focus on task decomposition + progressive filtering for reliability; be cautious about model claims until baselines/protocols are clear.

paper.title: Beyond MoCap: Scaling Motion Tokenizers with Synthetic Human Motion for Generative Modeling
paper.abstract: Human motion generation models are fundamentally constrained by the limited diversity of motion capture datasets, which predominantly contain common, repetitive actions and fail to cover the long tail of complex human movements, resulting in a restricted motion vocabulary in learned latent representations and poor generalization to rare, compositional, and highly dynamic motions. In this work, we propose a framework for expanding the motion representation space by leveraging large-scale syntheti

summary.core_problem: 现有人类动作生成模型的离散tokenizer受限于真实动作捕捉（MoCap）数据集的多样性不足，无法覆盖长尾复杂动作，导致表示空间受限、泛化性差。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出合成数据与tokenizer codebook联合缩放的范式，为离散tokenizer的词汇扩展提供了可迁移的思路。
summary.technical_approach: 构建大规模物理可信的合成人类动作数据生成管线，扩展训练数据分布；同时设计适配该扩展分布的改进VQ-VAE tokenizer，联合缩放训练分布与离散codebook的大小，以捕获更丰富的动作基元。
summary.experiments: 提供的摘要未披露具体合成数据规模、codebook大小、基线模型及量化效果，仅提及该方法可显著扩展动作表示空间，提升对稀有、组合、高动态动作的泛化能力。
summary.authors_note: 达特茅斯学院团队，无知名预训练领域作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete tokenizers for human motion generation are limited by the low diversity of real motion capture (MoCap) datasets, which fail to cover long-tail complex motions, resulting in restricted representation space and poor generalization.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a paradigm of jointly scaling synthetic training data and tokenizer codebook, providing transferable insights for vocabulary expansion of discrete tokenizers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a large-scale physically plausible synthetic human motion generation pipeline to expand the training distribution; designs an improved VQ-VAE tokenizer adapted to the expanded distribution, and jointly scales the training distribution and discrete codebook size to capture richer motion primitives.
summary_en.experiments: No specific synthetic data scale, codebook size, baselines, or quantitative results disclosed in the provided abstract; only mentions that the method significantly expands the motion representation space and improves generalization to rare, compositional, and highly dynamic motions.
summary_en.authors_note: Dartmouth College team; no well-known pretraining researchers identified.

recommendation.zh: 特定模态的tokenizer改进，仅看§3的合成数据管线与codebook联合缩放设计即可，思路可迁移到文本/多模态tokenizer的长尾覆盖优化。
recommendation.en: Modality-specific tokenizer improvement; only read §3 for synthetic data pipeline and joint codebook-data scaling design, insights transferable to long-tail optimization of text/multimodal tokenizers.

paper.title: Dataset Usage Inference without Shadow Models or Held-out Data
paper.abstract: How much of my data was used to train a machine learning model? Dataset Usage Inference (DUI) aims to answer this by estimating what fraction of a dataset contributed to a model's training. However, existing DUI methods rely on assumptions that rarely hold in practice: they require training expensive shadow models to imitate the target model, and they assume access to both known training samples and an in-distribution held-out set confirmed to be absent from training. These conditions make curre

summary.core_problem: 如何在不训练昂贵的影子模型（shadow models）且没有可信的、未参与训练的保留数据集（held-out data）的情况下，推断某个数据集有多大比例被用于训练目标生成模型（Dataset Usage Inference, DUI）？
summary.importance: 为大模型时代的数据版权和合规审计提供了一种切实可行的方案。传统的 DUI 方法（如 DUCI）依赖影子模型和保留数据，这在动辄数十亿参数的现代生成模型面前计算成本极高且不切实际。本文提出的 NU-DUI 框架将计算成本降低了三个数量级，使得对大型自回归或扩散模型的训练数据审计成为可能。
summary.technical_approach: 将 DUI 转化为混合比例估计（Mixture Proportion Estimation, MPE）问题。核心创新在于构建合成的非成员参考集：1) 使用与目标模型不同架构的生成器对可疑数据集进行图像到图像（img2img）的重写，生成合成的非成员样本；2) 使用重写过程中相同的自编码器对可疑数据集进行自编码，以消除生成器伪影带来的分布偏移，使得成员和非成员之间的差异主要由是否参与训练决定；3) 提取针对目标模型家族定制的成员推断攻击（MIA）特征；4) 应用 MPE 估计成员比例。
summary.experiments: 在五个大型图像生成模型（包括自回归和扩散模型，如 RAR-XXL）上进行了验证。在 RAR-XXL 上，对于 1000 张图像的可疑集，NU-DUI 仅需 42.5 分钟（A100），而传统方法需要 1500 多小时，加速比超过 2000 倍。同时，估计误差（MAE）保持在 0.1 以下（例如 0.058），接近需要可信保留数据的理想情况。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Method 部分，特别是如何通过 img2img 重写和自编码对齐来构建合成非成员参考集的设计，这是本文最巧妙的地方。实验部分可以关注其在不同模型架构（自回归 vs 扩散）上的鲁棒性表现。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to infer the fraction of a dataset used to train a target generative model (Dataset Usage Inference, DUI) without training expensive shadow models or requiring a trusted held-out dataset?
summary_en.importance: Provides a practical solution for data copyright and compliance auditing in the era of large models. Traditional DUI methods (like DUCI) rely on shadow models and held-out data, which are computationally prohibitive and impractical for modern generative models with billions of parameters. The proposed NU-DUI framework reduces computational costs by three orders of magnitude, making training data auditing feasible for large autoregressive or diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Casts DUI as a Mixture Proportion Estimation (MPE) problem. The core innovation lies in constructing a synthetic non-member reference set: 1) Paraphrasing the suspect dataset using an image-to-image generator from a different family than the target model to create synthetic non-member samples; 2) Autoencoding the suspect dataset using the same autoencoder used during paraphrasing to align generator artifacts, ensuring the residual distribution shift is dominated by membership; 3) Extracting Membership Inference Attack (MIA) features tailored to the target model family; 4) Applying MPE to estimate the member ratio.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on five large-scale image generative models (both autoregressive and diffusion, e.g., RAR-XXL). On RAR-XXL with a suspect set of 1,000 images, NU-DUI takes only 42.5 A100 minutes, compared to over 1,500 hours for traditional methods, achieving a speedup of over 2,000x. The estimation error (MAE) remains well below 0.1 (e.g., 0.058), closing the gap to the oracle setting that requires trusted held-out data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section, particularly the design of constructing the synthetic non-member reference set via img2img paraphrasing and autoencoding alignment, which is the most ingenious part of the paper. In the experiments, pay attention to its robustness across different model architectures (autoregressive vs. diffusion). Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关注预训练数据版权合规的团队可参考其合成非成员样本+混合比例估计的思路，仅读§3方法部分即可，文本LLM场景需单独复现验证。
recommendation.en: For teams focused on pretraining data copyright compliance, refer to the synthetic non-member + mixture proportion estimation pipeline in §3; replicate on text LLMs before production adoption.

paper.title: PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
paper.abstract: Recent game world models can synthesize visually plausible, action-conditioned rollouts. However, their interaction behaviors often remain limited to exploratory or wandering trajectories, and physical dynamics are typically learned as implicit correlations from data rather than as controllable variables. This limitation hinders their applicability to authored game environments, where physical rules are deliberately designed and require explicit manipulation. We introduce PhysEditWorld, a multim

summary.core_problem: 构建一个可控制物理参数的游戏世界模型数据集，使模型能学习同一动作轨迹在不同重力条件下产生的可归因变化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态世界模型数据资产。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但受控 replay-and-render 数据构造方式对 embodied/world-model 预训练的数据设计有参考意义，尤其是把物理变量从相关性中显式拆出来。
summary.technical_approach: PhysEditWorld 基于 UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline：记录归一化 action trace，然后在相同初始状态、角色控制器、动作序列和相机策略下，用不同 gravity configuration 重放并渲染，从而形成成对、可控、可归因的物理变化数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示数据集包含 12 个 cinematic UE5 scenes，并围绕 gravity 作为首个版本的核心物理参数；具体样本规模、训练模型、baseline 和指标在给定信息中不完整。论文重点更偏数据构建，而不是提出新的生成模型结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a dataset for physics-editable game world models, enabling models to observe attributable changes under different gravity settings for the same action trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a multimodal world-model dataset contribution. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the controlled replay-and-render design is relevant to data construction for embodied and generative world models, especially for disentangling physical variables from raw correlations.
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysEditWorld uses a UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline. It records normalized action traces and replays the same initial state, character controller, action sequence, and camera policy under multiple gravity configurations, producing controlled paired data for physical variation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the dataset contains 12 cinematic UE5 scenes and focuses on gravity in the initial release. The provided information does not fully specify dataset size, trained model scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The main contribution is the data-generation protocol.

recommendation.zh: 可看数据构造思路，不必读模型细节；受控重放比随机视频采集更像 world-model 预训练该要的数据。
recommendation.en: Worth noting for the data protocol, not the model details; controlled replay is closer to useful world-model pretraining data than random video scraping.

paper.title: Autodata: An agentic data scientist to create high quality synthetic data
paper.abstract: We introduce Autodata, a general method that enables AI agents to act as data scientists who build high quality training and evaluation data. We show how to train (meta-optimize) such a data scientist agent, so that it learns to create even stronger data. We describe the overall formulation, and a specific practical implementation, Agentic Self-Instruct. We conduct experiments on computer science research tasks, legal reasoning tasks and reasoning with mathematical objects, where we obtain impro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题是：如何把更强的推理时计算转化成更高质量的训练数据和评测数据，而不是只用固定 prompt 做 Self-Instruct 式生成。核心目标不是生成更多样本，而是让一个 agent 像数据科学家一样创建、检查、迭代数据，并进一步学习如何更好地创建数据。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练数据研究的启发在于，它把合成数据生成从一次性 prompting 推向了闭环优化。数据不再只是模型采样的副产物，而是由 challenger、solver、verifier 和主控 agent 共同塑形的对象。这个方向适合用于构造推理训练数据、困难负例、benchmark 样本，以及 SFT/RL 的训练集。需要注意的是，当前贡献更偏方法框架和实践范式，离大规模预训练数据配比或数据质量定律还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: Autodata 的基本结构包含两个循环。内层循环由数据创建和数据分析组成：agent 基于 grounding context 生成样本，再检查样本是否正确、是否足够困难、是否能区分弱模型和强模型，然后把分析结果反馈给下一轮生成。外层循环是对这个“数据科学家 agent”本身做 meta-optimization，即优化 agent harness、prompt、工具使用和决策策略，使它更擅长产生有效数据。具体实现 Agentic Self-Instruct 使用四类子 agent：Challenger 生成样本，Weak solver 尝试解题，Strong solver 提供较强解答，Verifier/judge 检查答案和样本质量。对于可验证任务，可以要求强模型多数投票正确、弱模型多数投票错误；对于不可完全验证任务，则用 judge 根据 rubric 估计强弱解答的质量差距。相比传统 Self-Instruct，它显式把“难度控制”和“样本质量检查”放进生成流程，而不是先生成再简单过滤。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖计算机科学研究任务、法律推理任务、数学对象推理任务。结果显示，Agentic Self-Instruct 相比经典合成数据创建方法带来更好的训练或评测效果；进一步对数据科学家 agent 做 meta-optimization 后，提升更明显。文中提供的内容强调了弱/强 solver 间隔、verifier 反馈和多轮迭代的重要性，但当前给出的全文片段没有暴露完整表格中的逐任务数字、样本规模和提升幅度，因此不宜补写具体数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Autodata 总体框架图和 Agentic Self-Instruct 的实现图，理解它如何把 challenger、weak solver、strong solver、verifier 组织成数据创建闭环。实验部分主要看三个问题：一是它相对普通 Self-Instruct 的增益是否来自样本难度而非样本数量；二是 verifier 的可靠性如何影响数据质量；三是 meta-optimization 优化的是哪些 agent 决策。若关注预训练数据，值得深挖的是 support/coverage、difficulty 和 verifier noise 这些因素未来能否形成可测的数据质量指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to convert additional inference-time compute into better training and evaluation data, rather than relying on one-shot Self-Instruct-style prompting. The target is not merely to generate more examples, but to build an agentic data scientist that creates, audits, and iterates on data, and can itself be meta-optimized.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining and post-training data work is the shift from static synthetic data generation to a closed-loop data construction process. Synthetic data is treated as an object to be shaped by a challenger, solvers, a verifier, and a controller, rather than as raw model samples followed by light filtering. This is most directly useful for reasoning data, hard negatives, benchmark construction, and SFT/RL data generation. The contribution is currently closer to a practical framework than to a scaling law or a large-scale pretraining data recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Autodata has an inner loop and an outer loop. The inner loop alternates between data creation and data analysis: an agent grounds on source material, generates examples, checks whether they are correct and challenging, measures whether they separate weak and strong models, and feeds the lessons back into the next generation pass. The outer loop meta-optimizes the data scientist agent itself, including its harness, prompts, tool use, and decision policy. The concrete implementation, Agentic Self-Instruct, uses a main orchestrator and four LLM-based subagents: a Challenger that creates examples, a Weak solver expected to fail on many generated cases, a Strong solver expected to solve them, and a Verifier/judge that evaluates both solutions and example quality. For verifiable tasks, the intended criterion is often that the strong solver majority is correct while the weak solver majority is wrong. For less verifiable tasks, the judge scores the gap using generated rubrics. Compared with standard Self-Instruct, the key addition is explicit difficulty control and iterative quality analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover computer science research tasks, legal reasoning, and reasoning over mathematical objects. Agentic Self-Instruct improves over classical synthetic dataset creation baselines, and meta-optimizing the data scientist agent provides an additional gain. The supplied full-content excerpt describes the setup and qualitative findings, but does not expose the complete per-task tables, dataset sizes, or exact improvement numbers, so the safe reading is about mechanism and design rather than precise effect size.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Autodata template and the Agentic Self-Instruct diagram, especially how the challenger, weak solver, strong solver, and verifier form a feedback loop. In the experiments, check whether gains come from harder examples rather than just more examples, how verifier errors are controlled, and what exactly is optimized during meta-optimization. For pretraining-data researchers, the useful thread is whether coverage, difficulty, solver gap, and verifier noise can become measurable data-quality signals.

recommendation.zh: 把合成数据流程改成可元优化的智能体闭环思路有参考价值，目前实验仅覆盖后训练推理任务，看§3方法和§4.2消融即可
recommendation.en: The meta-optimizable agent loop for synthetic data is a useful reference; experiments only cover post-training reasoning tasks, read §3 method and §4.2 ablation only

institutions: ) has concentrated on agentic methods for architectural or training recipe

paper.title: Sarashina2.2-TTS: Tackling Kanji Polyphony in Japanese Speech Generation via Data Scaling and Targeted Data Synthesis
paper.abstract: While large language model (LLM)-based text-to-speech (TTS) systems have achieved high-quality speech synthesis, most existing systems focus on English and Chinese. Japanese, however, remains under-explored, and its unique linguistic challenges, such as widespread context-dependent kanji polyphony, have yet to be adequately tackled. Here we introduce Sarashina2.2-TTS (https://github.com/sbintuitions/sarashina2.2-tts), a Japanese-centric LLM-TTS system that tackles these challenges through a dual

summary.core_problem: 解决现有LLM-based日语TTS系统对上下文依赖的汉字多音歧义建模不足的问题
summary.importance: 数据贡献（361k小时日英混合语料+定向合成常用汉字语料）、基准贡献（Joyo Kanji Yomi Benchmark）、工程突破（开源日语TTS系统）
summary.technical_approach: 采用双策略：1）数据scaling：训练语料扩展至361k小时，平衡日语与英语数据配比；2）定向数据合成：构建覆盖日本文化厅指定2136个常用汉字的增强语料，针对性解决多音歧义；同时配套构建汉字读音评测基准
summary.experiments: 提供的摘要被截断，未完整披露实验量化结果，仅提及通过数据scaling与定向合成策略解决日语汉字多音问题，并开源系统与评测基准
summary.authors_note: 论文未披露所属机构，开源项目由sbintuitions团队维护

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses insufficient modeling of context-dependent kanji polyphony (reading ambiguity) in existing LLM-based Japanese TTS systems, which are under-explored compared to English and Chinese counterparts
summary_en.importance: Data contribution (361k hours of Japanese-English mixed speech corpus + targeted synthesized kanji corpus), benchmark contribution (Joyo Kanji Yomi Benchmark), and engineering breakthrough (open-source Japanese TTS system)
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts a dual strategy: 1) Data scaling: expands training corpus to 361k hours with a balanced Japanese-English mixture; 2) Targeted data synthesis: builds an augmented corpus covering all 2,136 Joyo kanji designated by Japan's Agency for Cultural Affairs to resolve polyphony ambiguity; also releases a matching kanji reading evaluation benchmark
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract is truncated and does not disclose full quantitative experimental results; only mentions the data strategy and open-sourced system/benchmark for Japanese kanji polyphony resolution
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliations are not disclosed in the provided information; the open-source project is maintained by the sbintuitions team

recommendation.zh: 特定语言语料的scaling+定向合成策略对多语言预训练数据设计有参考，仅看数据策略一节即可，无需读TTS细节
recommendation.en: The scaling + targeted synthesis strategy for language-specific corpora is informative for multilingual pretraining data design; only read the data strategy section, skip TTS-specific details

paper.title: An LMM for Precisely Grounding Elements in Documents
paper.abstract: Visual grounding in documents is a crucial ability for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in areas such as document understanding, deep research and document error detection. However, existing approaches exhibit poor grounding precision in text-rich document images, often failing to accurately locate the critical document elements needed for reliable reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce PreciseDoc, an LMM specifically designed for precise element grounding and can be further optimized for Do

summary.core_problem: 提升大多模态模型在文本密集型文档图像中的元素级精确定位能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是文档 LMM 的定位数据构造和训练范式，属于多模态理解的专门能力建设。它对 VLM 预训练的可迁移启发在于：文档场景需要细粒度坐标监督，普通图文对齐不足以支撑可靠 grounding。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PreciseDoc，并构建两条可批量生产训练数据的流水线，生成带细粒度坐标元数据的高质量文档，包括带相机效果的合成手填文档。训练目标从单文本定位扩展到真实功能型定位，例如在简历中定位个人信息，并进一步服务 Document VQA。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练样本规模、baseline 和具体提升幅度。实验声称模型可进一步优化 Document VQA，但可验证细节需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve element-level precise grounding for large multimodal models on text-rich document images.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a document-focused LMM training and data-construction approach. Its transferable lesson for VLM pretraining is that document grounding requires fine-grained coordinate supervision; generic image-text alignment is usually not enough.
summary_en.technical_approach: PreciseDoc uses two data-generation pipelines to mass-produce high-quality documents with fine-grained coordinate metadata, including synthetic hand-filled documents with camera effects. The training setup goes beyond locating single text spans and covers functional localization, such as finding personal information in CVs, with possible downstream optimization for Document VQA.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training-data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. It states that the model can be further optimized for Document VQA, but the concrete evidence requires the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 文档 grounding 数据工程味较重；只看数据生成流水线即可，作为 VLM 坐标监督的备查。
recommendation.en: This is mostly document-grounding data engineering; skim the data-generation pipeline as a reference for coordinate-supervised VLM training.

paper.title: Geometry-Instructed Video Editing
paper.abstract: Object-level geometric edits, including translating, rotating, scaling, duplicating, or removing an object, are routine operations in digital content creation (DCC) workflows, yet they remain unreliable in generative video editing. The key challenge lies in specifying the target object's 3D state change unambiguously across viewpoint and time, while consistently updating geometry-dependent secondary effects such as shadows and reflections. We introduce GIVE, a geometry-instructed video editing f

summary.core_problem: 解决生成式视频编辑中物体级几何操作难以精确指定、跨时间和视角不稳定、且阴影反射等几何相关效应难以同步更新的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成/编辑中的条件表示和合成监督数据管线。它对统一多模态预训练不是核心工作，但对几何条件如何进入视频生成模型有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GIVE，用统一 object-state formulation 表示平移、旋转、缩放、复制和删除等操作；使用两个 video-aligned geometry streams：depth-box 编码编辑前后 3D 位置和范围，orientation-box 提供与外观无关的朝向线索；通过 graphics-engine pipeline 构造 paired supervision。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明构建了可扩展图形引擎数据管线用于成对监督，但未给出模型规模、数据量、baseline、指标或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles object-level geometric video editing, where translation, rotation, scaling, duplication, and removal are hard to specify precisely and often fail to update shadows, reflections, and temporal geometry consistently.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a conditioning representation and synthetic paired-supervision pipeline for video generation/editing. It is not central to unified multimodal pretraining, but it is useful background for geometry-conditioned video models.
summary_en.technical_approach: GIVE represents edits with a unified object-state formulation. Two video-aligned geometry streams specify pre- and post-edit states: a depth-box for coarse 3D placement and extent, and an orientation-box for appearance-agnostic orientation. A graphics-engine pipeline supplies paired supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions a scalable graphics-engine pipeline for paired training data, but does not provide model scale, dataset size, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 看几何条件表示和数据管线即可；它是视频编辑工程，不是统一建模范式变化。
recommendation.en: Read only the geometry-conditioning design and data pipeline; this is video-editing engineering, not a shift in unified modeling.

paper.title: One Image is All You Need: Agentic One-Shot Image Generation via Text-Based World Models for Long-Tail Spatial Perception
paper.abstract: Reliable spatial decision automation, such as autonomous driving and maritime surveillance, critically depends on robust visual perception. However, real-world spatiotemporal data exhibits severe heterogeneity, often manifesting as extreme long-tail distributions for safety-critical scenarios. This data scarcity induces dataset shift that degrades detection performance and pose safety risks. While synthetic data generation offers a potential solution, existing generative approaches, such as diff

summary.core_problem: 在长尾安全关键场景数据稀缺下，如何从单张参考图出发生成具备空间一致性与结构约束的场景数据，用于提升空间感知/决策系统鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏生成式数据合成框架：把“单图→结构化场景表示→受约束生成”做成agentic流水线，针对长尾空间关系一致性问题；对多模态数据合成（用于训练/评测）有一定参考，但更偏CV生成而非LLM基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: WMGen-v1：用大型VLM从单张图构建结构化场景表示（显式空间/对象关系），再由LLM进行规划/约束生成流程（文本世界模型/场景脚本），最后驱动扩散/GAN类生成器产出满足空间约束的合成图像（摘要未给出具体生成器与约束实现细节）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据与定量指标；主要宣称在长尾空间感知数据生成上比无显式结构约束的生成方法更一致、更可控（需看正文的空间一致性度量、下游检测/定位增益与消融）。

summary_en.core_problem: Under long-tail data scarcity for safety-critical spatial perception, how to generate spatially consistent, structurally constrained scenes starting from a single reference image.
summary_en.importance: A generative data synthesis pipeline: it operationalizes an agentic “single image → structured scene → constrained generation” workflow for long-tail spatial consistency. Some relevance as multimodal synthetic data tooling, but it’s closer to CV generation than foundation LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: WMGen-v1: a large VLM extracts a structured scene representation from one image; an LLM acts as a planner/world-model to produce constrained textual scene specifications; a generative model (e.g., diffusion/GAN) renders images that satisfy spatial/physical constraints (exact generator/constraints not detailed in the abstract).
summary_en.experiments: No model sizes, training data, or quantitative results are provided in the abstract; claims improved spatial/physical consistency over unconstrained generators (check main paper for metrics, downstream gains, and ablations).

recommendation.zh: 当作“结构化场景→受约束生成”的数据合成思路备查即可；除非正文给出干净的空间一致性指标和下游增益，否则对基座预训练帮助有限。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for “structured scene → constrained generation” data synthesis; unless the paper has clean spatial-consistency metrics and downstream gains, it won’t move pretraining decisions.

paper.title: FreeStyle: Free Control of Style-Content Dual-Reference Generation from Community LoRA Mining
paper.abstract: Style-content dual-reference generation aims to synthesize an image that preserves the structure and semantics of a content reference while adopting the style of a separate style reference.Despite recent progress, this setting remains challenging because models must balance content fidelity, style alignment, and instruction following avoiding semantic leakage from the style reference.A key bottleneck is the lack of large-scale triplet data with clean content-style separation and broad long-tail

summary.core_problem: 解决双参考图像生成中内容参考、风格参考难以解耦的问题，即既保持内容结构和语义，又采用另一张图的风格，同时避免风格参考带入语义泄漏。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成的数据与训练框架，重点在大规模 style-content triplet 构造和解耦训练；对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性有限，但 community LoRA mining 作为弱结构化数据来源有可借鉴之处。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FreeStyle，将社区 LoRA 视为风格和内容的组合锚点，围绕多个 base model 设计生成和过滤管线，构造 Style-Reference 与 Content-Reference 三元组。训练上采用两阶段 curriculum，并使用阶段特定的 disentanglement 机制；摘要提到包含 attention-level enrichment 约束，以缓解内容泄漏和风格语义混入。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体训练集规模、模型参数量、基线和数值提升。可确认的是，数据覆盖多个 base model，并面向风格-内容双参考生成进行训练与评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles dual-reference image generation: preserving the structure and semantics of a content reference while adopting the style of a separate style reference without semantic leakage.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a multimodal generation data-and-training framework, centered on large-scale style-content triplet construction and disentangled training. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but community LoRA mining is an interesting weakly structured data source.
summary_en.technical_approach: FreeStyle treats community LoRAs as compositional anchors for style and content, then builds a generation and filtering pipeline to create Style-Reference and Content-Reference triplets across multiple base models. Training uses a two-stage curriculum with stage-specific disentanglement mechanisms, including attention-level constraints mentioned in the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report dataset size, model scale, baseline names, or numerical gains. It does state that the pipeline spans multiple base models and targets style-content dual-reference generation.

recommendation.zh: 可略看数据管线：community LoRA 当标签和锚点的思路能借鉴到合成偏好数据，但图像风格任务偏窄。
recommendation.en: Skim the data pipeline: using community LoRAs as labels and anchors may transfer to synthetic preference data, though the task is narrow.

paper.title: The Significance of Style Diversity in Annotation-Free Synthetic Data Generation
paper.abstract: Generating high-utility synthetic data for intent classification typically requires human-annotated seed data, which is often unavailable in fast-paced industrial settings. In this paper, we propose a framework for synthetic dialogue generation that works entirely without human-annotated data, relying solely on intent definitions. Our proposed dialogue generation framework utilizes two different types of topic and style attributes to improve data diversity. Also, we propose two novel post-hoc st

summary.core_problem: 在没有人工标注种子数据的情况下，如何仅凭 intent 定义生成足够有用的合成对话数据，并提升其风格多样性与训练价值。
summary.importance: 这是一篇合成训练数据工作，虽然面向 intent classification 而非基座预训练，但对后训练数据合成有一个可迁移的点：风格多样性可能比主题多样性更影响数据效用。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 annotation-free 的对话生成框架，只使用 intent definitions 生成样本；在生成时显式控制 topic 和 style 两类属性，并设计两个事后风格化模型 Univ 与 Exam，把 LLM 生成的 utterance 改写成更丰富、更接近人类的表达；最后用 LLM-as-a-judge 做质量过滤。
summary.experiments: 在工业和公开数据集上，合成数据训练得到的模型性能可达到人工标注训练数据的 93.3%。核心经验结论是 style diversity 比 topic diversity 更关键。摘要未给出底座模型规模、过滤成本或 judge 误差分析，因此结论更适合作为弱先验，而非直接照搬。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to generate useful synthetic dialogue data from intent definitions alone, without any human-annotated seed data, while preserving enough diversity to train downstream models well.
summary_en.importance: This is a synthetic training-data paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it offers one transferable lesson for post-training data generation: stylistic diversity may matter more than topical diversity for utility.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework generates dialogues using only intent definitions, explicitly modeling both topic and style attributes. It then applies two post-hoc stylization models, Univ and Exam, to rewrite LLM-generated utterances into more varied and human-like styles, followed by LLM-as-a-judge filtering for quality control.
summary_en.experiments: On industrial and public datasets, the resulting synthetic data reaches up to 93.3% of the performance obtained with human-annotated training data. The main empirical claim is that style diversity is more important than topic diversity. The abstract does not provide enough detail on model scale, filtering cost, or judge reliability, so the result should be treated as a useful hint rather than a settled recipe.

recommendation.zh: 增量型合成数据论文，但“style diversity 比 topic diversity 更值钱”这个结论值得记下；只看消融和过滤策略，别把任务结果当通用规律。
recommendation.en: Incremental synthetic-data work, but the claim that style diversity matters more than topic diversity is worth pocketing; read the ablations, not the task score.

paper.title: Critical Percolation as a Synthetic Data Model for Interpretability
paper.abstract: Neural networks learn features that reflect the hierarchical, multi-scale structure of natural data. Synthetic datasets used to evaluate interpretability methods typically lack this structure, limiting their value as realistic toy models. To close this gap, we introduce a family of synthetic datasets consisting of hierarchical functions defined on critical mean-field percolation clusters embedded in a high-dimensional data space. The percolation data consists of sparse, low-dimensional fractal c

summary.core_problem: 现有可解释性 toy dataset 往往缺少自然数据常见的层级、多尺度结构，导致方法在玩具环境中的结论很难外推到真实神经网络表征。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析侧的数据建模工作，贡献不在提出新的解释方法，而在构造一个更接近真实数据统计结构、同时又可解析的合成数据分布，供 interpretability 研究做更干净的受控实验。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出基于临界平均场渗流簇的合成数据族：数据点分布在稀疏、低维、分形结构的高维簇上，簇大小服从幂律分布；标签由带分类层级的潜变量生成。方法上利用渗流簇、随机树与 additive coalescence 的对应关系，设计近线性时间的联合采样算法，同时采样随机树结构及其层级 latent decomposition。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模或标准 baseline 数字，重点更像是数据生成机制与理论可解析性，而非大规模神经网络 benchmark。可预期实验会围绕生成数据的统计性质、层级结构恢复、以及作为 interpretability testbed 的适用性展开，但从摘要看还不足以支持强经验结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Typical toy datasets for interpretability lack the hierarchical and multi-scale structure of natural data, so conclusions drawn from them often fail to transfer to realistic representation learning settings.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-oriented data-modeling paper. Its value is not a new interpretability method, but a more realistic yet analytically tractable synthetic distribution for controlled interpretability experiments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a family of synthetic datasets built from critical mean-field percolation clusters. Samples lie on sparse, low-dimensional fractal clusters in a high-dimensional space, with cluster sizes following a power law. Labels are generated by latent variables with a taxonomic hierarchy. Using a mapping among percolation clusters, random trees, and additive coalescence, the authors derive an almost linear-time joint sampler for both the random tree and its hierarchical latent decomposition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scales, benchmark baselines, or headline quantitative gains. The emphasis appears to be on the statistical properties and analytical tractability of the data model rather than large-scale neural benchmarking. Any empirical value likely comes from showing that the generated data better supports interpretability studies than standard toy datasets.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但如果你做表征机制或想找更像自然数据的 toy setup，可先看数据构造；没有大规模训练结论，不必深读。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining material, but worth knowing if you care about representation probes or better toy worlds; read for the data model, not for training conclusions.

paper.title: From Bounding Boxes to Visual Reasoning: An On-Policy Data Annotation Tool for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are rapidly advancing toward sophisticated grounded structured visual reasoning. Training models for such advanced capabilities demands a new genre of data that seamlessly unifies spatial coordinates, open-vocabulary descriptions, structured attributes, and topological relationships into a singular representation. However, existing data annotation tools fundamentally fail to meet these intricate demands, suffering from three systematic bottlenecks: limited expressiv

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 训练数据标注表达力不足、标注流程与模型训练脱节、标注资产难复用的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 数据基础设施与标注 schema。它不直接提出新的 VLM 架构或预训练目标，但对构造 grounded visual reasoning 数据有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出开源工具 ScreenAnnotator。核心包括统一 annotation atom schema，将空间坐标、开放词表语义、结构属性和拓扑关系绑定为一个标注单元；引入带 Bayesian Annotation Verifier 的 on-policy 标注循环，让当前模型参与数据生产和校验；再用模板驱动的多任务数据合成，把静态标注转换为多种训练样本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 或量化提升；主要可见贡献是工具、数据表示和标注流程，而不是已验证的大规模训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of expressive and reusable annotation infrastructure for training VLMs on grounded structured visual reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is data infrastructure for VLM training: a schema, an annotation workflow, and template-based data synthesis. It does not directly introduce a new architecture or pretraining objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScreenAnnotator defines a unified annotation atom that binds coordinates, open-vocabulary semantics, structured attributes, and topological relations. It adds an on-policy annotation loop with a Bayesian Annotation Verifier, then uses templates to turn static annotations into multi-task training data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The main artifact appears to be the annotation tool and data-generation pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 只看 schema 和 on-policy 标注循环即可；对 VLM 数据管线有参考，但不是基座训练 recipe 的强信号。
recommendation.en: Read the schema and on-policy annotation loop; useful for VLM data pipelines, but not a strong signal for foundation-model training recipes.

paper.title: Want Better Synthetic Data? Steer It: Activation Steering for Low-Resource Language Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become an effective tool for synthetic data generation, including for low-resource languages, where generated data can improve downstream task performance. Current best-performing approaches typically rely on few-shot prompting with target-language examples, which increases inference costs and may reduce diversity through lexical anchoring. In this work, we investigate activation steering as an alternative for low-resource synthetic data generation. We study two

summary.core_problem: 解决低资源语言合成数据生成依赖 few-shot 示例、成本较高且容易被示例词汇锚定的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 activation steering 的应用分析。它与预训练数据没有直接关系，但对控制 LLM 生成分布、语言身份向量和质量向量的可迁移性有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 研究两类 steering：Language Steering 通过激活方向增强目标语言身份；Quality Steering 通过对比人工文本与回译文本的表示来捕捉文本良构性。方法在 zero-shot 和 few-shot prompt 下都施加 steering，并比较不同开源 LLM、层位置和语言类型。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 4 个开源 LLM、11 种类型差异较大的低资源语言，生成情感分类和主题分类数据，再微调小分类器评估下游效果。摘要未给出具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies 与 DFKI。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to generate synthetic data for low-resource languages without relying heavily on few-shot target-language examples.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an application-oriented analysis of activation steering. It is not pretraining-data work, but it gives a useful signal about controllable generation, language identity directions, and quality directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: It evaluates two steering strategies: Language Steering, which targets linguistic identity, and Quality Steering, which contrasts human-written text with backtranslated text to capture well-formedness. Steering is tested under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers four open-source LLMs and 11 typologically diverse languages. It generates sentiment and topic classification data, then trains smaller classifiers for downstream evaluation. The abstract does not report exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies and DFKI.

recommendation.zh: 作为 activation steering 备查即可；任务太下游，真正有用的是层位置和语言方向的消融。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an activation-steering reference; the task is downstream, and the useful bits are the layer and language-direction ablations.

institutions: German Research Institute for Artificial Intelligence
Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies, Bratislava, Slovakia

paper.title: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Foundation models in language and multimodality achieve strong generalization by aligning heterogeneous data under a unified formulation and training at scale. In this report, we investigate whether this scaling recipe can be applied to robotic manipulation to achieve genuine generalization. This is challenging because, unlike text, manipulation data is heterogeneous by nature, expensive to collect, and narrow in diversity, making alignment and scale simultaneously difficult.
