- SynAE 的 validity/fidelity/diversity 指标能区分这些受控退化；
- 单一指标不足以刻画合成数据质量，需要组合视角；
- 通过加入“下游评测一致性”可以发现某些表面相似但会改变 agent 评测结论的合成偏差。
（你提供的正文片段未包含完整结果表与具体数值，因此无法可靠复述每个 benchmark 上的定量提升幅度或阈值设置。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看框架定义：validity/fidelity/diversity 各自覆盖哪些对象（指令/回复、tool call、工具输出、最终输出、下游表现）。
- 重点看 fidelity 的“先算两边指标再比相似度”的设计，以及 diversity 的表示选择（在哪些层面算熵）。
- 快速扫实验里“人为注入缺陷”的合成策略：这些最像真实工程里会踩的坑。
- 如果你做的是预训练/后训练数据合成，把它当作“合成数据 QA checklist”，而不是新的建模方法。

summary_en.core_problem: When real multi-turn tool-calling traces are unavailable (privacy, sparsity), teams rely on synthetic datasets for agent evaluation—but lack quantitative ways to tell whether the synthetic benchmark truly matches and/or usefully extends the real distribution, or whether it will distort evaluation outcomes. The paper proposes a framework to measure synthetic benchmark quality for tool-calling agents, rather than proposing a better agent.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model work is indirect: it provides an engineering-style quality-control layer for synthetic evaluation data, explicitly accounting for tool calls and multi-step dependencies. This is useful for post-training data generation and regression testing of agentic systems, reducing the risk that synthetic benchmarks look plausible yet shift model rankings or success rates. It does not contribute to core pretraining recipes or optimization dynamics; it is closer to evaluation infrastructure for agents.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SynAE takes a real baseline dataset, a synthetic dataset, and optional metric configs plus one or more LLM agents (used only to compare downstream behavior on real vs synthetic). It reports three properties:
- Validity: whether synthetic tool calls/outputs actually satisfy the instructions (LLM-as-judge by default; rule-based checkers when available).
- Fidelity: how similar real and synthetic datasets are, computed by extracting metrics on each side and comparing their agreement.
- Diversity: entropy-based measures over representations of instructions/responses, tool calls, outputs, etc.
Metrics are computed across multiple trajectory components (instructions/responses, tool calls, final outputs) and also include downstream evaluation consistency (running an agent on both datasets to see whether performance conclusions are preserved). The paper also creates synthetic datasets with controlled failure modes (reduced fidelity, limited diversity) to test metric sensitivity.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
- Read the formal definitions of validity/fidelity/diversity and which trajectory components each covers.
- Focus on the fidelity design (compute metrics on both datasets, then compare) and the diversity representation choices (where entropy is computed).
- Skim the synthetic “pitfall injection” setups; they map well to real-world failure modes.
- Treat it as a synthetic-data QA checklist for agent evaluation, not as a modeling contribution.

recommendation.zh: 只看 metric taxonomy 和 failure cases；对预训练没直接动作，但能校准 agent eval 合成数据的可信边界。
recommendation.en: Read the metric taxonomy and failure cases; no direct pretraining action, but it calibrates how much to trust synthetic agent-eval data.

paper.title: Terminal-World: Scaling Terminal-Agent Environments via Agent Skills
paper.abstract: Terminal agents extend Large Language Models with the ability to execute tasks directly in command-line environments, but their progress is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality training data. Existing approaches bootstrap from partial sources such as human-defined seeds or GitHub repositories to instantiate one component and then complete the rest, producing tasks confined to narrow seed distributions, environments misaligned with task semantics, and inefficient trajectories from unguide

summary.core_problem: terminal agent 的训练数据稀缺，现有自动化构造方法依赖人工 seed 或仓库素材，导致任务分布窄、环境与任务语义错位、轨迹质量差。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 数据合成方向的工作。对基座预训练本身帮助有限，但对后训练阶段如何系统地产生 terminal-use 轨迹、构造更广覆盖的 agent curriculum 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Terminal-World，把 agent skills 作为合成原语，同时编码做什么、何时做、如何做，据此共同生成任务指令、环境和 teacher trajectory。进一步通过 skill teams 与 skill graphs 组合技能，扩展到多角色和跨领域任务，目标是扩大 terminal 环境中的任务空间并提升轨迹质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度。按描述，实验重点应是与人工 seed 或 GitHub bootstrap 方法比较任务多样性、环境一致性和轨迹效率。若没有强基线和人工验证，结论更适合作为数据工程信号而非稳定方法论。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Beihang University、Beijing Institute of Technology、University of Edinburgh 等。不是顶级实验室范式工作，但题目切中 terminal agent 数据瓶颈。

summary_en.core_problem: Training data for terminal agents is scarce, and existing automated pipelines rely on human seeds or repository bootstrapping, leading to narrow task distributions, environment-task mismatch, and poor trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent data-synthesis paper. It is not directly about foundation-model pretraining, but it may be useful for post-training researchers thinking about systematic terminal-use trajectory generation and broader agent curricula.
summary_en.technical_approach: Terminal-World uses agent skills as the synthesis primitive, jointly encoding what to do, when to apply it, and how to execute it. From these skills, it co-derives task instructions, environments, and teacher trajectories. It further expands the space through skill teams and skill graphs for multi-role and cross-domain tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains. The likely evaluation compares against human-seed or GitHub-bootstrap pipelines on diversity, semantic alignment, and trajectory efficiency. Without strong baselines and human validation, the conclusions should be treated more as data-engineering signals than stable methodology.
summary_en.authors_note: From Beihang University, Beijing Institute of Technology, and the University of Edinburgh. Not a top-lab paradigm paper, but it targets a real bottleneck in terminal-agent data.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent 训练数据工厂，不是基座论文；看它如何把 skill 变成任务/环境/轨迹共生成，若你做 agent post-train 可借鉴，其他人看摘要够了。
recommendation.en: This is more a data factory for terminal-agent post-training than a foundation-model paper; read it only for the skill-to-task/environment/trajectory synthesis idea.

paper.title: When Does Model Collapse Occur in Structured Interactive Learning?
paper.abstract: The proliferation of generative artificial intelligence has given rise to an interactive learning environment, where model parameters are continuously updated using not only data generated by natural processes, but also synthetic outputs produced by other models. This paradigm introduces two major challenges: (1) training data are no longer drawn exclusively from the target population, undermining a core assumption of classical statistical learning, and (2) model training processes become inhere

summary.core_problem: 结构化交互式学习场景下（多模型互相使用对方的合成输出迭代训练），经典统计学习的独立同分布假设失效，模型塌陷的发生条件与影响机制缺少严格的理论刻画。
summary.importance: 当前公共数据源中合成数据占比持续提升，多模型迭代训练的持续预训练场景越来越普遍，该研究给出了模型塌陷发生的边界条件，为合成数据治理、持续预训练的数据源设计提供了理论依据。
summary.technical_approach: 首先提出有向图框架建模多模型之间的交互式训练依赖关系，边A→B表示模型A的输出会作为模型B的训练数据。分别在线性回归和通用M估计的设置下，推导多轮交互式训练后模型参数的迭代更新方程，给出参数收敛到真实分布、出现偏差或完全塌陷的充分必要条件。
summary.experiments: 合成数据线性回归任务上，理论推导的参数收敛与塌陷条件得到验证：当交互式依赖图存在强连通分量且合成数据占比超过阈值时，模型参数会逐步偏离真实分布。MNIST和CIFAR-10图像分类任务上，多模型循环使用对方输出训练时，分类精度随训练轮数持续下降，与理论预测的塌陷趋势一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的场景定义与贡献、第2章的交互式有向图建模框架、第3和4章的核心结论、第5章的实验结果，跳过附录的所有证明部分，预计阅读时间40分钟。
summary.authors_note: 康奈尔大学运筹学与信息工程学院、哥伦比亚大学统计系、宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院统计与数据科学系

summary_en.core_problem: In structured interactive learning scenarios where multiple models are continuously trained on synthetic outputs generated by each other, the i.i.d. assumption of classical statistical learning is violated. There lacks rigorous theoretical characterization of the conditions and mechanisms leading to model collapse.
summary_en.importance: As synthetic data accounts for an increasing share of public data sources and iterative multi-model training becomes more common in continual pretraining, this work identifies the boundary conditions for model collapse, providing theoretical basis for synthetic data governance and data source design for continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first proposes a directed graph framework to model interactive training dependencies between multiple models, where an edge A→B indicates outputs of model A are used as training data for model B. It derives iterative update equations for model parameters after multiple rounds of interactive training under both linear regression and general M-estimation settings, and provides sufficient and necessary conditions for parameters to converge to the true distribution, incur bias, or experience complete collapse.
summary_en.experiments: The derived convergence and collapse conditions are first validated on synthetic linear regression tasks: when the interactive dependency graph contains strongly connected components and the proportion of synthetic data exceeds a threshold, model parameters gradually deviate from the true distribution. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 image classification show that classification accuracy degrades continuously as multiple models cyclically train on each other's outputs, consistent with the theoretically predicted collapse trend.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on scenario definition and contributions in Section 1, the directed interactive graph framework in Section 2, core conclusions in Sections 3 and 4, and experimental results in Section 5. Skip all proofs in the appendix. Estimated reading time: 40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Cornell University School of Operations Research and Information Engineering, Columbia University Department of Statistics, University of Pennsylvania Wharton School Department of Statistics and Data Science

recommendation.zh: 做合成数据预训练的研究员可参考其推导的模型坍缩边界，用于调整训练语料的合成数据占比约束
recommendation.en: Researchers using synthetic data for pretraining can refer to its derived model collapse boundary to adjust the proportion constraint of synthetic data in training corpus

paper.title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI
paper.abstract: Can AI systems discover genuinely new knowledge through iterative self improvement, and if so, at what cost? We introduce the NOVA framework, which models the common ``generate, verify, accumulate, retrain'' loop as an adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space. We identify sufficient conditions under which accumulated genuine knowledge eventually covers a finite domain, and show how their violations produce distinct failure modes: contamination, forgetting, exploration failure, and accept

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 AI 系统通过“生成候选、验证、累积、再训练”的循环能否发现新知识，以及发现成本如何随时间增长。它把自训练、形式化证明、自博弈和递归合成数据训练放到同一个抽象框架里，核心关注四个瓶颈：模型是否能采到目标知识、验证器是否能识别有效样本、训练后是否保留已发现知识、未知知识前沿是否会变得越来越稀薄。
summary.importance: 对预训练和自改进研究的启发在于，它把“用模型生成数据再训练模型”的问题从经验技巧提升到可分析的采样过程。结论比较克制但有用：自举发现并不只受模型能力限制，还受候选分布尾部、验证误报率、遗忘和支持集覆盖共同约束。尤其是污染陷阱值得关注。当前沿有效样本概率下降时，固定的 false positive rate 会变得不安全，错误样本可能比真实新知识更快进入知识库。这对 RL self-training、自动合成 reasoning data、形式化验证数据闭环都有直接警示。
summary.technical_approach: NOVA 将知识发现建模为有限或可数知识空间上的自适应采样。模型在环境候选空间中生成 artifact，验证器决定接受或拒绝，已接受样本进入知识库，并影响后续模型分布。论文分别刻画了成功覆盖有限知识域所需的充分条件，以及条件破坏后的失败模式：reachability 不足导致 exploration failure；验证器拒绝有效样本导致 acceptance failure；训练后概率质量从已发现知识上消失导致 forgetting；无效样本被接受导致 contamination。相比只讨论 model collapse 的工作，NOVA 不只看递归训练造成的分布退化，而是把生成分布、验证质量、知识保留和未知前沿同时纳入分析。论文还区分了 Good–Turing 的 batch unseen mass 和长期发现过程中的 historically undiscovered valid mass，并在尾部分布近似 Zipf、指数 α>1 的假设下推出发现 D 个不同真实 artifact 的累计生成成本为 Θ(c_gen D^α)。这给“越往后越难发现”的直觉提供了明确的成本律。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇理论建模论文，重点不是实证 benchmark。主要结果是若有限目标知识域中每个有效 artifact 在长期生成过程中保持正可达概率、验证器能接受有效 artifact、训练过程保留已发现知识，则知识覆盖可几乎必然发生。若存在 imperfect verification，论文分析有效样本和无效样本的增长率，得到局部污染阈值：当新有效知识的模型质量变小，验证器可容忍的误报率也必须同步下降；否则即使误报率很小，也会在后期积累污染。发现成本部分给出 R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α)，其中 c_gen 是单个候选生成成本，α 是有效发现前沿的 Zipf 尾指数。这个结果解释了为什么简单扩大采样预算在后期收益下降明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–45 分钟。重点看形式化定义、收敛条件和 imperfect verification 部分。对预训练研究更有用的是 contamination threshold 和 discovery-cost scaling，而不是符号细节。若正在做自动数据合成、proof/RL verifier、self-training 或持续预训练，应仔细看失败模式的划分：它能帮助区分是模型采不到、验证器太弱、训练忘掉，还是知识库被污染。人类专家 amplification 部分也值得扫读，它给出了为什么 frontier 阶段仍需要外部引导的形式化解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether an AI system can discover genuinely new knowledge through a repeated generate–verify–accumulate–retrain loop, and how the cost of discovery scales as the easy part of the domain is exhausted. It frames self-training, formal theorem proving, self-play, and recursive synthetic-data training as instances of the same adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution for pretraining research is a clean separation of the failure modes in model-driven data generation. Discovery is not limited only by model capacity. It also depends on support coverage, verifier quality, retention after retraining, and the probability mass assigned to the remaining unknown frontier. The contamination result is especially relevant for RL-based self-training and synthetic reasoning data pipelines: when valid new samples become rare, a fixed false-positive rate can become unsafe, because invalid artifacts may enter the retained corpus faster than genuine discoveries.
summary_en.technical_approach: NOVA models discovery as adaptive sampling from an ambient candidate space containing valid and invalid artifacts. A generator proposes candidates, a verifier accepts or rejects them, accepted candidates are accumulated, and retraining changes the future sampling distribution. The analysis gives sufficient conditions for almost-sure coverage of a finite target domain and maps violations of those conditions to forgetting, exploration failure, acceptance failure, and contamination. This is broader than standard model-collapse analyses, which mainly focus on distributional degradation under recursive training. The paper also separates Good–Turing batch unseen mass from the historically undiscovered valid mass that drives long-run discovery. Under a tail-equivalence assumption with a Zipf exponent α>1, the cumulative generation cost for discovering D distinct valid artifacts scales as Θ(c_gen D^α).
summary_en.experiments: This is a theoretical paper rather than an empirical benchmark paper. The main results are convergence guarantees under reachability, acceptance, and retention assumptions; failure characterizations when those assumptions break; and a contamination threshold under imperfect verification. The imperfect-verifier analysis shows that as the generator assigns less mass to new valid artifacts, the acceptable false-positive rate must also shrink. The cost law R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α) quantifies the diminishing return of brute-force sampling near the discovery frontier.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. The most relevant parts are the formal setup, the convergence and failure-mode results, the imperfect-verification analysis, and the discovery-cost scaling theorem. For readers working on synthetic data, verifier-guided RL, formal proof generation, or continual pretraining, the contamination and frontier-thinning sections are the parts to read carefully. The human-amplification discussion is also useful because it explains why expert guidance remains valuable when autonomous sampling assigns very low probability to undiscovered valid artifacts.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 self-training、synthetic data 或 model collapse，这篇值得读；它不直接给 recipe，但把“验证器稍差也会越训越脏”讲成了可推演的机制。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care about self-training or synthetic-data loops; it gives no recipe, but it turns “slightly noisy verification poisons the loop” into a clean mechanism worth stress-testing internally.

paper.title: Video-Zero: Self-Evolution Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Self-evolution offers a promising path for improving reasoning models without relying on intensive human annotation. However, extending this paradigm to video understanding remains underexplored and challenging: videos are long, dynamic, and redundant, while the evidence needed for reasoning is often sparse and temporally localized. Naively generating difficult question-answer pairs from full videos can therefore produce supervision that appears challenging but is weakly grounded, relying on sta

summary.core_problem: 现有自进化范式迁移到视频理解领域时存在两个核心瓶颈：一是基于全视频生成的问答对依赖静态视觉或语言先验，未锚定关键时序证据；二是仅以问题难度为优化目标，忽略问题与视频内容的相关性，导致生成的监督信号弱、落地性差。
summary.importance: 提出了无需人工标注的视频多模态大模型自进化路径，为降低视频VLM预训练/微调阶段的标注成本、提升时序推理能力提供了可复用的设计思路。
summary.technical_approach: 采用问答生成器-求解器的协同进化框架，核心设计有三点：1）问答生成器先定位视频中的关键时序证据段，再基于证据段生成问答对，避免全视频无焦点生成；2）生成器的奖励函数同时覆盖可学习性、视频依赖性、证据质量三个维度，不再仅依赖难度指标；3）求解器训练时加入推理证据的时序对齐损失，避免模型依赖答案捷径。
summary.experiments: 在13个视频理解基准上测试了Qwen3-VL、MiMo-VL、InternVL3.5三个系列模型，在时序定位、长视频理解、视频推理三类任务上均获得一致的性能提升，全程未使用人工标注数据。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注方法章节的证据定位机制和奖励函数设计、实验部分的消融实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-evolution paradigms face two key bottlenecks when adapted to video understanding: first, QA pairs generated from full videos rely on static visual or language priors instead of grounded temporal evidence; second, optimization only targets question difficulty while ignoring relevance between questions and video content, leading to weak, poorly grounded supervision signals.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes an annotation-free self-evolution pipeline for video multimodal large models, providing reusable design insights for reducing annotation cost in video VLM pretraining/finetuning and improving temporal reasoning capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework adopts a Questioner-Solver co-evolution loop with three core designs: 1) The Questioner first locates key temporal evidence spans in the video, then generates QA pairs conditioned on these spans to avoid unfocused full-video generation; 2) The reward function for the Questioner covers learnability, video dependency, and evidence quality, instead of using difficulty as the only metric; 3) A temporal alignment loss for reasoning evidence is added to the Solver's training objective to prevent answer shortcut reliance.
summary_en.experiments: Tests are conducted across 13 video understanding benchmarks on three model families: Qwen3-VL, MiMo-VL, and InternVL3.5. Consistent performance gains are observed on temporal grounding, long-video understanding, and video reasoning tasks, with no human annotation used during the entire process.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the evidence localization mechanism and reward function design in the method section, as well as ablation study results in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇真正值得看的点不是视频，而是它把自进化监督的核心从“更难”改成“更有证据”；只看问题生成与 grounding ablation 就够了。
recommendation.en: The real value is not video but the shift from “harder self-evolution” to “better-grounded self-evolution”; read the question-generation and grounding ablations, not the whole benchmark parade.

paper.title: Silent Collapse in Recursive Learning Systems
paper.abstract: Recursive learning -- where models are trained on data generated by previous versions of themselves -- is increasingly common in large language models, autonomous agents, and self-supervised systems. However, standard performance metrics (loss, perplexity, accuracy) often fail to detect internal degradation before it becomes irreversible. Here we identify a phenomenon we call silent collapse: under broad recursive conditions, model internal distributions -- predictive entropy, representational d

summary.core_problem: 递归学习系统（如用自身前版输出训练LLM、伪标签自监督、带偏置奖励的RL）会出现内部表征持续退化，但传统验证指标（损失、困惑度、准确率）无法在退化不可逆前检测到异常，此前的模型坍缩研究也未解决提前预警和无原始真实数据干预的问题。
summary.importance: 为LLM递归自训练、持续学习、RLHF迭代等常用训练范式的健康度监控提供了可落地的观测维度，打破了「验证指标稳定等于训练动态健康」的固有认知，为避免长期迭代过程中的隐性能力退化提供了预警和干预思路。
summary.technical_approach: 定义「静默坍缩」现象：系统内部预测熵、表征多样性、尾部分布覆盖率持续收缩的同时，传统验证指标仍保持稳定甚至提升；识别出三个早于指标恶化出现的轨迹层面前兆：锚点熵收缩、表征漂移冻结、尾部覆盖侵蚀；提出不需要持续接入原始真实数据的MTR框架，仅用初始checkpoint的少量固定锚点样本，通过监控轨迹统计量生成信任估计，自适应调节学习强度。
summary.experiments: 在TinyStories递归语言建模、CIFAR-10递归伪标注两个压力测试场景下验证，MTR比传统指标提前多代检测到坍缩前兆，有效阻止了困惑度的灾难性爆炸。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中静默坍缩与传统模型坍缩的差异部分、静默坍缩三个前兆的定义逻辑、MTR框架的设计思路，预计阅读时间20-25分钟，附录实验细节可按需查看。

summary_en.core_problem: Recursive learning systems, including LLMs trained on outputs of previous versions, self-supervised models with pseudo-labels, and RL agents with biased rewards, suffer from progressive internal representational degradation. Standard validation metrics (loss, perplexity, accuracy) cannot detect this degradation before it becomes irreversible, and prior model collapse research did not address early warning or intervention without continuous access to pristine real data.
summary_en.importance: It provides actionable observation dimensions for health monitoring of common LLM training paradigms such as recursive self-training, continual learning, and iterative RLHF. It challenges the default assumption that stable validation metrics equal healthy training dynamics, and offers a practical framework for early warning and intervention to avoid hidden capability degradation during long-term training iterations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work defines silent collapse, a dynamical regime where internal predictive entropy, representational diversity, and tail distribution coverage shrink progressively while standard validation metrics remain stable or even improve. It identifies three trajectory-level precursors that emerge long before visible metric degradation: anchor entropy contraction, representation drift freezing, and tail coverage erosion. It proposes the MTR framework, which requires no continuous access to pristine real data — only a small fixed set of anchor samples from the initial checkpoint — to monitor trajectory statistics, generate trust estimates, and adaptively adjust learning intensity.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on two stress test scenarios: recursive language modeling on TinyStories and recursive pseudo-labeling on CIFAR-10. MTR detects collapse precursors multiple generations earlier than standard metrics, and effectively prevents catastrophic perplexity explosion.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the difference between silent collapse and traditional model collapse in the introduction, the definition of the three collapse precursors, and the design logic of the MTR framework. Estimated reading time is 20-25 minutes. Appendix experiment details can be reviewed on demand.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 synthetic data 回流或 continual pretrain，这篇至少该看监测指标定义；结论未必稳，但“内部先塌、外部后坏”这个警报值得立刻加进训练面板。
recommendation.en: If you run synthetic-data recursion or continual pretraining, at least inspect the proposed diagnostics; the claim may be setup-sensitive, but the idea that internals fail before metrics do is worth instrumenting immediately.

institutions: China Mobile GBA (Greater Bay Area) Innovation Institute

paper.title: Towards Continuous Sign Language Conversation from Isolated Signs
paper.abstract: Sign language is the primary language for many Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) signers, yet most conversational AI systems still mediate interaction through spoken or written language. This spoken-language-centered interface can limit access for signers for whom spoken or written language is not the most accessible medium, motivating direct sign-to-sign conversational modeling. However, sentence-level sign video data are expensive to collect and annotate, leaving existing sign translation and pro

summary.core_problem: 在句子级手语视频数据稀缺的情况下，构建可用于连续手语对话建模的数据和基线。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态数据构建和合成流程，目标是从孤立手语片段重组连续手语对话；对语音/视频语言建模中的离散动作单元和数据合成有一点参考，但领域较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 把大规模带标签的孤立手语片段视为词汇级动作原语，再根据现有对话语料中的话语顺序和手语语言顺序重组为连续手语 utterance；提出SignaVox-W作为大词汇孤立手语集合，SignaVox-U作为连续手语对话数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要称SignaVox-W是目前最大的带标签孤立手语词汇之一，并构建SignaVox-U用于连续对话；未给出具体词表规模、视频时长、模型参数量、基线和量化效果。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括Yonsei University和Emory University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds data and modeling resources for continuous sign-language conversation under the scarcity of sentence-level sign videos.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal data-construction and synthesis pipeline that recomposes isolated sign clips into continuous sign conversations. It has some relevance to discrete motion units and data synthesis for video-language modeling, but the domain is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: Large-scale labeled isolated sign clips are treated as lexically grounded motion primitives, then recomposed into sign-language-ordered utterances derived from existing dialogue corpora. The paper introduces SignaVox-W as a large isolated-sign vocabulary resource and SignaVox-U as a continuous sign-conversation dataset.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that SignaVox-W provides one of the largest labeled isolated-sign vocabularies and that SignaVox-U supports continuous conversation modeling. It does not provide vocabulary size, video hours, model size, baselines, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Yonsei University and Emory University.

recommendation.zh: 可作为“动作原语重组生成序列数据”的案例备查；手语域太窄，缺少规模和评测细节。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a case of recomposing motion primitives into sequence data; the sign-language domain is narrow and the abstract lacks scale and evaluation details.

paper.title: Query-Conditioned Test-Time Self-Training for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are typically deployed with fixed parameters, and their performance is often improved by allocating more computation at inference time. While such test-time scaling can be effective, it cannot correct model misconceptions or adapt the model to the specific structure of an individual query. Test-time optimization addresses this limitation by enabling parameter updates during inference, but existing approaches either rely on external data or optimize generic self-super

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是单个查询级别的 test-time adaptation：模型在推理时不只增加采样或搜索计算，而是根据当前 query 生成局部训练信号，并临时更新参数来改善回答。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 test-time training 和 post-train / inference 闭环有启发。它把“查询本身包含局部分布信息”作为训练信号来源，试图在不依赖外部检索库的情况下做 per-query 参数适配。这个方向值得关注的原因是，它把推理时算力从纯搜索转向临时学习，可能影响未来模型在预训练阶段是否需要显式支持快速局部适应。
summary.technical_approach: QueST 的流程很直接。给定 query q，先用模型自身或辅助生成器生成一批与 q 结构相近的 problem–solution pairs。这些样本被视为 query 所诱导的局部分布 D(q) 的近似。然后在推理时用这些样本做轻量 LoRA 更新，得到临时参数，再用适配后的模型回答原始 query。它和 TTT-NN 的区别是不用外部相似题检索库；和 TLM 这类最小化输入 perplexity 的方法不同，它显式生成带解答的 query-conditioned supervision，因此训练目标更贴近当前问题所需的推理结构。它和 self-evolving 方法也不同，后者通常做全局数据生成和后续训练，而 QueST 是单 query 条件下的局部更新。
summary.experiments: 作者报告在 7 个数学推理 benchmark 上评测，QueST 相对对应 base model 平均提升 6.44 个百分点，并在 GPQA-Diamond 上展示了数学之外的科学推理泛化。给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格、模型规模、生成样本数量、LoRA rank、更新步数、额外推理成本和消融数字，因此无法核实提升主要来自 query-conditioned 生成、LoRA 更新，还是额外采样计算。阅读时需要特别检查这些控制实验。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟，重点看方法部分的 D(q) 构造、test-time LoRA 更新设置，以及实验中的 cost-normalized 对比。最需要看的消融是：只生成不更新、随机相似题更新、输入 perplexity 更新、不同生成样本数量、不同更新步数、错误伪标签对最终答案的影响。如果没有严格控制推理预算，6.44 个百分点的提升不能直接理解为参数适配本身的收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses per-query test-time adaptation for LLMs. Instead of only spending more inference compute through sampling or search, it builds supervision from the input query itself and performs a temporary parameter update before producing the final answer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant to test-time training and the pretrain–posttrain–inference interface than to base pretraining directly. The useful idea is that an input query may define a local problem distribution, and that generated samples from this local distribution can serve as adaptation data. If this line of work holds up under careful compute controls, it may influence how future pretrained models are designed to support fast local adaptation at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: QueST starts from a query q and generates auxiliary problem–solution pairs conditioned on q, using the base model itself in the described implementation. These generated examples are treated as an empirical approximation to a local distribution D(q) that shares concepts, assumptions, and reasoning patterns with the original query. The model then performs a lightweight LoRA update at test time on these examples, and the adapted parameters are used to answer q. Compared with TTT-NN, it does not require an external retrieval database of similar problems. Compared with objectives such as minimizing the perplexity of the input, it uses explicit query-conditioned problem–solution supervision. Compared with self-evolving methods, it performs localized per-query adaptation rather than global data generation and later training.
summary_en.experiments: The authors report results on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with an average gain of 6.44 percentage points over the corresponding base models. They also evaluate on GPQA-Diamond to test transfer beyond mathematics into scientific reasoning. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete experimental tables, model sizes, number of generated examples, LoRA rank, update steps, inference cost, or ablation numbers. Those details are needed to separate the benefit of query-conditioned generation from the benefit of additional sampling compute and from the LoRA update itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim should take 20–30 minutes. Focus on how D(q) is generated, how the LoRA update is configured, and whether the comparisons are normalized for test-time compute. The most important ablations are generation without parameter updates, random or weakly related generated problems, input-perplexity test-time training, different numbers of generated examples, different update steps, and robustness to wrong pseudo-solutions. Without those controls, the reported 6.44-point gain should be read as a system-level improvement rather than clean evidence for per-query parameter adaptation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain prior，但值得看它如何把“query 自带监督”落成训练目标；先读方法和 ablation，若增益只出现在窄任务上，就当 test-time tuning 的弱信号。
recommendation.en: It likely won’t change your pretraining prior, but it is worth reading for how it turns the query itself into a training signal; read the method and ablations first, and treat it as weak evidence if gains stay narrow.

paper.title: Curated Synthetic Data Doesn't Have to Collapse: A Theoretical Study of Generative Retraining with Pluralistic Preferences
paper.abstract: Recursive retraining of generative models poses a critical representation challenge: when synthetic outputs are curated based on a fixed reward signal, the model tends to collapse onto a narrow set of outputs that over-optimize that objective. Prior work suggests that such collapse is unavoidable without adding real data into the mix. We revisit this conclusion from an alignment perspective and show that collapse can be mitigated through curation based on multiple reward functions. We formalize

summary.core_problem: 该工作讨论递归合成数据训练中的模式坍缩问题：如果每一代模型生成样本，再用固定奖励函数筛选高分样本继续训练，模型分布会逐步集中到少数高奖励区域。作者关心的是，当筛选信号不是单一偏好，而是来自多个相互竞争的偏好时，坍缩是否仍然不可避免。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在合成数据闭环和偏好驱动数据筛选。结论是，坍缩不只由“使用合成数据”决定，也由筛选机制决定。单一 reward 会持续放大同一方向的样本；多个 reward 交替参与筛选时，极限分布可以保留多个高奖励 basin 的质量。这对用 reward model、人工偏好、规则过滤器构造预训练或持续预训练数据有直接参考意义。不过贡献主要是理论模型，不涉及有限容量模型、真实优化器、token 级语言建模和大规模实验，不能直接推出工程配方。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把递归训练建模为一个分布动力系统。每轮从当前模型分布 p_t 采样 K 个候选，用 Bradley-Terry 选择模型按某个 reward 选择一个样本，然后假设重新训练是无约束 MLE，因此下一轮分布 p_{t+1} 等于被选样本的分布。关键推导是：当候选池 K 足够大时，BT 筛选近似等价于对当前分布做 exponential tilt，即按 exp(r_i(x)) 对 p_t 重新加权并归一化。多偏好设置下，每轮 reward 从固定混合分布中抽取，例如两个 reward 的采样权重为 q 和 1-q。作者定义每个 reward 的近最优 basin，并在 outside-basin gap 条件下证明，basin 外质量会逐步衰减，分布集中到多个近最优 basin 的并集。之后，basin 之间的质量分配由 leakage 控制：如果 reward r_1 在 r_2 的 basin 上也能给出较高分，这种交叉强化会改变最终混合比例；当 basin 分离更强、leakage 趋近于零时，最终权重接近 reward 的采样权重。硬分离和 plateau 条件下，极限分布有显式形式，并可解释为带权 Nash bargaining 解。
summary.experiments: 该工作没有常规机器学习实验，主要结果是定理和推论。可记录的技术结果包括：有限 K 的 BT 筛选更新可看作 K→∞ exponential-tilt 更新的扰动；在近最优集合上的偏差项量级为 O(sqrt(log K / K))。在 outside-basin gap 条件下，非近最优区域质量收缩。进入近最优 basin 并集后，任意非退化的双 basin 极限混合都会保持正的 reward 方差，作者还给出 basin 分离条件下的下界。M 个偏好的扩展也被讨论，但核心证明以两个 reward 为主。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 的问题设定，Theoretical Results 中从 BT 选择到 exponential tilt 的 Lemma 3.1/3.2，以及 basin concentration、leakage-controlled mixture、Nash bargaining interpretation 三段。需要判断适用性时，优先看假设：无约束 MLE、固定 reward mixture、bounded reward、large-K 近似、outside-basin gap、hard separation。这些假设决定了结论能否迁移到真实 LLM 合成数据流水线。附录证明可只看关键不等式和有限 K 扰动项，不必逐行细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies mode collapse in recursive synthetic-data training. Prior theory showed that repeatedly generating data, filtering it with a fixed reward, and retraining on the selected samples drives the model toward a narrow high-reward region. The question here is whether the same collapse is unavoidable when curation is driven by multiple, competing preferences rather than a single reward.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is synthetic-data governance. The result separates the risk of using synthetic data from the choice of curation signal. A single reward creates a one-directional amplification loop; a mixture of rewards can maintain probability mass across several high-reward basins. This is useful when thinking about reward-model filtering, rule-based data selection, preference mixtures, and continual pretraining loops. The contribution is theoretical and stylized. It does not model finite-capacity neural networks, token-level language modeling, optimizer dynamics, or large-scale data pipelines, so it should be read as a conceptual model rather than an engineering recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate recursive retraining as a distributional dynamical system. At each iteration, K candidates are sampled from the current model distribution p_t. One candidate is selected by a Bradley-Terry choice rule under a sampled reward, and retraining is idealized as unconstrained maximum likelihood, so p_{t+1} becomes the selected-sample distribution. In the large-candidate regime, the BT selection update becomes an exponential tilt of p_t by exp(r_i(x)), followed by normalization. With pluralistic preferences, the reward is sampled from a fixed mixture, for example with weights q and 1-q for two rewards. The analysis defines near-optimal basins for the rewards and proves that, under an outside-basin gap condition, mass outside the union of these basins decays. Once mass is concentrated inside the basin union, the final split is governed by leakage: how much one reward also reinforces the other reward’s basin. As leakage vanishes under stronger separation, the basin weights approach the reward sampling weights. In an idealized hard-separation and plateau regime, the limit has an explicit mixture form and matches a weighted Nash bargaining solution.
summary_en.experiments: There are no standard empirical experiments. The results are theorem-driven. Key quantitative statements include a finite-K approximation bound: on the near-optimal set, the deviation from the K→∞ exponential-tilt update is O(sqrt(log K / K)). Under the outside-basin gap assumption, probability mass contracts toward the union of near-optimal basins. For any nontrivial two-basin limiting mixture, reward variance remains strictly positive, with lower bounds under basin separation. The paper also sketches the extension from two preferences to M preferences, while the main exposition and proof structure focus on the two-reward case.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction for the motivation, then focus on the Theoretical Results section: the Bradley-Terry-to-exponential-tilt derivation, the basin concentration argument, the leakage-controlled mixture result, and the Nash bargaining interpretation. For applicability, inspect the assumptions before the proofs: unconstrained MLE retraining, fixed reward mixture, bounded rewards, large-K approximation, outside-basin gap, and hard separation. The appendix is useful mainly for the finite-K perturbation bound and the exact conditions behind the mass-decay claims.

recommendation.zh: 从理论上证明多元奖励可缓解合成数据递归训练坍塌，做合成数据后训练循环的可参考核心证明章节
recommendation.en: Theoretically proves that pluralistic rewards mitigate collapse in synthetic data retraining loops, researchers working on synthetic data pipelines can refer to the core proof sections

paper.title: Verifier-Backed Hard Problem Generation for Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities for solving scientific and mathematical problems, yet they struggle to produce valid, challenging, and novel problems - an essential component for advancing LLM training and enabling autonomous scientific research. Existing problem generation approaches either depend on expensive human expert involvement or adopt naive self-play paradigms, which frequently yield invalid problems due to reward hacking. This work introduces VHG, a verifi

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是数学难题自动生成中的奖励欺骗问题。普通 setter-solver 自博弈把“solver 做不出来”当成难度奖励，但 setter 很容易生成无解、错解或表述不完整的问题，从而得到高奖励。VHG 的核心目标是让生成问题的奖励同时依赖有效性和难度。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 post-train 数据生成，但对预训练研究也有启发：难度不是孤立信号，必须和可验证性绑定。对于数学、代码、科学推理这类可部分验证领域，数据生成管线如果只优化模型失败率，很容易把分布推向无效样本。VHG 给出一个清晰的三方结构，可作为持续构造高难训练数据的参考，但它不是通用预训练目标或架构创新。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在传统 setter-solver 自博弈外加入 verifier。setter 不只生成问题 x，还要生成参考解 y*，形成 problem-reference pair。verifier 先判断这个 pair 是否正确；只有通过验证的样本才会进入难度打分和 solver 训练。难度由 solver 的通过率或准确率估计，setter 的高奖励只能来自“有效且 solver 难以解决”的问题。论文讨论了两类 verifier：hard verifier 使用符号验证，适合不定积分这类可形式化检查的环境；soft verifier 使用 LLM 检查逐步推导过程，适合一般数学，但可靠性弱于 hard verifier。和 R-Zero 或普通自博弈相比，关键区别是奖励不再只看 solver 失败，而是先用独立验证器切断无效题目的奖励通道。
summary.experiments: 实验分成不定积分和一般数学两类。不定积分提供了相对干净的 hard verification 环境。VHG 在 AntiderivBench Qualifier、AntiderivBench Competition 和 Integration Stress Test 上分别带来 16.9%、16.6%、21.4% 的 pass@1 提升，并超过包括 R-Zero 在内的基线。一般数学使用 soft verifier，覆盖 MATH、AMC、Minerva、Olympiad、AIME24-26 等 benchmark，整体 pass@1 从 56.8% 提升到 69.0%。论文还报告了一个有意思的现象：setter 和 solver 都基于 Qwen3-4B 时，生成的问题仍能挑战 Qwen3-8B、14B、32B，说明弱模型生成的数据在 verifier 约束下仍可能对更强模型有训练价值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分的三方奖励设计、hard/soft verifier 的定义，以及实验中关于 verifier 作用的消融。最值得关注的是：无 verifier 时为什么会出现无效题目奖励欺骗；加入 verifier 后，训练数据的有效率、难度分布和 solver 性能如何变化。一般数学部分可快速看，重点理解 soft verifier 的边界，而不是只看 benchmark 数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets reward hacking in automatic generation of hard math problems. In a standard setter-solver self-play loop, the setter is rewarded when the solver fails. This creates a direct incentive to generate invalid, underspecified, or incorrectly solved problems. VHG tries to make hardness rewards conditional on validity.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly relevant to post-training data generation, but it carries a useful lesson for pretraining data pipelines: difficulty signals are unsafe unless they are tied to verification. For math, code, and parts of scientific reasoning, optimizing for model failure alone can push generation toward invalid samples. VHG offers a clean three-party template for building harder data over time, although it is not a new pretraining objective or architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: VHG augments the usual setter-solver game with an independent verifier. The setter produces both a problem x and a reference solution y*, rather than only a problem. The verifier first accepts or rejects this pair. Only accepted pairs are used for difficulty scoring and solver training. Difficulty is estimated by solver performance, so a high setter reward must come from a valid problem that the solver cannot solve. The paper considers hard verifiers, based on symbolic checking, for domains such as indefinite integration, and soft verifiers, based on LLM judgment over step-by-step derivations, for broader math. The main departure from R-Zero-style self-play is that solver failure is no longer sufficient for reward; validity gates the reward.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers indefinite integration and general math. In the indefinite integration setting, where hard verification is available, VHG improves pass@1 by 16.9%, 16.6%, and 21.4% on AntiderivBench Qualifier, AntiderivBench Competition, and Integration Stress Test, respectively, outperforming baselines including R-Zero. In general math with a soft verifier, the paper reports gains across MATH, AMC, Minerva, Olympiad, and AIME24-26, raising aggregate pass@1 from 56.8% to 69.0%. A useful observation is that a Qwen3-4B setter and solver can generate problems that challenge larger Qwen3-8B, 14B, and 32B models, suggesting that weaker generators can still produce useful training data when validity is enforced.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the three-party reward formulation, the distinction between hard and soft verification, and the ablations around verifier removal. The key mechanism to inspect is how invalid problems exploit a naive hardness reward, and how verifier gating changes the distribution of accepted data. The general-math section is worth reading for the limitations of soft verification rather than for benchmark numbers alone.

recommendation.zh: 做 reasoning 数据合成的人该看：它把 reward hacking 的根因拆成 validity 与 difficulty 两路信号，三方博弈比常见 self-play 干净得多。
recommendation.en: If you work on reasoning-data synthesis, read this: it cleanly separates validity from difficulty, and the three-player game is a better reward design than standard self-play.

institutions: Hong Kong Institute of AI for Science, City University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Position: the Stochastic Parrot in the Coal Mine. Model Collapse is a Threat to Low-Resource Communities
paper.abstract: Model collapse, the degradation in performance that arises when generative models are trained on the outputs of prior models, is an increasing concern as artificially generated content proliferates. Related critiques of large language models have highlighted their tendency to reproduce frequent patterns in training data, their reliance on vast datasets, and their substantial environmental cost. Together, these factors contribute to data degradation, the reinforcement of cultural biases, and inef

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论生成内容进入训练语料后造成 model collapse，并指出这种分布退化会更严重地伤害低资源语言和边缘化群体。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是观点与风险分析，不是新的训练方法。它把 model collapse、数据尾部分布丢失、文化偏差和训练资源效率放在同一个问题框架里，提醒预训练数据治理不能只看主流语言和高频模式。
summary.technical_approach: 论文是 position paper，主要通过整合已有 model collapse 论文、随机鹦鹉批评、环境成本讨论和低资源社区风险来构造论证。它没有提出新的建模目标或数据过滤算法，而是强调合成数据污染对长尾分布的非均匀影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要未显示新的实证实验、模型规模或训练数据设置。主要证据来自已有研究和概念分析，结论适合作为数据治理议题的背景材料，而不是可直接复现的技术结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that model collapse from training on generated content disproportionately harms low-resource languages and marginalized communities.
summary_en.importance: This is a position and risk-analysis contribution rather than a new training method. It connects model collapse, tail-distribution loss, cultural bias, and inefficient resource use, making a data-governance point relevant to pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper synthesizes existing work on model collapse, stochastic-parrot critiques, environmental cost, and low-resource data scarcity. It does not introduce a new objective or filtering method; the central claim is that synthetic-data contamination has uneven effects across the data distribution.
summary_en.experiments: No new empirical setup, model scale, or training-data experiment is described in the abstract. The evidence appears to come from prior literature and conceptual argumentation, so the paper is best treated as background for data governance rather than a technical result to reproduce.

recommendation.zh: 作为 synthetic-data 风险备查即可；没有新实验，但低资源尾部退化这个 prior 值得放进数据审计清单。
recommendation.en: Use it as background on synthetic-data risk; no new experiments, but tail degradation for low-resource data belongs on a data-audit checklist.

paper.title: Self-Improvement for Fast, High-Quality Plan Generation
paper.abstract: Generative models trained on synthetic plan data are a promising approach to generalized planning. Recent work has focused on finding any valid plan, rather than a high-quality solution. We address the challenge of producing high-quality plans, a computationally hard problem, in sub-exponential time. First, we demonstrate that, given optimal data, a decoder-only transformer can generate high-quality plans for unseen problem instances. Second, we show how to self-improve an initial model trained

summary.core_problem: 研究如何让生成模型在规划任务中快速产生高质量计划，而不只是找到任意可行解。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用规划中的自改进训练流程，介于 Agent planning、合成数据训练和推理时搜索之间。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对“模型生成候选 + 搜索改进 + 再训练”的闭环有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 先验证 decoder-only transformer 在最优计划数据上能泛化到未见问题实例；再从次优数据训练初始模型，通过多次模型采样和图搜索生成更短、更优的计划，并把这些改进计划用于下一轮微调。推理时还可叠加搜索进一步提升计划质量。
summary.experiments: 在 Blocksworld、Logistics、Labyrinth、Sokoban 四个规划域上实验。摘要报告相对源符号规划器平均减少 30% 计划长度，在已知最优解的任务中超过 80% 计划达到最优；模型延迟随复杂度呈次指数增长。摘要未给出模型规模和训练数据量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how generative models can produce high-quality plans quickly, rather than merely finding any valid plan.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a self-improvement loop for generalized planning, sitting between agent planning, synthetic data generation, and inference-time search. It is not a direct pretraining paper, but the model-sample-search-retrain loop is relevant to training pipelines for reasoning agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first show that a decoder-only Transformer trained on optimal plans can generate high-quality plans for unseen instances. Starting from a model trained on suboptimal data, each self-improvement round uses multiple model calls plus graph search to produce improved plans, then fine-tunes the model on those plans. Additional inference-time search further improves quality.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers Blocksworld, Logistics, Labyrinth, and Sokoban. The abstract reports an average 30% reduction in plan length over the source symbolic planner and over 80% optimal plans where optima are known; model latency scales sub-exponentially with complexity. Model size and training-data scale are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座训练论文；可把自改进循环当 planning 数据合成模板，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper; keep the self-improvement loop as a planning-data synthesis template, but no need to read deeply.

paper.title: Controllable and Verifiable Process Data Synthesis for Process Reward Models
paper.abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) rely on high-quality process supervision data, yet existing construction methods often provide limited control over error location, error type, and trajectory consistency. We propose a controllable and verifiable framework for synthesizing process supervision data for PRMs. Our framework first constructs a correct symbolic reasoning chain, injects a template-aware error into an intermediate step, recomputes subsequent steps under the corrupted state, and verifies tha

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 PRM 数据构造里一个很具体但很关键的问题：现有自动化过程监督数据往往只能粗糙地产生“对/错”轨迹，却很难精确控制首个错误出现在哪一步、属于哪一类错误，以及错误出现后后续推导是否仍然自洽。对于训练 process reward model 来说，这三个属性都很重要，因为 PRM 真正要学的是 step-level 诊断能力，尤其是 first-error localization，而不是只给整条链打一个总分。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train / reasoning supervision 基础设施。但如果你关心 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口，这篇有现实意义：高质量过程监督数据的瓶颈不在于再多采样几条 CoT，而在于能否构造出可验证、可控、错误传播合理的负样本。很多 PRM 训练失败，不是模型不会判错，而是训练数据里的错误轨迹本身不干净，首错位置不准，或者后续步骤只是机械翻转标签而不符合真实推理分布。这篇方法把“错误样本质量”从弱启发式提升到符号可验证层面，对后续 PRM、step verifier、search reranking 都有帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计比较工整，核心是四步链路。第一步，先构造一条经过符号验证的正确推理链 C+。这部分沿用了 ProverGen 一类 LLM+symbolic prover 的思路，从目标结论反向展开，再验证每一步是否可由当前前提推出，只保留 truth-consistent 的链。第二步，在中间某一步 k 注入一个模板感知的错误。这里不是从全局错误分布里随便采样，而是根据该步所实例化的 rule template 约束错误类型，比如改错结论、误用规则方向、破坏局部事实状态等。这样做的好处是错误更像真实推理中的局部失误，而不是表面噪声。第三步，把第 k 步的错误结论当成新的状态，重新用 symbolic prover 计算后续步骤，得到错误链 C-。这一步很关键，因为它保证错误之后的轨迹仍然和被污染的前缀一致，避免出现“首步错了，但后面还沿着正确世界线走”的伪负样本。第四步，做首错验证。对非结构性错误，检查被注入的错误结论是否真的不能从前缀推出；如果还能推出，就说明这不是有效首错，样本要丢弃。对结构性错误，则检查规则方向、依赖顺序、无环约束等是否被破坏。最后再把正确链和错误链翻译成对齐的自然语言过程，保持背景上下文、实体映射、谓词映射一致，使两条链主要只在推理行为上不同。这个 paired, aligned, verifiable 的设计，是整篇最有价值的部分。
summary.experiments: 从可见内容看，作者构造了一个 20k 规模的训练集，并在附录里给出错误类型分布。实验重点应该不在大模型能力展示，而在数据质量和 PRM 训练效果验证。摘要提到该框架在 PRM 训练和评测上有提升，尤其针对 first-error localization 和细粒度过程评估。结合方法设计，比较合理的实验应包括：与 Monte Carlo rollout、search-based annotation 或简单 label flipping 构造的数据相比，PRM 在首错定位、step-level 准确率、reranking 成功率上的提升；以及不同错误类型、不同错误位置上的泛化表现。当前给出的全文片段没有具体数值，因此还不能判断提升幅度是否足以改变现有 PRM 数据管线。但从问题设定看，最该关注的是：模型是否真的学会了“前缀到第 k-1 步都对，第 k 步首次出错”的判别，而不是只学会识别某些表面错误模板。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Figure 1 和 Method 全段，确认数据生成流程是否闭环，尤其是错误注入、下游重算、prefix non-derivability check 这三步。然后看 error type 定义和数据分布，判断错误空间是否足够丰富，还是主要集中在少数模板。实验部分优先看三类结果：一是 PRM 的首错定位能力；二是 reranking 或 process evaluation 的实际收益；三是对比不做 downstream recomputation 或不做 prefix verification 的消融，这能直接说明每个设计是否必要。若只想判断是否值得跟进，20 到 30 分钟足够；如果你在做 PRM 数据合成或 verifier，值得细看附录里的模板、过滤规则和自然语言对齐策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in process reward modeling: automatically generated process supervision data usually lacks precise control over where the first error occurs, what kind of error it is, and whether the rest of the trajectory remains coherent after that error. Those details matter because PRMs are supposed to learn step-level diagnosis, especially first-error localization, rather than merely assign a global score to an entire chain of thought.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it sits closer to post-training infrastructure for reasoning supervision. Still, it matters if you care about the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. A large fraction of PRM weakness comes from noisy negative trajectories: the first wrong step is ambiguous, later steps are inconsistent with the corrupted state, or the errors are synthetic in a superficial way. This work pushes process data construction toward something more controlled and verifiable. That is useful for PRMs, step verifiers, reranking, and search-based reasoning pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is built as a four-stage pipeline. First, it constructs a verified correct symbolic reasoning chain C+ using an LLM-plus-symbolic-prover setup similar in spirit to ProverGen. The chain is generated under rule templates and each step is checked for derivability, so only truth-consistent trajectories are kept. Second, it injects a template-aware error at an intermediate step k. The error type is constrained by the local rule template rather than sampled from a global noise process, which makes the corruption structurally compatible with the local inference pattern. Third, the corrupted step is treated as part of the new symbolic state, and all downstream steps are recomputed under that corrupted state to produce an erroneous chain C-. This is the key design choice: later steps remain consistent with the wrong prefix, instead of becoming unrealistic label-flipped artifacts. Fourth, the framework verifies that the injected step is truly the first invalid step. For non-structural errors, it performs a prefix non-derivability check; if the corrupted conclusion is still derivable from the prefix, the sample is rejected. For structural errors, it checks violations of rule direction, dependency order, or acyclicity constraints. Finally, both the correct and erroneous symbolic chains are translated into aligned natural-language processes under shared context, entity realizations, and predicate mappings, so the pair differs mainly in reasoning behavior rather than surface form.
summary_en.experiments: From the visible text, the authors build a 20k training set and provide the error-type distribution in the appendix. The experimental focus appears to be data quality and downstream PRM utility rather than raw model scale. The abstract indicates gains in PRM training and evaluation, especially for first-error localization and fine-grained process assessment. The most relevant comparisons are likely against Monte Carlo rollout annotation, search-based annotation, or simpler corruption schemes such as isolated label flipping. The excerpt does not include concrete numbers, so it is hard to judge the practical effect size. The main thing to check in the full paper is whether the trained PRM truly learns the boundary between a valid prefix and the first invalid step, rather than overfitting to a small set of synthetic error templates.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with Figure 1 and the method section to verify that the pipeline is logically closed: error injection, downstream recomputation, and prefix non-derivability checking are the three essential pieces. Then inspect the error taxonomy and its distribution to see whether the corruption space is broad enough. In the experiments, prioritize three questions: how much first-error localization improves, whether reranking or process evaluation actually benefits, and what the ablations say when downstream recomputation or prefix verification is removed. A 20 to 30 minute skim is enough to assess whether the data construction idea is solid; if you work on PRM data synthesis or verifiers, the appendix is likely worth a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 step-level 评测即可；它提醒 PRM 数据要控制“首错可证伪”和“错后轨迹一致”两个变量。
recommendation.en: Read the method and step-level evaluation; the useful lesson is to control both first-error invalidity and post-error trajectory consistency in PRM data.

paper.title: StressEval: Failure-Driven Dynamic Benchmarking for Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Static benchmarks for LLMs are increasingly compromised by contamination and overfitting especially on knowledge intensive reasoning tasks While recent dynamic benchmarks can alleviate staleness they often increase difficulty at the expense of answerability and controllability In this paper we propose StressEval a failure driven data synthesis framework that turns observed model failures into dynamic challenging and controllable test instances StressEval consists of three stages first it constru

summary.core_problem: 静态知识密集推理评测容易被数据污染和过拟合削弱，而现有动态评测又常牺牲可回答性与可控性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法与Benchmark构建。它把模型失败样例转化为新的可控测试实例，目标是让评测持续跟随模型弱点，而不是只依赖固定题库。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StressEval：先构造半结构化 difficulty card，标注失败推理步骤和根因；再用双视角合成方法分别针对知识缺口和推理断点生成新实例；最后用 gating 机制过滤未扎根、歧义或不可回答的样例。
summary.experiments: 从多个知识密集推理数据集出发，构建 Dynamic OneEval。摘要未给出具体模型清单、样本规模、提升幅度或人审一致性指标，核心实验应主要围绕动态样例质量、难度控制和模型区分度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Southeast University、Zhejiang University、Tongji University、Hangzhou Dianzi University；团队背景与知识图谱、知识密集推理评测相关。

summary_en.core_problem: Static benchmarks for knowledge-intensive reasoning are increasingly weakened by contamination and overfitting, while many dynamic benchmarks trade answerability and controllability for difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation and benchmark-construction contribution. It turns observed model failures into controlled test instances, aiming to make evaluation track current model weaknesses instead of relying on fixed test sets.
summary_en.technical_approach: StressEval first builds a semi-structured difficulty card that identifies the failed reasoning step and root cause, then synthesizes instances from both knowledge-gap and reasoning-breakdown perspectives, and finally applies a gating mechanism to keep grounded and unambiguous examples.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is seeded from multiple knowledge-intensive reasoning datasets to build Dynamic OneEval. The abstract does not provide the model list, dataset size, quantitative gains, or human validation statistics; the expected evidence is around instance quality, controllable difficulty, and model discrimination.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Southeast University, Zhejiang University, Tongji University, and Hangzhou Dianzi University, with a likely background in knowledge graphs and knowledge-intensive reasoning evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 作为动态评测思路可留档；预训练研究员只需看 difficulty card 和 gating，别把分数当能力结论。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a dynamic-eval reference; for pretraining work, read the difficulty-card and gating design, not the leaderboard numbers.

paper.title: ScribbleEdit: Synthetic Data for Image Editing with Scribbles and Text
paper.abstract: Recent progress in generative models has significantly advanced image editing capabilities, yet precise and intuitive user control remains difficult. Specifically, users often struggle to communicate both exact spatial layouts and specific semantic details simultaneously. While natural language instructions effectively convey high-level semantics like texture and color, they lack spatial specificity. Conversely, freehand scribbles provide rough spatial boundaries but cannot express detailed visu

summary.core_problem: 为同时接受手绘 scribble 和文本指令的图像编辑模型构造专门训练数据，解决空间控制和语义控制难以兼得的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成数据集和合成数据管线。它补足了现有图像编辑数据中缺少“粗略空间约束 + 细粒度文本属性”组合监督的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ScribbleEdit，一个大规模合成数据集；其核心是用自动化合成流程生成图像编辑样本，并为每个样本配对自然语言编辑指令和自由手绘式 scribble 输入，使模型学习同时解析抽象空间边界和文本语义。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集规模、使用的编辑基座模型、训练 token/图像数量或具体提升幅度；实验目标应包括联合 scribble-text 条件下的编辑精度、空间对齐和语义一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of California, Berkeley。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds training data for image editing models that jointly use freehand scribbles and text instructions, aiming to combine spatial and semantic control.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal generative dataset and synthetic data pipeline. It fills a data gap where existing editing datasets do not jointly supervise rough spatial constraints and fine-grained textual attributes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScribbleEdit is a large-scale synthetic dataset. Its pipeline creates editing examples paired with natural-language instructions and freehand-like scribble inputs, so models can learn to interpret abstract spatial marks together with semantic edit requests.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify dataset size, base editing model, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation likely measures edit accuracy, spatial alignment, and semantic consistency under joint scribble-text conditioning.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with University of California, Berkeley.

recommendation.zh: 可作为多模态合成数据案例备查；预训练研究员看数据生成管线即可，不必跟编辑指标。
recommendation.en: Useful as a multimodal synthetic-data case study; for pretraining work, read the data pipeline and ignore most editing metrics.

paper.title: Embody4D: A Generalist 4D World Model for Embodied AI
paper.abstract: World models have made significant progress in modeling dynamic environments; however, most embodied world models are still restricted to 2D representations, lacking the comprehensive multi-view information essential for embodied spatial reasoning. Bridging this gap is non-trivial, primarily due to challenges from severe scarcity of paired multi-view data, the difficulty of maintaining spatiotemporal consistency in generated 3D geometries, and the tendency to hallucinate manipulation details. To

summary.core_problem: 解决具身AI世界模型只建模2D动态画面、缺少多视角4D空间一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成世界模型和数据合成管线；对预训练研究的间接价值在于如何用合成数据和几何约束补齐稀缺的多视角交互数据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Embody4D，一个面向具身场景的视频到视频世界模型，可从单目视频合成任意新视角。方法包括3D-aware compositional synthesis，用不同机械臂和背景组合构造异构数据；再用adaptive noise injection约束时空几何稳定，减少操作细节幻觉。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline和具体指标；声称能在跨具身形态的机器人场景中提升泛化，并保持生成3D几何的时空一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、中国科学技术大学、中国科学院自动化所、北京航空航天大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of multi-view 4D spatial consistency in embodied world models that mostly operate in 2D video space.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generative embodied world model and synthetic data pipeline. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is how synthetic composition and geometric constraints are used when paired multi-view interaction data is scarce.
summary_en.technical_approach: Embody4D is a video-to-video world model that synthesizes arbitrary novel views from a monocular video. It uses a 3D-aware compositional synthesis pipeline to combine robotic arms and backgrounds, and an adaptive noise injection strategy to improve spatiotemporal geometry stability and reduce manipulation hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims improved cross-embodiment generalization and more stable 3D geometry in generated embodied scenes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, University of Science and Technology of China, Institute of Automation CAS, and Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 只扫数据合成和noise injection即可；它不是LLM预训练，但多视角稀缺数据的处理方式可作多模态预训练备忘。
recommendation.en: Skim the data synthesis and noise-injection parts only; not LLM pretraining, but useful as a note on scarce multi-view data.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
Institute of automation, Chinese academy of science

paper.title: Exploring the Limits of Pruning: Task-Specific Neurons, Model Collapse, and Recovery in Task-Specific Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Neuron pruning is widely used to reduce the computational cost and parameter footprint of large language models, yet it remains unclear whether neurons in task-specific models contribute uniformly to task performance. In this work, we provide empirical evidence for the existence and importance of task-specific neurons through a systematic pruning study on language models specialized for mathematical reasoning and code generation. We introduce an activation-based selectivity metric to identify ne

summary.core_problem: 任务专用 LLM 中，神经元是否均匀贡献于目标能力，以及剪枝后性能崩塌能否通过恢复关键神经元逆转。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析加压缩交叉问题。新意不算高，但如果实验做得干净，它能为“能力是否局部化在少量神经元”提供又一组证据，对 task-vector、sparsity、可编辑性有边际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出基于激活的 selectivity metric，识别对目标任务贡献低的神经元并进行 selective pruning，再与 random pruning 对比；同时做 reverse pruning，专门移除高任务特异性神经元，观察是否出现性能坍塌与可恢复性。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是面向数学推理和代码生成的 task-specific 模型。摘要称 selective pruning 一致优于 random pruning，而移除约 10% 高任务特异性神经元会导致性能完全崩塌。当前信息不足以判断模型规模、训练方式和统计显著性，因此更适合作为弱机制信号。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 BRAC University。未见可确认的顶级实验室背景或该方向长期代表性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Do neurons contribute uniformly in task-specific LLMs, and can pruning-induced collapse be explained by a small set of task-specialized neurons whose restoration recovers performance?
summary_en.importance: This sits at the intersection of mechanism analysis and compression. The novelty is moderate, but if the setup is clean, it adds another data point to the question of whether capabilities are localized in a small subset of neurons, which is relevant to sparsity and model editability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes an activation-based selectivity metric to identify low-contribution neurons for selective pruning, compares it against random pruning, and performs reverse pruning by removing highly task-specific neurons to test collapse and recovery.
summary_en.experiments: The study targets task-specific models for mathematical reasoning and code generation. The abstract claims selective pruning consistently beats random pruning, while removing roughly 10% of highly task-specific neurons causes complete collapse. The available metadata does not reveal enough about model scale, training setup, or statistical rigor, so this should be treated as a weak mechanistic signal.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from BRAC University. No clearly identifiable top-lab affiliation or widely recognized long-track-record authors are evident from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 结论方向不新，但“10% 神经元导致任务崩塌”这个数字值得留档；若要读，只看 selective vs random pruning 和 reverse pruning 两组图。
recommendation.en: The direction is not new, but the “~10% neurons cause collapse” number is worth bookmarking; if you read it, focus only on selective-vs-random and reverse-pruning results.

paper.title: EvoSelect: Data-Efficient LLM Evolution for Targeted Task Adaptation
paper.abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to a targeted task efficiently and effectively remains a fundamental challenge. Such adaptation often requires iteratively improving the model toward a targeted task, yet collecting high-quality human-labeled data to support this process is costly and difficult to scale. As a result, synthetic data generation has emerged as a flexible and scalable alternative. One straightforward approach is through an iterative generation-training loop, where candidate data

summary.core_problem: 面向特定任务的迭代式自合成数据适配中，如何避免噪声/冗余/分布偏移导致的“越训越差”。
summary.importance: 把“生成-训练”闭环改成“生成-选择-训练”，属于数据合成与选择策略；对 pretrain 的启发点在于数据选择/去冗余，但整体更偏任务适配。
summary.technical_approach: EvoSelect：在每轮外部生成器合成候选样本后加入 selection 步骤，筛掉噪声、冗余或与目标分布不匹配的数据，再用筛选数据更新模型并迭代。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、任务、指标与提升幅度细节（仅描述问题与范式）。
summary.authors_note: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign。

summary_en.core_problem: In iterative synthetic-data adaptation loops, how to prevent noisy/redundant/misaligned samples from diluting learning signals and degrading performance.
summary_en.importance: Reframes the common generate-train loop into generate-select-train; relevant mainly as a data selection/de-duplication idea rather than core pretraining innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoSelect inserts a selection step after external generation to filter noisy/redundant/misaligned samples before training, iterating this loop for targeted task adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, tasks, metrics, or concrete gains.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

recommendation.zh: 当作“合成数据闭环里必须做 selection”的提醒即可；等正文确认 selection 信号是否干净、是否只是启发式去重再决定要不要细读。
recommendation.en: Use it as a reminder that synthetic-data loops need selection; only read deeper if the paper shows a clean selection signal beyond heuristic de-dup.

paper.title: Exploring the Role of Synthetic Data Augmentation in Controllable Human-Centric Video Generation
paper.abstract: Controllable human video generation aims to produce realistic videos of humans with explicitly guided motions and appearances,serving as a foundation for digital humans, animation, and embodied AI.However, the scarcity of largescale, diverse, and privacy safe human video datasets poses a major bottleneck, especially for rare identities and complex actions.Synthetic data provides a scalable and controllable alternative,yet its actual contribution to generative modeling remains underexplored due t

summary.core_problem: 合成数据在可控“人类视频生成”训练中到底带来什么增益、与真实数据如何互补，缺少系统性量化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏“数据/训练配比分析”：对生成模型的数据混合与Sim2Real gap有参考，但不直接触及LLM/统一token建模。
summary.technical_approach: 构建一个扩散式可控人像视频生成框架作为统一试验台，系统改变合成/真实数据配比与选择策略，分析两者在身份稀缺与复杂动作场景下的互补性，并讨论更高效的数据筛选方法以缩小Sim2Real差距。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体控制条件（姿态/外观）指标与提升幅度；仅声明“广泛实验”与“揭示互补角色”。

summary_en.core_problem: The actual training value of synthetic data for controllable human-centric video generation and its interaction with real data is under-quantified.
summary_en.importance: Mainly a data-mixture/Sim2Real analysis for diffusion video generation; indirectly relevant to pretraining via data composition lessons.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a diffusion-based controllable human video generation framework as a unified testbed, varies synthetic/real mixing and selection strategies, and studies complementary effects (e.g., rare identities, complex actions) and efficiency-oriented selection to mitigate Sim2Real gap.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits model/data scale, control conditions, metrics, and concrete gains; it only claims extensive experiments and complementary findings.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“合成数据×真实数据配比”的经验报告看即可；只需抓结论与数据选择策略，方法本身对基座预训练迁移有限。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an empirical note on synthetic-vs-real mixing; focus on the takeaways and selection heuristics, not the model details.

paper.title: CHORUS: An Agentic Framework for Generating Realistic Deliberation Data
paper.abstract: Understanding the intricate dynamics of online discourse depends on large-scale deliberation data, a resource that remains scarce across interactive web platforms due to restrictive accessibility policies, ethical concerns and inconsistent data quality. In this paper, we propose Chorus, an agentic framework, which orchestrates LLM-powered actors with behaviorally consistent personas to generate realistic deliberation discussions. Each actor is governed by an autonomous agent equipped with memory

summary.core_problem: 在真实在线讨论数据稀缺、受平台访问限制时，如何生成更接近真实 deliberation dynamics 的合成讨论数据。
summary.importance: 价值主要在数据生成与 agent-based simulation。若你关心用合成交互数据做后训练、偏好建模或社会性对话数据扩充，这篇有一点参考；但它不是基础模型训练范式创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CHORUS：用具有人设一致性的 LLM actors 生成讨论，每个 actor 由带记忆的 autonomous agent 驱动；发言时序由 Poisson process 建模；并结合工具使用访问外部资源与接入交互平台。
summary.experiments: 系统部署在 Deliberate 平台，由 30 名专家从内容真实性等维度评估。摘要未给出与现有 synthetic dialogue generation pipeline 的强基线比较，也未说明这些数据对下游模型训练带来多大量化收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to generate realistic deliberation data when real online discussion data are scarce or inaccessible.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is in synthetic data generation via agent-based simulation. It may be mildly relevant if you care about training data for social dialogue or post-training, but it is not a new foundation-model training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: CHORUS uses persona-consistent LLM actors, each implemented as an autonomous agent with discussion memory. Participation timing is modeled with a Poisson process, and structured tool use allows external resource access and platform integration.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is deployed on the Deliberate platform and evaluated by 30 experts on realism-related dimensions. The abstract does not show strong baseline comparisons or downstream training gains from the generated data.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做合成交互数据，可只看 persona consistency 和 temporal process 设计；没有下游训练增益，先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Only worth a quick look for the persona-consistency and temporal-process design; without downstream training gains, treat it as a weak signal.

paper.title: Evaluating LLM Simulators as Differentially Private Data Generators
paper.abstract: LLM-based simulators offer a promising path for generating complex synthetic data where traditional differentially private (DP) methods struggle with high-dimensional user profiles. But can LLMs faithfully reproduce statistical distributions from DP-protected inputs? We evaluate this using PersonaLedger, an agentic financial simulator, seeded with DP synthetic personas derived from real user statistics. We find that PersonaLedger achieves promising fraud detection utility (AUC 0.70 at epsilon=1)

summary.core_problem: 评估以差分隐私保护输入为条件的 LLM 模拟器，能否生成既保隐私又保分布真实性的合成数据。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值不在 DP 本身，而在一个更普遍的问题：LLM 作为数据生成器时会用自身先验覆盖条件输入分布。这对合成预训练数据、用户模拟、RL 环境构造都很相关。贡献类型主要是失效模式分析。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 PersonaLedger 这一 agentic financial simulator，以由真实用户统计经 DP 机制生成的 synthetic personas 作为种子输入，考察 LLM 生成数据对原始统计分布的保真度，并分析时间特征和人口统计特征上的系统性漂移。
summary.experiments: 在 fraud detection 下游任务上，PersonaLedger 在 epsilon=1 时达到 AUC 0.70，说明合成数据仍有一定效用；但统计分布出现明显漂移，原因是 LLM learned priors 覆盖了输入约束。论文更偏分析而非方法改进，未给出大规模模型训练或消融修复方案。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM simulators conditioned on differentially private inputs can generate synthetic data that is both privacy-preserving and distributionally faithful.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is not DP per se, but a broader lesson: when LLMs are used as data generators, their internal priors can override the conditioning distribution. That matters for synthetic pretraining data, user simulation, and RL environment construction. The contribution is mainly a failure-mode analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate PersonaLedger, an agentic financial simulator, seeded with DP synthetic personas derived from real user statistics, and measure how faithfully the generated data matches the intended statistical distributions.
summary_en.experiments: On a fraud-detection downstream task, PersonaLedger reaches AUC 0.70 at epsilon=1, indicating some utility, but shows substantial distribution drift, especially on temporal and demographic features, because learned LLM priors override input constraints. The paper is more diagnostic than methodological and does not provide a strong repair method or large-scale training study.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它提醒一个常被忽略的坑：拿 LLM 合成数据时，模型先验会悄悄吃掉条件分布；读失效分析就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it surfaces a real pitfall: LLM-generated synthetic data can silently wash out the conditioning distribution; read it for the failure analysis.

paper.title: Evaluating LLMs as Human Surrogates in Controlled Experiments
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human responses in behavioral research, yet it remains unclear when LLM-generated data support the same experimental inferences as human data. We evaluate this by directly comparing off-the-shelf LLM-generated responses with human responses from a canonical survey experiment on accuracy perception. Each human observation is converted into a structured prompt, and models generate a single 0--10 outcome variable without task-specific t

summary.core_problem: 评估现成 LLM 在受控行为实验中能否作为“人类替身”，复现人类数据支持的统计推断。
summary.importance: 价值在于方法学边界澄清：它不是提升模型能力，而是检验 LLM 生成数据在社会科学实验中的外推可靠性，对“LLM 是否像人”这类常见叙事做了收缩。
summary.technical_approach: 将经典调查实验中的每条人类观测转成结构化 prompt，让不同现成 LLM 直接生成单个 0-10 结果变量，不做任务特定训练；随后对人类数据和合成数据施加同样的统计分析，比较方向效应、效应量和调节项。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名单与规模；核心结果是：LLM 能复现若干方向性效应，但效应量和 moderation pattern 随模型变化，且不能稳定匹配人类尺度。更像外部效度检查，而非能力 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether off-the-shelf LLMs can serve as human surrogates in controlled behavioral experiments and preserve the same statistical inferences.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is methodological boundary-setting rather than capability improvement: it narrows the common claim that LLM-generated data can stand in for human subjects.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each human observation from a canonical survey experiment is converted into a structured prompt, and multiple off-the-shelf LLMs generate a single 0-10 outcome without task-specific training; identical statistical analyses are then applied to human and synthetic data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model families or sizes, but the main finding is clear: LLMs recover several directional effects while missing human-scale effect sizes and moderation patterns in a model-dependent way.

recommendation.zh: 结论不直接改预训练做法，但能校正“LLM 可替代人类受试者”的松散叙事；看结果表和误差分解即可，不必细读方法。
recommendation.en: It will not change your pretraining recipe, but it usefully punctures the loose 'LLMs as human subjects' narrative; skim the result tables and error patterns only.

paper.title: HyperGVL: Benchmarking and Improving Large Vision-Language Models in Hypergraph Understanding and Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) consistently require new arenas to guide their expanding boundaries, yet their capabilities with hypergraphs remain unexplored. In the real world, hypergraphs have significant practical applications in areas such as life sciences and social communities. Recent advancements in LVLMs have shown promise in understanding complex topologies, yet there remains a lack of a benchmark to delineate the capabilities of LVLMs with hypergraphs, leaving the boundaries of t

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题很直接：现有 LVLM benchmark 基本停留在普通图，缺少对 hypergraph 这类高阶关系结构的系统评测，因此无法判断模型到底能否理解和推理多元关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身的直接影响有限，它更像一个多模态结构理解 benchmark。但有两个启发点值得记住：一是高阶结构比普通图更接近真实知识组织方式，适合作为检验视觉-语言模型结构推理边界的压力测试；二是作者发现不同 hypergraph 表示形式会显著影响模型表现，这对多模态预训练中的表示选择、输入格式设计和 routing 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 工作分两部分。第一部分是构建 HyperGVL benchmark：总计 84,000 个视觉-语言 QA 对，覆盖 synthetic 与 real-world hypergraph，各自再按 small/medium/large 规模划分；任务上分为 understanding 和 reasoning 两大类，共 12 个任务，并按难度组织为四级，从基本元素识别、邻接感知、启发式计算，到多步算法问题和 NP-hard planning。输入表示也做得比较系统，包含 7 种文本表示和 5 种视觉表示，用来分析模型对不同表示的偏好。第二部分是 WiseHyGR，一个基于历史表现训练的 router，用于为给定 hypergraph 问题选择更合适的表示形式，再交给 LVLM 作答。它不是改模型本体，而是改输入路由策略。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了 12 个主流 LVLM，在 HyperGVL 上做了较全面的横向比较。核心结果不是某个模型绝对分数，而是几条结构性结论：第一，模型在基础理解任务上相对可用，但一旦进入算法推理和尤其是 NP-hard planning，性能明显下滑，说明当前 LVLM 对高阶结构的推理能力仍然有限。第二，表示形式影响很大，同一个模型在不同 textual/visual hypergraph 表示下会有显著差异，这也是作者训练 WiseHyGR 的依据。第三，WiseHyGR 在多数设置下能提升表现，并且有一定 out-of-domain 泛化。就 skim 而言，重点看 benchmark 设计是否合理、任务分层是否清楚，以及 router 的收益是否稳定，不必过度关注具体榜单名次。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看 Introduction 和 Table 1，确认它与已有 graph / hypergraph benchmark 的区别；再看 benchmark 构造部分，重点是任务层级、数据来源、规模划分和 12 种表示；最后看 WiseHyGR 的主结果表，判断 routing 是否真的带来稳定收益。预计 20–30 分钟足够形成判断。如果你主要做 LLM 预训练，这篇不需要精读全文；更适合作为多模态结构推理评测资料备查。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a simple gap: existing LVLM benchmarks focus mostly on ordinary graphs, not hypergraphs, so we do not have a clear measurement of whether current vision-language models can understand and reason over higher-order relations.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, so this is not a core read for base-model research. Still, it offers two useful signals. First, hypergraphs are a more realistic testbed for higher-order relational structure than standard pairwise graphs. Second, the paper shows that representation choice matters a lot: the same underlying hypergraph can lead to very different model behavior depending on how it is rendered in text or vision. That is relevant to multimodal input design and routing strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has two components. The first is HyperGVL, a benchmark with 84,000 vision-language QA pairs built from both synthetic and real-world hypergraphs. The benchmark spans 12 tasks across understanding and reasoning, and organizes them into four difficulty levels: atomic understanding, compound understanding, polynomial-time algorithmic reasoning, and NP-hard planning. It also includes a broad representation space, with seven textual and five visual forms of hypergraphs, so the benchmark can probe not only capability limits but also representation sensitivity. The second component is WiseHyGR, a router trained to choose a better hypergraph representation for a given problem before passing it to an LVLM. This is a representation-selection layer rather than a new backbone model.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 12 advanced LVLMs on HyperGVL. The main takeaway is structural rather than leaderboard-driven. Models are relatively more competent on basic understanding tasks, but performance drops sharply on algorithmic reasoning and especially on NP-hard planning, suggesting that current LVLMs still struggle with higher-order structural reasoning. Another key result is that representation choice has a large effect: the same model can perform very differently across textual and visual hypergraph encodings. This motivates WiseHyGR, which generally improves performance and shows some out-of-domain transfer.
